jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Identity, Data Security and Trust
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer across our Identity, Data Security and Trust organization. These teams builds the security backbone of Snowflake — enabling customers to confidently bring their most sensitive data and workloads to the Data Cloud, empowering every Snowflake engineer to deliver the most secure platform at scale, and giving customers the tools to monitor, achieve, and maintain a strong security, governance, privacy, and compliance posture. As the agentic era accelerates, these teams are at the forefront of building AI-native security capabilities that protect the world's data.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Design and implement critical AI security capabilities — including controlled, audited agent workflows, MCP server and client security, agent identity frameworks, and admin guardrails — that form the foundation for secure agentic enterprise adoption

  • Build and evolve foundational identity and access management systems, including authentication protocols, SSO integrations, multi-factor authentication, OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and fine-grained RBAC that scales to millions of objects and users

  • Design and develop core security infrastructure spanning secret management, key management, service identity, and end-to-end encryption across a natively multi-cloud environment

  • Build and maintain security tooling to define, monitor, enforce, and detect policy violations across the platform; implement automation and self-service processes that increase developer autonomy and promote secure-by-default engineering

  • Design and implement extensible, plug-and-play platform components that enable first-, second-, and third-party security detectors, responders, and visualizations to be built on top of Snowflake's Trust Center

  • Leverage industry-accredited benchmarks (e.g., CIS) to develop standards-based security posture assessments; contribute to behavioral analytics pipelines and PII attribution capabilities that help detect, prevent, and respond to threats and abuse vectors

  • Partner with engineering teams across the company to understand security pain points and deliver solutions that reduce friction without compromising safety

  • Lead the design and enforcement of secure network architectures to actively defend against ransomware attacks and detect sophisticated data exfiltration attempts.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and on-call rotations; hold a high bar for code quality, reliability, and sound technical decisions

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of industry experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems in production cloud environments

  • Strong foundational computer science skills — data structures, algorithms, systems design, and distributed computing

  • Proficiency in one or more of Java, C++, Python, Golang, or Rust, with solid SQL skills for data-driven features

  • Experience shipping and on-calling production services with a focus on availability, reliability, and observability

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach to engineering — comfortable iterating quickly and working across PM, design, and peer engineering teams

  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Knowledge of identity and access management concepts and protocols — SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC, Federation, MFA, or RBAC

  • Familiarity with security infrastructure domains such as secret management, key management, service identity, authentication, or authorization

  • Experience with database internals, query engines, or data platform systems

  • Exposure to machine learning or AI systems, particularly applied to anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, or risk classification

  • Contributions to developer platforms, SDKs, or multi-tenant extensibility frameworks

  • Experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes or production cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

WHY JOIN OUR IDENTITY, DATA SECURITY AND TRUST TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

These teams sit at a rare intersection: the security, identity, infrastructure, and customer trust layers of one of the fastest-growing data platforms in the world. You won't be maintaining someone else's security layer; you'll be defining it. These are teams that value craft, curiosity, and collaboration, and that take pride in making complex security invisible to the developers and customers who depend on it. If you want a role where your technical decisions matter and your growth is tied directly to the scale of the platform you're protecting — and you're energized by the challenge of securing the agentic era before it fully arrives — this is it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, App Runtime
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the role

The App Runtime team is building a platform that lets every Snowflake user go from an idea to a live, deployed web application (Node.js first) in minutes. We own the end-to-end experience of building and running apps, from Cortex AI-assisted development to deployment in a secure, scalable infrastructure. Apps built on the platform inherit Snowflake's security, governance, lineage, and access controls by default. See Deploy Faster with Snowflake Apps.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will drive initiatives that span our product areas and tech stack. It’s a high-impact role - you will work on an early-stage, public-preview product. Your work will directly shape the product experience developers rely on. This role requires a unique combination of deep hands-on expertise with web frameworks, great UX design instincts, customer obsession and collaboration with backend teams.

Responsibilities

  • Build the AI-assisted, agentic development experiences that power App Runtime, spanning the full tech stack - React, Go, Python, and Java

  • Stay deeply hands-on by authoring technical and design specs that consider the system holistically (frontend and backend) and implementing critical code

  • Partner directly with customers, i.e. developers building Snowflake Apps, translating their needs into features and improvements

  • Raise the bar for quality, reliability and performance through code review; mentor engineers

  • Coordinate closely with sister teams such as Cortex AI, Container Platform or Security

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. Master’s or higher is preferred but not a requirement

  • 5+ years of experience including significant experience in frontend or full-stack software development, with a demonstrated track record of designing, shipping and operating high-scale systems

  • Deep understanding of modern web application architecture (e.g. React, NextJS), good API design patterns, security, performance and scale; proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, ideally also in Go, Python and/or Java

  • Good communication skills: crisp write-ups, constructive debate, and ability to drive consensus across engineering, design and product

Nice to have:

  • Experience shipping 0-1 products where you skillfully balanced the trade-offs between feature completeness and time-to-market

  • Experience with multi-tenant systems (ideally app hosting platforms or tooling for developers) with strong isolation and a security-first posture

  • Technical leadership experience, such as being an architect or tech lead for high-impact customer-facing products

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Software Engineer for our Snowpark Container Service, part of our Snowflake Compute Platform - to build our elastic, high-scale, high-performance, cloud native compute platform to enable bringing Compute to Data effortless and simple.

Snowpark Container Services is a fully managed container offering that helps our customers easily deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications without having to move data out of Snowflake. As a fully managed service, it comes with Snowflake security, configuration, and operational best practices built in. You will be part of this highly productive, fast moving, and growing team that is critical to realizing Snowflake’s Data Cloud Mission.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

  • Design and develop features, understand customer requirements and meet business goals.

  • Lead a team of engineers, including mentoring and guiding them, and build technical direction and strategy for large and critical parts of the product surface area.

  • Manage all aspects of the Project, including Design, Coding, Reviews, Testing, Observability, Tooling and On-Call support.

  • Build highly reliable and fault-tolerant software to meet the needs of the largest customers.

  • Ensure operational readiness and maintainability of the service with heavy focus on reliability, availability, debuggability and performance.

  • Design and build Kubernetes based OCI compliant container compute platform features and capabilities that scale and evolve with changing business and customer needs.

  • Snowpark Container Services is still in an early stage of development - it is an amazing opportunity for outsized impact on Snowflake’s growth story.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE MOST OF THE FOLLOWING QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Excitement to learn new things - passion to learn and grow are keys to success on this team.

  • Be a team player - Our team culture is a priority. Transparency, knowledge sharing, fun events, and helping each other are all part of our work environment

  • Work across functions and across teams - we don’t only work on code that we own, we work with other parts of Snowflake every day.

  • 7+ years of industry experience building features and capabilities of large scale systems or infrastructure level platforms.

  • Extremely strong fundamental computer science skills and experience building distributed systems.

  • Hands-on coding experience in Java, C++ or Go is highly desirable

  • Ability to work on-site in our downtown Bellevue office.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience building products or services with Kubernetes.

  • Designing and implementing products and features with multi-cloud support (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Implementing multi-tenant systems with focus on performance, isolation and security.

jobs.title: Director, Technical Revenue Accounting
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is seeking a Director, Technical Revenue Accounting to lead the company’s technical revenue accounting function and serve as the trusted advisor on complex accounting matters across the business. This strategic leadership role partners closely with Product, Legal,Deal Desk, Finance and Go-to-Market teams to enable new business models, structure customer agreements, and ensure compliance with ASC606 and other applicable accounting standards.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical accounting expertise with strong operational acumen, enabling them to translate complex accounting guidance into scalable policies, processes and systems while partnering effectively with cross-functionally stakeholders.

AS THE DIRECTOR, TECHNICAL REVENUE ACCOUNTING YOU WILL:

  • Serve as the company's technical accounting authority for complex revenue transactions, providing accounting guidance that supports new products, strategic partnerships, and evolving commercial models.

  • Review and assess complex customer contracts, including SaaS, professional services, managed services, multi-element arrangements, consumption-based pricing, and strategic partnerships.

  • Partner closely with Legal, Deal Desk and Sales during negotiations for complex, nonstandard deals to translate dense accounting standards (ASC606 and other guidance) into clear, actionable commercial options.

  • Prepare technical account memoranda supporting revenue conclusions. Research emerging accounting guidance and recommend policy updates.

  • Lead technical revenue accounting support for New Product Offerings (NPI), providing authoritative guidance on performance obligation identification, SSP evaluation, contract modifications and other ASC 606 considerations.

  • Advise executive leadership on revenue implications for strategic transactions. Translate complex technical accounting requirements into actionable business guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.

  • Support month-end close activities.

  • Drive process improvement and revenue system implementation projects as needed. Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using AI.

  • Lead and develop a team of revenue accounting professionals; champion a culture of continuous learning, professional growth and career development across the team.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA required

  • 10+ years of progressive experience, including a combination of public accounting and publicly traded SaaS or technology companies.

  • Deep expertise in ASC 606 and technical accounting for complex software/SAAS business models.

  • Experience working with consumption-based revenue models at scale is strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience partnering with Product, Pricing, Legal, GTM, and executive leadership to support new product launches and innovative commercial models.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, and executive presentation skills with the ability to explain complex accounting concepts to non-financial stakeholders.

  • Experience leading, mentoring and developing high-performing accounting teams.

  • Ability to manage tight deadlines, prioritize workload and achieve effective results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, effective multitasking skills are vital.

  • Experience with SFDC, Workday, and revenue accounting systems.

  • Passion for technological and demonstrated interest in leveraging AI and automation to modernize financial operations. Experience driving finance transformation is a plus.

LOCATION:

This role requires in-person attendance at least 3 days per week.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Performance Engineering (Cloud Infrastructure)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Principal Software Engineer — Performance Engineering (Cloud Infrastructure)

Engineering Location: Menlo Park

About the Team

The Capacity, Performance & Efficiency team sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, workload behavior, performance measurement, and business economics. We drive Snowflake’s cloud infrastructure adoption and evolution strategy, price/performance decisions, platform footprint expansion amidst capacity constraints, and strategic alignment with cloud service provider (CSP) technical roadmaps.

We're looking for a Principal Performance Engineer to drive Snowflake's cloud infrastructure performance strategy. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who can go deep on hardware internals (CPU microarchitecture, memory bandwidth, I/O behavior) while also translating that technical depth into pricing, capacity, and roadmap decisions across Snowflake.

You will drive the evaluation of new hardware generations across all major cloud providers, build the benchmarking and modeling infrastructure that turns raw performance data into pricing and rollout decisions, and represent Snowflake in technical discussions with CSPs and silicon partners. You'll help grow performance engineering as a discipline across the company — mentoring engineers, building benchmark capability, and championing a culture of rigorous, data-driven performance work.

What You'll Do

  • Own new hardware evaluation and enablement. Lead evaluation of new AWS, Azure, and GCP instance types (e.g., AWS Graviton, AMD Turin, Azure ARM/Cobalt, GCP Axion) by building representative benchmark and evaluation solutions.

  • Set performance strategy and architecture. Shape the team's technical roadmap, set direction on measurement methodology, and translate benchmark results into concrete rollout and adoption recommendations.

  • Lead cross-functional and CSP partnerships. Work across engineering (i.e. Warehouse, Capacity, and other core platform teams) and Finance along with AWS, Azure, GCP to qualify new hardware and influence future cloud-instance designs.

  • Characterize hardware performance at a deep level. Analyze CPU microarchitecture (e.g., memory bandwidth, PMU counters, I/O behavior) to identify workload-specific bottlenecks and drive resolution.

  • Develop price/performance model to support new hardware transitions.

  • Automate day-zero hardware readiness. Build automated performance-validation workflows and per-provider/per-instance scorecards so Snowflake can qualify and price new silicon at or near cloud-provider GA.

  • Grow the performance engineering discipline. Mentor engineers, build out benchmarking capability, and drive company-wide performance education (e.g., a recurring Performance Tech Talk series).

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • 12+ years of experience in performance engineering, systems engineering, or infrastructure engineering, with a track record of principal-level technical leadership.

  • Deep expertise in cloud infrastructure performance across at least one major CSP (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including instance types, pricing models, and capacity constraints.

  • Strong grounding in hardware/systems fundamentals: CPU microarchitecture, memory bandwidth, I/O subsystems, and use of profiling tools (PMU counters, etc.) to root-cause performance bottlenecks.

  • Experience building or operating large-scale benchmarking systems (e.g., TPC-DS-style workloads) and turning benchmark output into actionable optimization strategies and pricing/rollout decisions.

  • Ability to build quantitative models connecting technical performance metrics to business outcomes (pricing multipliers, cost-per-query).

  • A track record of leading cross-functional, cross-company initiatives — comfortable being the primary technical point of contact with external hardware and cloud partners (CSPs, silicon vendors).

  • Bias toward automation: builds scorecards, dashboards, and validation pipelines rather than relying on one-off analysis.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data warehouse / distributed database performance characteristics.

  • Direct experience partnering with cloud providers or silicon vendors on early-access hardware programs.

  • Experience building hardware-emulation systems.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Security Architect, Applied Field Engineering Office
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We seek a highly specialised technical Senior Security Architect (SA) who practices security with an obsession for helping customers design and implement the best security mechanisms, particularly those that would relate to the Snowflake AI & Data Cloud.


At Snowflake, Security Architects are passionate about security, often involving tremendous technology challenges that require no simple solutions. Success requires working collaboratively with a broad range of people inside and outside the company.

Operating out of our APJ Field CTO Office, you will serve as our primary South Korean Security expert, who will be a cloud compliance evangelist, technical architect, and hands-on practitioner. This specialized role bridges the gap between global cloud data architecture and South Korea’s rigorous, localized regulatory frameworks, specifically the Cloud Security Assurance Program (CSAP) and the Korea Financial Services Institute (K-FSI) Safety Evaluation.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Help to scope security related feature enhancements on behalf of customers to work with Product Management and Engineering on ways to enhance requirements for the local market.

  • Help drive Snowflake adoption by advising customers and engineering teams on how to build secure Korea-compliant Data and AI architectures, ensuring Snowflake implementations respect strict localization and regional access controls.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support in order to drive customer security feature adoption.

  • Partner with our Product Marketing team to define and support Snowflake's AI and Data Cloud posture and Security DataLake workload awareness and pipeline building via marketing initiatives including conferences, trade shows, and events.

  • Work and collaborate with other Field CTO members in areas as a security expert collaborating with Enterprise AI, Gen AI, Data Engineering and Applications teams at Snowflake.

  • Share knowledge with internal and industry communities via webinars & conferences.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

Mandatory Technical Experience & Language Proficiency (Required)

  • Verified Industry Experience: 7-10+ years of hands-on information security experience, with at least 5+ years focused squarely on cloud security architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP, or domestic Korean CSPs like Naver Cloud/NHN).

  • Mandatory Korean & English Fluency: Native or professional business fluency in written and spoken Korean is strictly required for regulatory filings, KISA/FSI communications, and complex technical documentation. Professional-level English is required for global HQ collaboration.

  • 10+ years of industry, customer-facing, and hands-on implementation experience with a core focus on data concepts, privacy, governance, networking, infosec and security technologies.

  • Outstanding skills in presenting to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Experience selling enterprise SaaS software and working in the local South Korean market.

  • Korea-Specific Infrastructure Design: Proven experience designing and managing physical and logical network separation architecture and data localization/residency compliance for highly regulated industries.

  • Expertise and in-depth working knowledge and hands-on experience in cloud platforms (at least one of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP), and its corresponding security, data encryption, and networking architecture and technologies.

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Networking: Advanced understanding of IAM/RBAC, OAuth, identity governance (SCIM), TCP/IP, IP routing, DNS, proxies, and CSP private networking (NAT, Firewalls, TLS, PrivateLink).

  • Advanced Identity & AI Security: Practical exposure to modern security vectors, including AI Security principles and emerging non-human identity frameworks like Agentic Identity (securing AI agents, orchestrators, and LLM data pipelines).

  • Audit Lifecycle Management: Experience executing gap assessments, control implementations, evidence collection, and managing annual surveillance/reassessment cycles.

  • Ability to build out demos, configure CSP environments, and test use cases on the Snowflake platform and relevant integrations with CSP services and external security tools.

  • Ability to create security and networking-related reference architectures, security best practices and hardening guides, and articulate them to a customer audience.

  • A demonstrated knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK and how to articulate controls and security mechanisms within a Risk Assessment centred approach.

  • Knowledge of ANSI SQL compliant databases and / or data warehousing is preferred

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills, presentation and white boarding skills to a large audience, and the ability to successfully communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Fair understanding of the culture diversity across Asia Pacific Japan region and flexibility of working with customers and colleagues from multiple APJ time zones.

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Management Systems, or related field required. Masters preferred.

Korean Regulatory & Compliance Expertise (Highly Desired)

  • Proven CSAP Track Record: Direct, hands-on experience leading or supporting a successful CSAP certification framework (Low, Mid, or High tier)

  • K-FSI & Financial Sector Mastery: Direct experience navigating the K-FSI CSP Safety Evaluation process, demonstrating a deep understanding of vendor risk, outsourcing due diligence, and the Regulation on Supervision of Electronic Financial Transactions (RSEFT / 전자금융감독규정).

  • Data Privacy Mastery: Clear working knowledge of South Korean data privacy and cloud legislation, including Article 23-2 of the Cloud Computing Act, the Electronic Financial Transactions Act (EFTA), and the Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA).

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • AWS/Azure/GCP security and / or networking specialty related certification achievement is a plus

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and APIs

  • Hands-on expertise with software containerisation in Kubernetes, including the use of Terraform or similar technologies.

  • A background or experience in Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC) and Infosec Auditing with relevant accreditations.

  • Any security operations experience in a Security Operations Environment, Security

  • Korean Manufacturing/Telco/Financial Services Vertical experience: Prior experience implementing cloud security architectures or handling compliance programs within various Korean verticals such as: Manufacturing Industry, Telecom, Financial Services, Retail.

  • Formal Certifications: Valid global security credentials (CISSP, CISM, or CISA) paired with official K-ISMS-P Lead Auditor/Assessor credentials.

  • DevSecOps & Coding: Hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, APIs, containerization (Kubernetes), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).

  • SecOps Experience: Prior experience working within a live Security Operations Center (SOC) or threat-hunting environment.

  • Enterprise SaaS Experience: Technical pre-sales or architecture experience supporting enterprise cloud or SaaS software sales cycles.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

 - Audit Lifecycle Management: Experience executing gap assessments, control implementations, evidence collection, and managing annual surveillance/reassessment cycles.

 - Ability to create security and networking-related reference architectures, security best practices and hardening guides, and articulate them to a customer audience.

 - K-FSI & Financial Sector Mastery: Direct experience navigating the K-FSI CSP Safety Evaluation process, demonstrating a deep understanding of vendor risk, outsourcing due diligence, and the Regulation on Supervision of Electronic Financial Transactions (RSEFT / 전자금융감독규정).

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

  • Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

 

On day one you we will expect you to have:

  • Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

  • Fluency or Native Dutch.

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solution Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Senior IT Auditor - IT Internal Audit

Snowflake is growing and looking for a driven Senior IT Auditor to join our team. You will report to the Manager, IT Internal Audit and help with an evolving workload with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment. Whether it is facilitating Snowflake’s SOX compliance efforts or conducting internal audits, we strive to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of the company’s processes, systems, and underlying internal control environment. You will be expected to problem solve, collaborate, and move fast while keeping attention to detail.

AS A SENIOR IT AUDITOR, YOU WILL:

  • Execute and support our IT SOX internal controls assessment, other IT audits and investigations.

  • Evaluate and test the Information Technology General Controls (ITGCs), automated controls, key reports and other IT dependencies as applicable.

  • Develop and update risk and control matrices (RCM), flowcharts, and testing procedures.

  • Prepare and maintain testing workpapers as well as ensure timely testing.

  • Assess and analyze the impact of IT control deficiencies and audit findings; identify remediation procedures and compensating controls to address the associated risks.

  • Participate in risk assessments and the design of audit programs to address relevant risks.

  • Lead in all phases of internal audits including planning, fieldwork, close meetings, and reporting.

  • Partner the Managers and Senior Managers to identify areas of improvement as well as recommend industry-wide best practices.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR IT AUDITOR WILL HAVE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Systems; or relevant MBA.

  • Recognized professional qualification(s) CA/CPA/CISA/CIA/CISSP.

  • 7+ years of relevant work experience in IT SOX, other Technology or System audits and SOC 1 / SOC 2 / CIS controls assessment.

  • Experience with Big 4 accounting firms or global public companies is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with cloud-based or software as a service (SAAS) companies, and certifications like AWS, Azure and Google Cloud is a plus but not required

  • Proven experience in supporting the execution of an end-to-end IT SOX program and control principles (e.g. COSO). Experience in auditing Salesforce and Workday Financials is strongly preferred.

  • Data interpretation and data driven audit/analytics approach with experience in SQL. Ability to read Java/Python preferred.

  • Detail and team-orientated; ability to work both independently and as a team member.

  • Self-starter, ability to proactively problem-solve, identify, advocate for and execute improvements.

  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude and embrace changes, thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to manage multiple, concurrent projects efficiently and effectively with minimal oversight. Maintain relationships with process owners and other key stakeholders.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and refine workflows that are critical to Snowflake’s business

  • Design metrics and experiments to validate your insights

  • Help to implement projects that span our stack, including Typescript services hosted in Snowflake and Kubernetes

  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including product management and design

  • Deliver features requiring close coordination with several partner teams

  • Be a participant in defining the product vision and team planning

  • Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions

Our ideal Software Engineer will have:

  • B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, or equivalent discipline

  • 2+ years of hands-on software engineering experience

  • 2+ years maintaining a production system

  • Interest in the State of the Art LLM-based solutions

  • Experience with modern application design architecture, good API design patterns, performance and scale

  • Experience in technologies such as Typescript, React, Node, Express.

  • Experience with software engineering best practices: unit testing, code reviews, design documentation

  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills, especially in a cloud environment

  • Great communication skills, both verbal and written and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers

  • Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great products

How do you want to make your impact?

About the Marketplace team:

Snowflake Marketplace serves as the vibrant hub which enables customers to do more with data. We are building a platform that empowers organizations to seamlessly discover, access, and build with valuable datasets, cutting-edge applications, and intelligent AI agents.

We are rethinking the architecture and reimagining the user experience to build a best-in-class product that scales to meet the demands of our global customer and partner ecosystem. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and driving customer value. This is a high-impact role where you will have a direct impact on the product and the opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER YOU WILL:

  • Design, develop, and deliver features across our full stack that have a direct impact on our customers and partners.

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end features.

  • Build robust and high-performance systems to support the Marketplace platform

  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, while contributing to a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

  • Be a strong contributor to the overall product and technical direction of the area

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping customer-facing features on production systems.

  • A strong foundation in full-stack development from frontend to backend using technologies like Java, Python, Golang and React/Typescript

  • A genuine passion for building customer-facing products and a drive to solve problems that create real value for users.

  • A strong understanding of core computer science concepts and web application architecture, including security, performance, and scalability.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER YOU WILL:

  • Build and own end-to-end full-stack features — from polished checkout and billing UIs to the backend services that process, validate, and settle marketplace transactions at scale

  • Design and implement robust backend APIs and services in Java or Python that handle the lifecycle of commercial transactions: entitlements, AI usage metering, invoicing, and payment orchestration

  • Develop reusable, accessible component libraries and systems that give buyers and sellers clear visibility into usage, spend, and revenue — working closely with design to deliver intuitive experiences

  • Contribute to the reliability, correctness, and observability of high-stakes transactional pipelines — including fraud prevention, idempotency guarantees, and audit logging

  • Collaborate with product, operations, and Billing teams to model and evolve the data schemas and APIs that underpin Snowflake’s Marketplace.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, architecture discussions, and sprint planning; raise the bar for engineering quality across the Monetization team

  • Identify gaps in test coverage, monitoring, and operational tooling for transactional workflows and drive improvements proactively

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Senior Cloud Support Engineer (CSE) - SQL

職務概要

Snowflakeでは、技術力、顧客志向、そしてAIを活用した業務遂行能力を兼ね備えたSenior Cloud Support Engineerを募集しています。

本ポジションでは、AIツールを活用しながらトラブルシューティングの迅速化、ナレッジベースの改善、問題解決までの時間短縮に取り組んでいただきます。また、安全性と品質を維持しながら、AIを効果的に活用することが求められます。

24時間365日のテクニカルサポート環境での業務経験、エスカレーション対応、オンコール対応、インシデントマネジメントの経験をお持ちの方を歓迎します。

 
 

主な業務内容

Senior Cloud Support Engineer として、お客様からのお問い合わせ（ケース）を管理し、解決までの時間の短縮、プラットフォームの安定性の確保、および世界最高水準のサポート体験の提供に責任を負います。本ポジションは、幅広い技術領域に対応するテクニカルサポート担当者として、高度な実践的トラブルシューティング能力に加え、お客様から信頼されるアドバイザーとしての共感力とコミュニケーション能力を備えた役割です。


顧客価値の提供とインシデントオーナーシップ

顧客体験の向上 : お客様からのお問い合わせについて、初期調査から解決、その後のフォローアップまで一貫して担当し、適切なコミュニケーションとタイムリーな状況共有を行います。

AIを活用したサポート : AIアシスタントや診断ツールを活用し、初動対応や根本原因分析を効率化します。

成果重視の問題解決 : 単なる事象解消に留まらず、再発防止やシステムの信頼性向上を意識したサポートを提供します。

顧客対応 : メール、Web会議、電話などを通じて技術的な分析やアドバイスを提供し、お客様の技術レベルに応じたコミュニケーションを行います。

 
 

技術対応と社内連携

AIを活用した調査 : AIを利用してログ分析、仮説立案、回答案作成を行い、その内容を適切に検証したうえでお客様へ提供します。

技術調査 : Snowflake環境、コネクタ、社内ツールなどを活用し、問題の調査・検証を実施します。

部門横断での連携 : Engineering、Product、Customer Successチームと連携し、複雑な問題や製品課題の解決に取り組みます。

ナレッジ管理 : ナレッジベースに解決策を登録するとともに、AIが作成したドラフトをレビューし、必要に応じて修正します。

フィードバックと改善提案 : 製品の動作、ドキュメントの不足、およびAIツールの改善点などについてフィードバックを提供します。

バグ管理 : 不具合や機能改善要望を文書化し、Engineeringチームと連携して問題の解決に取り組みます。

サポート体制への参加 : 祝日・週末のローテーション勤務およびオンコール対応を行います。

 
 

勤務条件

  • 13:00～22:00（休憩1時間）のシフト勤務が可能であること

  • 業務状況に応じて、勤務時間やシフトを変更する場合があります

 
 

必須となる経験・スキル

  • 5年以上のテクニカルサポート経験（顧客対応経験必須）

  • 24時間365日サポート環境での業務経験がある方歓迎

  • AIツールを活用した業務経験

  • AIの出力内容を適切に評価・検証できる能力

  • 必要に応じてAIに依存せず、自ら調査・分析できる能力

  • SQLを利用した問題解析経験

  • ログ分析経験

  • 主要なRDBMS製品に関する基本的な知識

  • SQLデータ型、集計処理、関数に関する理解

  • クエリ実行計画（Execution Plan）やクエリプロファイルの分析経験

  • JSON、XMLなどの半構造化データの取り扱い経験

  • 半構造化データの検索・変換経験

  • 主要クラウドサービス（AWS、Azure、GCPなど）の利用経験

  • クラウドアーキテクチャの理解

  • ロック制御や同時実行制御に関する深い理解

  • 日本語による優れた読み書きおよび口頭でのコミュニケーション能力

  • 英語での基本的な口頭コミュニケーションスキル

  • 中級以上の英語の読み書きスキル

 
 

歓迎する経験・スキル

  • Snowflake製品の利用経験

  • ワークフロー自動化またはCI/CD環境の構築・運用経験

  • AIを活用したサポート業務またはSRE業務経験

  • SnowProやクラウド関連資格

  • 分散データベース、ビッグデータ基盤、MPPデータベースの運用経験

  • データベース移行やETLプロジェクト経験

  • クラウドコスト管理および最適化経験

  • SQLパフォーマンスチューニング経験

  • JOIN最適化やクエリ改善の実務経験

  • データベースのパッチ適用・リリース管理経験

  • CPU、メモリ、I/O、ネットワークなどのパフォーマンス指標の分析能力

  • 高可用性（HA）および災害復旧（DR）設計・運用経験

  • データウェアハウスのリソース管理および最適化経験

  • クラウドリソースのスケールアップ・スケールアウトに関する知識

  • ジョブおよびタスクスケジューリングの最適化経験

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team.

Do you want to own one of the most consequential narratives in enterprise data? As AI forces organizations to rethink their architectures, the ability to act on governed data from any engine, any cloud, any format is becoming a foundational requirement. We're looking for a technically fluent, driven PMM to lead Snowflake's Interoperable Lakehouse story across the Apache Iceberg™ and Apache Polaris™ ecosystems, turning a fast-moving technical landscape into sharp positioning that wins in the market.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in Snowflake’s Menlo Park, CA, OR Bellevue, WA office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build and execute a go-to-market strategy and innovative programs that position the Snowflake platform as the leading Lakehouse, with interoperability at the core of our offerings.

  • Create crisp and compelling messaging, content, sales enablement, and more to be used by Snowflake marketing and sales teams, as well as partner teams

  • Drive Snowflake's go-to-market narrative across the Apache Iceberg™ and Polaris™ open source ecosystems alongside our community team, including developer and community audiences

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other PMM teams, demand generation, content marketing, sales, product management, Alliances and other teams to build alignment around go-to-market plans

  • Execute and be accountable for the success of go-to-market campaigns

  • Communicate customer requirements and provide input to product management on product enhancements and future product direction

  • Develop market/competitive intelligence, acting as our thought leader and expert

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • 6+ years of proven product marketing experience ideally related to data infrastructure, lakehouse technologies or the open source data ecosystem

  • Cross-functional team management and organizational skills, influence without authority, including senior management

  • Excellent communication skills, and can engage internal leaders/teams across functions and external stakeholders

  • Strong written communication skills and ability to synthesize complex information into clear and concise presentations and plans

  • Demonstrated track record of building and executing successful go-to-market programs and campaigns

  • Analytical mindset, interpreting and summarizing data with actionable insights

  • Technical- and business-benefit understanding of prevailing and emerging data technologies, on-premises and in the cloud

  • Experience working with or alongside open source communities, developer ecosystems, or technical alliances a strong plus

  • BS/BA, MBA preferred

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of time

Google Cloud is one of Snowflake’s fastest-growing CSP partners. What You'll Own

Co-Sell & Revenue

  • Drive co-sell execution with Google Cloud and Snowflake sellers across the Americas, with visibility into EMEA and APJ targets

  • Build sales plays and joint customer solutions targeting Global 2000 accounts and industry-specific use cases

  • Manage Google Cloud-related incentive fund programs in partnership with Snowflake's Incentive Programs team

Executive Engagement & Strategy

  • Lead QBRs with Snowflake and Google Cloud senior executives

  • Create and own the annual business plan between Snowflake and Google Cloud

  • Build trust-based relationships across both organizations at the leadership level

Marketing & Enablement

  • Partner with Snowflake and Google Cloud marketing teams to design and execute joint programs that drive pipeline

  • Develop enablement materials for partner sales teams, leaders, and AEs covering joint solutions and use cases

  • Measure program impact through deal registration, joint pipeline, and reference wins

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in sales, alliances, or partner management in software/SaaS

  • 3+ years leading an ISV partnership with Google Cloud, with a track record of $25M+ in annual co-sell

  • Experience building cross-functional alignment across Sales, Sales Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Programs

  • Strong executive presence: you're comfortable presenting strategy and partnership impact to C-level audiences

  • Analytical and data-driven approach to measuring what's working and where to double down

Nice to Have

About the team

Engineering Systems is the team redefining how Snowflake builds. We develop AI-powered tools, platforms, and workflows that accelerate delivery, strengthen reliability, and drive deeper developer satisfaction. Now, we’re unlocking the next frontier, bringing AI transformation to boost productivity, elevate the developer experience, and set a new standard for engineering efficiency across Snowflake.

What you will do

Global Context & Memory: Give agents the context they need to operate independently & efficiently at every step of the product lifecycle. Enable long horizon tasks via a tiered memory system.

Next-Gen AI Tooling & Ecosystem: Scale the core components of our AI developer toolkit, including experimental frameworks, the MCP ecosystem, and seamless skill distribution through our internal plugin marketplace.

Model Enablement & Smart Routing: Onboard cutting-edge models and intelligent routing solutions that optimize for performance, quality, and efficiency.

Rigorous Evaluation & Verification: Design and execute evaluation pipelines to assess model cost-efficiency, ensure strict reliability standards, and continually protect developer productivity.

Cost Optimization & Scale: Partner directly with cross-functional leaders on cost-curve bending initiatives, bringing transparency and efficiency to massive-scale AI infrastructure.

Our ideal candidate

  • 12+ years of industry experience building developer infrastructure, tools, test frameworks or CI systems for large, complex codebases.

  • Hands on experience with building and scaling AI solutions. Experience with building fully self-driving codebases is a plus.

  • A data-driven approach to quality: experience analyzing incidents and defect data to identify quality escapes and systemic themes, and driving practice changes that reduce them.

Your role will encompass prospecting, developing, and closing business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability and be open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team carries a deep curiosity to learn and are always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers needs.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Become an expert on Snowflake’s product and conduct discovery calls, customized demos, and presentations to prospective customers

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

  • Land, adopt, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

  • Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

  • This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

jobs.title: Programme Director EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Snowflake works with the world's top 200 global companies. In this role you will build and lead Snowflake's programme delivery practice across EMEA, and stay close to the programmes that matter most to our largest customers: multi-year data, AI and modernisation transformations that change how those businesses run.

We are looking for a hands-on Programme Director. You have personally delivered complex, high-stakes programmes across several industries, and you still want to be close to the work. As a player-coach, you can build and lead a senior team and run a regional services business with commercial discipline. You also keep hands-on senior oversight of our most critical customer engagements. You are as credible in a programme steering committee or a customer boardroom as you are reviewing a delivery plan with your engineers. You'll report directly to the Regional Vice President, EMEA Services. Success means predictable delivery, healthy margin and customers who come back to us.

WHY THIS ROLE?

Lead with AI: Snowflake is a market leader in data and AI. You will shape how a regional delivery organisation uses AI and agentic tools to scope, deliver, assure and govern programmes faster and better.

Shape a new delivery model: We're moving services from time and materials to fixed fee fixed outcome mode as part of the new AI Engineering initiatives that are shaping the way our customers build their enterprise i.e we own the result for the customer. You'll shape how delivery works in that model across EMEA.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Stay close to key engagements: Provide hands-on executive oversight of our most strategic and complex programmes. Step in personally where it matters, unblock escalations, and bring calm, decisive leadership to high-pressure situations.

Run the regional delivery business: Own EMEA delivery revenue, margin and forecast accuracy as we move from billable hours to fixed outcomes. Keep discipline on budgets and quarterly goals.

Build and lead a senior team: Hire, develop and retain a team of senior programme managers, delivery managers and architects. Set clear objectives, delegate well and hold the team accountable for results.

Champion AI-first delivery: Model and drive AI-forward ways of working across the team. Use Snowflake's AI and agentic capabilities, and wider AI tooling, to speed up scoping, migration, quality assurance, reporting and decision-making. Do this responsibly, with human oversight built in.

Advise at C-suite level: Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives on data and AI strategy, modernisation ROI, reducing technical debt, and managing risk.

Shape and negotiate complex deals: Lead the shaping, pricing and negotiation of high-value Statements of Work (SOWs) together with Sales, Partners and Legal.

Set the standard for delivery quality: Establish and run regional programme governance and Quality Assurance frameworks that validate architecture, surface risk early and give customers predictable results.

Oversee modernisation at scale: Direct multiple concurrent enterprise programmes moving from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Exadata, Hadoop and others) to Snowflake. Increasingly, this includes AI and agentic use cases built on the AI Data Cloud.

Orchestrate the ecosystem: Lead blended delivery models across Snowflake, Global System Integrators and partners, setting direction for people who may not report to you.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE

  • A track record of hands-on delivery: 12+ years in technical programme delivery, professional services or management consulting. You have personally led complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes, not only overseen them.

  • Achieve pipeline generation and revenue targets for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target account list

  • Work directly with customers to understand their Data Engineering needs, communicating insights to inform Snowflake’s product roadmap and ensuring alignment with customer requirements.

  • Work with our Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Leadership and Field CTOs to drive customer engagements from discovery and qualification through solution implementation and deployment

  • Track, analyze, and report on Data Engineering sales performance metrics, using data-driven insights to optimize strategies and drive continuous improvement

  • Partner with the broader cross-functional organization to integrate Data Engineering sales efforts with Snowflake’s overall go-to-market plans.

  • Driving the forecast of the region and exceeding revenue targets on consumption

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of professional experience and at least 6 of years sales experience with consistently exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market

  • A strong track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in highly competitive markets

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, capable of engaging with senior executives and key decision-makers at both technical and business levels.

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Senior Software Engineer, CXE – Frontier Engineering

Customers are taking Snowflake into increasingly ambitious workloads, and they expect the product itself to guide them through complexity. The Customer Experience Engineering (CXE) team builds the intelligent product capabilities that make this possible. We turn diagnostic telemetry, operational signals and technical knowledge, both structured and unstructured, into AI-powered features inside Snowflake that help customers understand, diagnose and resolve problems on their own.

We design LLM-powered applications and agentic systems, backed by solid backend engineering, and ship them to production at Snowflake scale. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us. You'll own products from design through launch, and you'll use AI tools in your own engineering workflow.

As a Sr. Software Engineer, you will:

  • Lead and drive projects that span our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Kubernetes and Snowpark Container Services.

  • Design, build and ship LLM-powered features and AI agents that reason over diagnostic data and technical content, with attention to quality, latency, cost and safety.

  • Create evaluation frameworks and observability for AI systems, so we can measure and improve their quality in production.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools in your daily work and help raise the team's practices for building with them.

  • Promote strong collaboration within a cross-functional team, including product management and design.

  • Deliver features requiring close coordination with several partner teams.

  • Be a strong contributor to the product vision and drive team planning.

  • Find problems, instrument the relevant components and implement lasting solutions

  • Mentor and coach junior team members.

Our ideal Senior Software Engineer will have:

  • B.S. or M.S degree in CS, MIS, or equivalent discipline

  • 6+ years experience hands-on software engineering experience

  • Deep understanding of modern application design architecture, good API design patterns, performance, and scale.

  • Expertise in at least one of the following (bonus for more than one): Python, Java, Scala, GoLang.

  • Experience with software engineering best practices: unit testing, code reviews, and design documentation.

  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills, especially in a cloud environment.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership experience, such as being an architect or tech lead for high-impact projects.

  • Great communication skills, both verbal and written and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers.

  • Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Cortex AI Functions
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the team

Our vision is to make raw multimodal data agent-ready and useful for analytics at enterprise scale. With Snowflake AI Functions, we enable pipelines that transform PDFs, images, audio, and video into high-quality information for downstream agents and applications, with the scalability and performance of a data platform.

We bring semantic operators into SQL—extraction, classification, filtering, joins, summarization, and aggregation—so customers can process and analyze structured and unstructured data together in a single hybrid query or pipeline through Snowflake’s SQL query surface. Our work connects AI quality with database systems through AI-aware query planning, adaptive model selection, and semantic query optimization. We seek deep expertise in either AI quality and applied modeling or database systems.

As a Staff Software Engineer you will

  • Serve as tech lead for a group of 2–4 engineers, independently driving a large project end to end—from problem definition and architecture through implementation, launch, and production outcomes.

  • For AI quality initiatives, define model strategies tailored to product needs, balancing accuracy, cost, and latency. Drive evaluation, error analysis, prompt optimization, and model adaptation, including fine-tuning and post-training where appropriate. Guide model-specific hosting and inference optimizations with infrastructure partners, validating their impact on quality and performance.

  • For database systems initiatives, advance AI-aware query planning, compiler optimizations, distributed execution, scheduling, and safe result reuse within SQL and data pipelines.

  • Connect quality objectives with execution decisions; diagnose bottlenecks and improve correctness, reliability, observability, and efficiency across the data processing workflow.

  • Co-define the product surface and business strategy with PMs and leadership, translating customer needs into product capabilities, priorities, and success metrics. Align partner teams and manage dependencies through delivery.

  • Break complex projects into milestones, delegate work, unblock and mentor engineers, and maintain technical quality through hands-on contributions and design and code reviews.

Our ideal candidate will have

  • Deep expertise in either AI quality and applied modeling or database systems, supported by substantial technical contributions and measurable production impact. Expertise in both is not required.

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or database systems, including independently leading multi-engineer projects from definition through production.

  • Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and software design; fluency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python; and strong debugging and testing skills.

  • An empirical approach to problem solving: clear metrics, disciplined experiments, root-cause analysis, and sound tradeoffs between quality, cost, and latency.

  • Strong product sense and a track record of co-defining product direction with PMs and leadership, connecting technical investments to customer value and business outcomes.

Relevant depth in either area

AI quality: modeling, evaluation methodology, statistical experimentation, data quality, error analysis, and automated optimization. Prior hands-on experience with model fine-tuning and post-training is a plus for AI quality candidates, but is not required.

Database systems: query optimizers, compilers, execution engines, distributed data processing, and performance analysis. Familiarity with AI infrastructure is a plus; our systems focus is integrating AI into database execution and data pipelines.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Drive evaluation, error analysis, prompt optimization, and model adaptation, including fine-tuning and post-training where appropriate. Guide model-specific hosting and inference optimizations with infrastructure partners, validating their impact on quality and performance.

 - For database systems initiatives, advance AI-aware query planning, compiler optimizations, distributed execution, scheduling, and safe result reuse within SQL and data pipelines.

 - Connect quality objectives with execution decisions; diagnose bottlenecks and improve correctness, reliability, observability, and efficiency across the data processing workflow.

 - Co-define the product surface and business strategy with PMs and leadership, translating customer needs into product capabilities, priorities, and success metrics. Align partner teams and manage dependencies through delivery.

 - Break complex projects into milestones, delegate work, unblock and mentor engineers, and maintain technical quality through hands-on contributions and design and code reviews.

Our ideal candidate will have

 - Deep expertise in either AI quality and applied modeling or database systems, supported by substantial technical contributions and measurable production impact. Expertise in both is not required.

 - 8+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or database systems, including independently leading multi-engineer projects from definition through production.

 - Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and software design; fluency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python; and strong debugging and testing skills.

 - An empirical approach to problem solving: clear metrics, disciplined experiments, root-cause analysis, and sound tradeoffs between quality, cost, and latency.

 - Strong product sense and a track record of co-defining product direction with PMs and leadership, connecting technical investments to customer value and business outcomes.

Relevant depth in either area

AI quality: modeling, evaluation methodology, statistical experimentation, data quality, error analysis, and automated optimization. Prior hands-on experience with model fine-tuning and post-training is a plus for AI quality candidates, but is not required.

Database systems: query optimizers, compilers, execution engines, distributed data processing, and performance analysis. Familiarity with AI infrastructure is a plus; our systems focus is integrating AI into database execution and data pipelines.

People Partner – Product & Engineering

Snowflake is seeking a People Partner to support our Product and Engineering organizations. In this role, you will be a trusted, hands-on advisor to people managers and their teams across the full range of people topics, including talent, performance, engagement, org design and change management. Partnering with leaders on performance and talent decisions will be a meaningful part of the work.

We are looking for a People Partner who is curious about how technical teams work, comfortable with hard conversations, and excited about the impact of AI on both the business and Snowflakes around the world. You bring sound judgment, a bias for action, and a strong sense of ownership.

This role is based in either our Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA office, with in-office attendance required three days per week.

The People Partner will work closely with Product and Engineering teams, global People Partners, Employee Relations, and People Centers of Excellence (COEs) to deliver people programs and solve talent challenges across a fast-moving technical organization.

THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE:

  • Serve as a go-to advisor for Product and Engineering leaders and teams on talent, team effectiveness, and day-to-day people decisions

  • Help managers raise the bar on their teams by setting clear expectations, giving candid feedback, and tackling performance head-on

  • Partner on performance review and calibration cycles for your client groups, bringing data and a point of view to drive consistent, differentiated outcomes

  • Support core talent processes including promotions, compensation cycles, succession planning, and retention of top talent

  • Build manager capability through coaching and targeted development, helping first- and second-line leaders grow

  • Spot what's working and what's not across engagement, attrition, and performance, and turn insights into action

  • Be the steady hand on complex employee situations, partnering with Employee Relations when it counts

  • Help teams scale, reorganize, and evolve without losing momentum

  • Use data, Workday reporting, and AI tools to diagnose issues, track outcomes, and scale your impact

  • Partner with COEs (Talent, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, Recruiting) to deliver programs tailored to technical teams

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 7+ years of HR/People experience, including as a people partner or generalist

  • Experience supporting Engineering, Product, or other technical organizations in a fast-paced environment is preferred

  • Hands-on experience advising managers through performance challenges, review cycles, and calibrations

  • Strong coaching skills, with the ability to help managers have direct, empathetic conversations

  • Comfort with data; able to interpret people metrics and turn them into recommendations

  • Ability to build credibility quickly with technical managers and push back constructively

  • Curiosity and applied interest in AI and how it can evolve the people partner role

  • Thrive in a high-volume environment and own outcomes from start to finish

  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments

WORK MODEL & LOCATION:

Snowflake operates a hybrid work model, with three days per week in either the Bellevue or Menlo Park office.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
