jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics & AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential with Data & AI. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We're hiring for a Senior Director of Analytics Engineering to join our Data, Analytics, and AI organization (DAA), reporting directly to the Chief Data & Analytics Officer. You will lead a team of 20+ Analytics Engineers that build and operate the pipelines behind Snowflake's revenue, bookings, people analytics, and go-to-market reporting within our governed data platform.

This role has an in-office requirement — you must be able to work out of our Menlo Park office a minimum of 3 days a week.

In This Role You Will

  • Lead and grow the Analytics Engineering organization: Manage through your direct reports (team leads/managers), setting priorities and technical strategy across the team.

  • Drive Snowflake’s internal data transformation: Lead your teams' ongoing work to create an AI ready data foundation, with an emphasis on documentation, contracts, context, and governance.

  • Own Snowflake’s internal analytics agents: Build, improve, and maintain general purpose analytics agents - and underlying context and semantic layers - that can be used across the organization including evals, orchestration instructions, and ground truth data sets

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering: Drive adoption of Cortex Code-based agentic workflows and reusable skills across your teams to speed up typical Analytics Engineering jobs-to-be-done, including model development, PR review, and root-cause analysis.

  • Act as Snowflake’s customer zero: Be the first trusted tester of Snowflake’s own features across the data engineering and transformation stack, deeply engaging with Product and Engineering teams on product and feature roadmaps

  • Represent Snowflake: Support our GTM and Frontier Engineering teams by joining customer conversations, supporting speaking engagements, and publishing thought leadership, ultimately demonstrating the art of possible on Snowflake to all our customers and prospects

  • Continually push our stack forward: Push the boundaries of what we can accomplish on Snowflake, adopting the latest internal Data and AI capabilities.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Serve as the primary point of escalation for business stakeholders, driving towards a common roadmap and transforming upstream processes and workflows with data in mind

  • Represent your teams upward and cross-org: Contribute your teams' patterns and learnings to the Data, Analytics, and AI org's broader technical initiatives

What You Will Need

  • 10+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or data architecture, including second line leadership experience managing managers or senior individual contributors across multiple teams.

  • A systems thinker at your core: You naturally see how individual data models, pipelines, and architectural decisions connect — and you design for second-order effects, not just the immediate problem.

  • Deep expertise in Snowflake, including data modeling, data governance (e.g., RBAC design, row access policies and masking policies), and the broader Snowflake feature set (Dynamic Tables, Streams, Tasks, Horizon, Cortex)

  • Expert-level dbt skills, including macro development, testing and CI/CD frameworks, and large-scale multi-team project management.

  • Hands-on experience with Airflow or similar orchestration platforms

  • A track record owning finance- or revenue-critical, deadline-driven data pipelines where accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable.

  • Familiarity with GTM and sales analytics domains: master data management, consumption & attainment pipelines, quota/territory data.

  • Advanced adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools — Cortex Code, Claude Code, or similar agent frameworks — including agentic skill development and prompt engineering for data workflows.

  • A record of driving large scale data transformation initiatives across complex organizations

  • Experience with downstream BI/consumption layers such as Streamlit, Sigma, Tableau, etc.

  • Comfort working in a Jira/Confluence-based agile delivery model.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of writing clear technical specs and stakeholder-facing materials for non-technical audiences

    Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer I, Frontier Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer for our Frontier Engineering team. This team embeds directly with Snowflake's most strategic customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems . At the Principal level, you are the senior technical counterpart to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and chief architects at our largest enterprise customers; you set the technical direction that the Frontier Engineering organization follows.

AS A PRINCIPAL FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER YOU WILL:

  • Be the trusted technical partner to customer engineering leadership: Build durable, peer-level relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, chief architects, and heads of data/AI at Snowflake’s most strategic accounts: lead architectural steering, technical reviews, and executive strategy alignment to help shape their AI roadmaps.

  • Drive Architecture & Technical Strategy Across High-Stakes Deployments: Own end-to-end technical execution and outcomes across Snowflake’s most complex, high-visibility AI engagements.

  • Stay hands-on: Write production code and working prototypes on the most critical parts of customer programs, and review designs and code to set the bar for how the team builds.

  • Own the AI quality bar: Lead how the team measures and improves AI quality, turning ambiguous customer goals into clear, testable evaluation standards.

  • Provide Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Mentor Senior and Staff engineers, raise engineering standards across the organization, and partner with cross-functional leads to drive complex technical initiatives.

  • Travel to Customer Sites: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite working with customers.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years building and shipping production AI/ML or agentic systems at enterprise scale.

  • Proven track record as a trusted technical advisor to CTOs and executive engineering leaders at large enterprises.

  • Demonstrated success converting client/field delivery patterns into reusable platforms, tools, frameworks, or open-source libraries.

  • Deep expertise in production AI architectures—including RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic systems, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.

  • Hands-on builder who writes and reviews production code and stays close to implementation.

  • Strong systems mindset with exceptional technical communication skills across both deeply technical and executive audiences.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience shipping features into a commercial data or AI platform, based on customer requirements.

  • Active contributions to open-source AI frameworks, technical publications, or industry speaking engagements.

  • Familiarity with Cortex AI, Snowpark, or modern enterprise data infrastructure platforms.

WHY JOIN FRONTIER ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE?

Frontier Engineering is where Snowflake’s AI platform meets reality. You’re not building demos, you’re shipping AI applications that run in some of the world’s most complex enterprise environments. You will work on hard problems with real stakes, alongside engineers who are deeply technical and customer-obsessed.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, Frontier Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer II for our Frontier Engineering team. This team embeds directly with Snowflake's most strategic customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems . At the IC6 level, you serve as the senior technical authority and architectural leader for a portfolio of high-impact customer engagements. You operate as a peer technical advisor to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, chief architects, and heads of data and AI, setting technical direction that extends beyond individual accounts and influences how Snowflake delivers AI solutions at scale.

AS A PRINCIPAL FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER II YOU WILL:

  • Serve as the senior technical authority and architectural leader for customer engineering leadership: Build durable, peer-level relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, chief architects, and heads of data and AI at Snowflake’s most strategic accounts. Lead architectural steering, technical reviews, and executive strategy alignment while shaping multi-year AI roadmaps across a portfolio of customers.

  • Drive Architecture and Technical Strategy Across a Portfolio of High-Stakes Deployments: Set the technical strategy, architecture, and execution model across multiple complex, high-visibility AI engagements. Own end-to-end outcomes, arbitrate the most difficult cross-system tradeoffs, and establish patterns that scale across customers, teams, and business units.

  • Influence Snowflake Product Direction: Translate recurring customer needs and deployment learnings into clear product requirements, partner with Product and Engineering leaders, and drive adoption of capabilities that improve outcomes across the field.

  • Stay hands-on and set the engineering bar: Write production code and working prototypes on the most critical or ambiguous parts of customer programs, review designs and code, and demonstrate the technical depth and judgment expected across the organization.

  • Set the AI quality and reliability bar: Define organization-level standards for evaluation, observability, reliability, security, guardrails, and responsible deployment. Turn ambiguous customer goals into clear, testable measures and ensure those standards are applied consistently across engagements.

  • Provide technical leadership and develop senior technical talent: Mentor Principal, Staff, and Senior engineers; develop technical leads; raise engineering standards across the organization; and lead through influence across Engineering, Product, Sales, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Travel to Customer Sites: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite working with customers.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including a sustained track record of building and shipping production AI/ML or agentic systems at enterprise scale.

  • Proven track record serving as a trusted technical advisor to CTOs and executive engineering leaders at large enterprises, and setting technical direction across multiple strategic accounts or enterprise programs.

  • Demonstrated success converting client and field delivery patterns into reusable platforms, tools, frameworks, reference architectures, or open-source libraries adopted across teams or customers.

  • Deep expertise in production AI architectures—including RAG pipelines, multi-step agentic systems, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, security, and operating models for enterprise-scale adoption.

  • Hands-on technical leader who writes and reviews production code, stays close to implementation, and can move from executive strategy to the critical technical details that determine whether a system succeeds.

  • Exceptional systems thinking and technical communication skills across deeply technical and executive audiences, with the ability to influence without formal authority and align multiple organizations around a common technical strategy.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience leading cross-organizational technical initiatives that improve how enterprise AI solutions are designed, deployed, and adopted.

  • Active contributions to open-source AI frameworks, technical publications, or industry speaking engagements.

  • Familiarity with Cortex AI, Snowpark, or modern enterprise data infrastructure platforms.

WHY JOIN FRONTIER ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE?

Frontier Engineering is where Snowflake’s AI platform meets reality. You’re not building demos, you’re shipping AI applications that run in some of the world’s most complex enterprise environments. At the IC6 level, you also define the reusable architectures, engineering standards, and product feedback loops that allow these solutions to scale across customers. You will work on hard problems with real stakes, alongside engineers who are deeply technical and customer-obsessed.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Commercial Solutions Engineer - Expansion
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Commercial Solutions Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Commercial Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.

Snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago, and our biggest opportunity is also our customers' biggest challenge: migration. For every enterprise ready to harness the power of the AI Data Cloud, there lies a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. We believe Generative AI is the key — we are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications.

We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed) to sit at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. This is a unique hybrid role: you will lead a team of forward-deployed engineers who work directly with customers and partners on complex migration projects while simultaneously driving the development of AI-powered migration tools and products. Your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation — turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

AS A MANAGER, MIGRATIONS YOU WILL:

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, providing clear feedback, identifying strengths, and developing growth paths

  • Recruit, hire, and onboard future team members, setting them up for success in both customer-facing delivery and engineering contributions

  • Foster a culture of creativity, innovation, and practical decision-making across delivery and engineering work streams

  • Support engineers in their career development, growing both technical delivery leads and engineering leaders

Customer Delivery & Project Execution

  • Provide strategic oversight for migration projects, ensuring alignment with customer objectives and company goals

  • Lead teams executing complex migrations from legacy systems (Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, etc.) to the Snowflake platform

  • Act as the primary escalation point for delivery concerns, working closely with customers and system integrators

  • Maintain a hands-on presence on strategic projects, leveraging your technical expertise to assess quality and unblock teams

  • Collaborate with sales teams to scope opportunities, develop proposals, and ensure effective account strategy execution

Engineering & Product Build

  • Drive the design, development, and iteration of AI-powered migration tools and products based on real-world customer needs

  • Guide the team through an evolving AI ecosystem to build AI-first products — including code translation, developer co-pilots, and semantic validation

  • Translate field insights and customer requirements into engineering roadmap items and product improvements

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product Management organizations to align on priorities and deliver high-quality solutions

  • Encourage the development and sharing of best practices, utilities, and accelerators that streamline migrations and feed back into product

Cross-Functional Impact

  • Work with organizational leaders to influence GTM strategies, leading initiatives and improvements across Sales and Engineering

  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and cross-team learning between field engineers and product engineering teams

  • Present to both technical and executive audiences, articulating migration strategies, product vision, and business outcomes

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields (or equivalent experience)

  • 7+ years of experience in technical roles involving customer-facing delivery, engineering

  • 5+ years of people management experience — mentoring, coaching, and developing technical teams

  • 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, particularly involving AI/ML or developer tools

  • Demonstrated success leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformation projects

  • Strong foundation in databases, data warehouses, and data processing — hands-on experience with large-scale systems (Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, Greenplum, Hadoop)

  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and the complete data analytics stack (ETL, data platform design, BI/analytics tools)

  • Familiarity with data integration/transformation tools (Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion, dbt) and BI tools (Tableau, MicroStrategy, Business Objects)

  • Extensive hands-on expertise with SQL, SQL analytics, and scripting (Python, Perl, Bash)

  • Resourceful, data-driven, strong partners, and able to step in as PM, program manager, or architect when needed

  • Hiring and growing the team, technical leadership (including for staff+ engineers), driving projects from idea to production, and partnering across teams and with customers

  • Strong experience scoping engagements — developing delivery estimates, proposals, and project plans

  • Outstanding presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.



Snowflake redefined the data landscape over a decade ago, and our biggest opportunity is also our customers' biggest challenge: migration. For every enterprise ready to harness the power of the AI Data Cloud, there lies a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. We believe Generative AI is the key — we are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications.



We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed) to sit at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. This is a unique hybrid role: you will lead a team of forward-deployed engineers who work directly with customers and partners on complex migration projects while simultaneously driving the development of AI-powered migration tools and products. Your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation — turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions.



AS A MANAGER, MIGRATIONS YOU WILL:

Team Leadership & People Management

 - Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, providing clear feedback, identifying strengths, and developing growth paths

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard future team members, setting them up for success in both customer-facing delivery and engineering contributions

 - Foster a culture of creativity, innovation, and practical decision-making across delivery and engineering work streams

 - Support engineers in their career development, growing both technical delivery leads and engineering leaders

Customer Delivery & Project Execution

 - Provide strategic oversight for migration projects, ensuring alignment with customer objectives and company goals

 - Lead teams executing complex migrations from legacy systems (Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, etc.) to the Snowflake platform

 - Act as the primary escalation point for delivery concerns, working closely with customers and system integrators

 - Maintain a hands-on presence on strategic projects, leveraging your technical expertise to assess quality and unblock teams

 - Collaborate with sales teams to scope opportunities, develop proposals, and ensure effective account strategy execution

Engineering & Product Build

 - Drive the design, development, and iteration of AI-powered migration tools and products based on real-world customer needs

 - Guide the team through an evolving AI ecosystem to build AI-first products — including code translation, developer co-pilots, and semantic validation

 - Translate field insights and customer requirements into engineering roadmap items and product improvements

 - Collaborate with Engineering and Product Management organizations to align on priorities and deliver high-quality solutions

 - Encourage the development and sharing of best practices, utilities, and accelerators that streamline migrations and feed back into product

Cross-Functional Impact

 - Work with organizational leaders to influence GTM strategies, leading initiatives and improvements across Sales and Engineering

 - Facilitate knowledge sharing and cross-team learning between field engineers and product engineering teams

 - Present to both technical and executive audiences, articulating migration strategies, product vision, and business outcomes

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

 - University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields (or equivalent experience)

 - 7+ years of experience in technical roles involving customer-facing delivery, engineering

 - 5+ years of people management experience — mentoring, coaching, and developing technical teams

 - 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, particularly involving AI/ML or developer tools

 - Demonstrated success leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformation projects

 - Strong foundation in databases, data warehouses, and data processing — hands-on experience with large-scale systems (Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, Greenplum, Hadoop)

 - Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and the complete data analytics stack (ETL, data platform design, BI/analytics tools)

 - Familiarity with data integration/transformation tools (Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion, dbt) and BI tools (Tableau, MicroStrategy, Business Objects)

 - Extensive hands-on expertise with SQL, SQL analytics, and scripting (Python, Perl, Bash)

 - Resourceful, data-driven, strong partners, and able to step in as PM, program manager, or architect when needed

 - Hiring and growing the team, technical leadership (including for staff+ engineers), driving projects from idea to production, and partnering across teams and with customers

 - Strong experience scoping engagements — developing delivery estimates, proposals, and project plans

 - Outstanding presentation skills for both technical and executive audiences

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Indonesia is one of Snowflake's top-priority markets and a key new business growth engine for the ASEAN region. We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive in Jakarta who is energised by winning brand-new customers. This is a dedicated new logo role: you will inherit an early-stage pipeline across a set of active opportunities and build your own pipeline from the ground up across a portfolio of 30+ target enterprise organisations, with a supported ramp as you establish your territory.

AS AN ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own a greenfield territory focused entirely on new business, driving net-new ACV growth by bringing the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to organisations that are new to Snowflake.

  • Progress and close an inherited set of active, early-stage opportunities while building a healthy, self-generated pipeline.

  • Lead consistent, high-quality outbound prospecting into Government and State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN), Healthcare and Pharmaceuticals, Manufacturing and Consumer Goods, and Oil and Gas organisations.

  • Partner closely with Snowflake's local partner and systems integrator ecosystem to co-prospect, co-sell and accelerate greenfield opportunities.

  • Work hand in hand with Sales Development Representatives to plan account strategies, sequence outreach and convert early interest into qualified pipeline.

  • Use AI tools, including Snowflake Cortex AI capabilities, to research accounts, prioritise effort and manage your pipeline with discipline and accuracy.

  • Navigate complex enterprise and public sector buying cycles, including formal BUMN and government procurement processes, from first meeting to signed contract.

  • Collaborate with Solution Engineers to position Snowflake's platform, including Snowpark, Cortex AI, Snowflake Marketplace and data sharing, against customers' data, analytics and AI priorities.

OUR IDEAL ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 6+ years of enterprise sales experience in software, cloud or SaaS. We also welcome applicants from strong Commercial or mid-market sales backgrounds who are ready for enterprise scale.

  • A proven track record of consistently opening multiple net-new enterprise logos each year, with quota achievement driven primarily by new business

  • Experience selling into Public Sector or State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN) in Indonesia, ideally including hands-on experience with BUMN procurement processes.

  • Strong, self-sustained outbound prospecting skills, with the ability to create pipeline without relying on inbound lead flow.

  • The organisation and focus to manage a broad portfolio of 30+ accounts at once.

  • Resilience and drive to build a territory from the ground up.

  • Professional fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Sales experience in other complex industries such as Telecommunications or Banking and Financial Services.

  • Established relationships with local partners, systems integrators or resellers in Indonesia.

  • Experience selling data platforms, analytics, cloud infrastructure or AI solutions.

  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape Snowflake's growth in one of our most important markets. You will have the backing of a supportive leadership team, local partners and SDRs, and the chance to put your name on some of the most significant new customer wins in Indonesia.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer — Engineering Systems, Continuous Integration
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About Snowflake

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the infrastructure, tools, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake’s engineering organization. As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will help define the technical direction of critical CI infrastructure used by thousands of engineers across a rapidly growing, multi-cloud codebase.

As a Staff Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of large-scale Continuous Integration services and infrastructure.

  • Design, build, and operate distributed systems that support reliable, performant, and secure software delivery.

  • Lead the development of CI capabilities that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and release velocity.

  • Partner with engineering leadership, product managers, and teams across Snowflake to define quarterly and long-term technical roadmaps.

  • Drive architectural decisions across build systems, test orchestration, resource scheduling, workflow execution, and developer tooling.

  • Identify systemic bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and develop solutions that improve engineering efficiency at scale.

  • Establish high standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Lead complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices to keep Snowflake’s developer platform scalable and effective.

Our Ideal Staff Software Engineer Will Have

  • 7+ years of industry experience designing and building production software systems.

  • A track record of technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.

  • Deep experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

  • Experience building or significantly evolving enterprise-grade Continuous Integration or Continuous Delivery systems.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

  • Experience making architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.

  • A strong understanding of developer productivity and the software development lifecycle.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

  • A collaborative mindset and a demonstrated ability to mentor and influence engineers across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CI/CD and build systems such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bazel, ArgoCD, or comparable platforms.

  • Experience with build optimization, caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, or distributed test scheduling.

  • Experience designing multi-tenant systems with strong isolation, reliability, performance, and security requirements.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience operating large-scale developer platforms or engineering infrastructure.

  • Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and production operations.

  • Experience authoring technical roadmaps, architecture documents, project plans, postmortems, and root-cause analyses.

  • Experience working with data systems, distributed storage, or cloud-based services.

  • A history of improving engineering practices and multiplying the effectiveness of teams.

Why Engineering Systems at Snowflake?

  • Build infrastructure that thousands of Snowflake engineers rely on every day.

  • Solve challenging distributed systems and developer productivity problems at significant scale.

  • Help improve the speed, reliability, and quality of software delivery across Snowflake.

  • Work with experienced engineers across a multi-cloud data platform.

  • Influence the technical direction of critical engineering infrastructure.

  • Grow your impact through architecture, mentorship, and cross-team technical leadership.

Compensation

Snowflake is committed to pay equity and transparency. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

For the US-Market 1 location band, the compensation range for this role is:

  • Base salary: $236,000–$354,000 USD

  • Target bonus: 15%

  • Total target compensation: $271,400–$407,100 USD

  • Equity: Eligible for an RSU grant in addition to base salary and bonus

Snowflake also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), ESPP, paid time off, parental leave, disability coverage, and company-paid life insurance.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s responsibility to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Startup Business Development Lead EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Role Overview

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. We are looking for AI-native builders and operators who use AI as a core part of how they think, learn, and execute.

The Startup Business Development Lead will be a key member of the Snowflake for Startups team, responsible for identifying, engaging, and growing relationships with the most strategic AI-native startups. This person will work across Sales, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, Ventures, and Solutions Engineering to help high-potential startups build with Snowflake and accelerate adoption of Snowflake AI.

This role requires a rare combination of startup ecosystem credibility, business development judgment, and practical understanding of modern AI application architectures. The ideal candidate can engage founders on both business value and technical direction, and can translate Snowflake’s AI platform into compelling growth opportunities for startup partners.

This is an individual contributor role and will be accountable for building a high-quality pipeline of AI-native startup opportunities, increasing activation and adoption of Snowflake AI products, and driving long-term consumption growth from strategic startup partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and grow relationships with high-priority AI-native startups, founders, venture investors, and ecosystem partners .

  • Develop and execute a startup GTM strategy to accelerate adoption of Snowflake with a heavy emphasis on Snowflakes AI products.

  • Serve as a trusted voice on AI-native startup trends, including model usage, data infrastructure, agentic workflows, and enterprise adoption patterns.

  • Help founders understand how to build and scale AI applications with Snowflake, including Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Document AI, Snowpark ML, and related platform capabilities.

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, and Snowflake Ventures to drive coordinated startup acquisition and expansion motions.

  • Create repeatable programs, founder engagements, and ecosystem initiatives that increase startup pipeline, product adoption, and workload growth.

  • Prioritize the startup landscape based on strategic fit, technical relevance, market momentum, and potential for long-term Snowflake consumption.

  • Track business outcomes, surface market insights, and provide regular recommendations to improve strategy, coverage, and execution.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, startup programs, venture, GTM, cloud, AI/ML, or related fields.

  • Experience working with high-growth startups, including founder engagement and cross-functional partnership execution.

  • Strong understanding of the modern AI stack, including LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, model serving, and data infrastructure.

  • Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into clear business value for founders, builders, and executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop partnership strategies, scale programs, and drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Strong executive communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

  • High comfort operating in ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution, and prioritizing in a fast-changing market.

  • Data-driven operating style with experience using metrics to evaluate opportunities, influence decisions, and improve execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the AI-native startup ecosystem as a founder, operator, investor, or partner leader.

  • Strong familiarity with enterprise AI application patterns such as RAG, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, governance, and model optimization.

  • Working knowledge of the Snowflake AI stack, especially Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Document AI, Snowpark ML, and AI Data Cloud adoption patterns.

  • Experience helping technical startups refine enterprise positioning, GTM motions, and customer adoption strategy.

Reports to

Head of Snowflake Startups,

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months

  • Built trusted relationships with a high-priority set of AI-native startups, key VC firms, and ecosystem partners. .

  • Increased startup adoption of Snowflake AI and expanded the pipeline of AI-native workloads built on Snowflake.

  • Established repeatable founder engagement and ecosystem programs that generate measurable startup pipeline and consumption growth.

  • Improved internal alignment across Sales, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, Ventures, and Solutions Engineering around the startup strategy.

  • Brought clear market intelligence and actionable recommendations on where Snowflake should invest to win with AI-native startups.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

This role requires a rare combination of startup ecosystem credibility, business development judgment, and practical understanding of modern AI application architectures. The ideal candidate can engage founders on both business value and technical direction, and can translate Snowflake’s AI platform into compelling growth opportunities for startup partners.

This is an individual contributor role and will be accountable for building a high-quality pipeline of AI-native startup opportunities, increasing activation and adoption of Snowflake AI products, and driving long-term consumption growth from strategic startup partners.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and grow relationships with high-priority AI-native startups, founders, venture investors, and ecosystem partners .

 - Develop and execute a startup GTM strategy to accelerate adoption of Snowflake with a heavy emphasis on Snowflakes AI products.

 - Serve as a trusted voice on AI-native startup trends, including model usage, data infrastructure, agentic workflows, and enterprise adoption patterns.

 - Help founders understand how to build and scale AI applications with Snowflake, including Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Document AI, Snowpark ML, and related platform capabilities.

 - Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, and Snowflake Ventures to drive coordinated startup acquisition and expansion motions.

 - Create repeatable programs, founder engagements, and ecosystem initiatives that increase startup pipeline, product adoption, and workload growth.

 - Prioritize the startup landscape based on strategic fit, technical relevance, market momentum, and potential for long-term Snowflake consumption.

 - Track business outcomes, surface market insights, and provide regular recommendations to improve strategy, coverage, and execution.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, startup programs, venture, GTM, cloud, AI/ML, or related fields.

 - Experience working with high-growth startups, including founder engagement and cross-functional partnership execution.

 - Strong understanding of the modern AI stack, including LLM-powered applications, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, model serving, and data infrastructure.

 - Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into clear business value for founders, builders, and executive stakeholders.

 - Demonstrated ability to develop partnership strategies, scale programs, and drive measurable business outcomes.

 - Strong executive communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.

 - High comfort operating in ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution, and prioritizing in a fast-changing market.

 - Data-driven operating style with experience using metrics to evaluate opportunities, influence decisions, and improve execution.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in the AI-native startup ecosystem as a founder, operator, investor, or partner leader.

 - Strong familiarity with enterprise AI application patterns such as RAG, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, governance, and model optimization.

 - Working knowledge of the Snowflake AI stack, especially Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Document AI, Snowpark ML, and AI Data Cloud adoption patterns.

 - Experience helping technical startups refine enterprise positioning, GTM motions, and customer adoption strategy.

Reports to

Head of Snowflake Startups,




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 12 MONTHS

 - Built trusted relationships with a high-priority set of AI-native startups, key VC firms, and ecosystem partners. .

 - Increased startup adoption of Snowflake AI and expanded the pipeline of AI-native workloads built on Snowflake.

 - Established repeatable founder engagement and ecosystem programs that generate measurable startup pipeline and consumption growth.

 - Improved internal alignment across Sales, Product, Marketing, AI Partnerships, Ventures, and Solutions Engineering around the startup strategy.

 - Brought clear market intelligence and actionable recommendations on where Snowflake should invest to win with AI-native startups.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


Why Join Us? What We Offer

We cultivate an inclusive, welcoming, and empowering environment where every intern is set up for success from day one:

  • Dedicated Mentorship & Support: High level of access to your manager and a personal mentor who provide guidance, constructive feedback, and continuous support without micromanagement.

  • Real Impact & Ownership: Work alongside world-class experts on meaningful, real-world projects that contribute directly to systems used by global customers.

  • Inclusive Culture & Flexibility: Work in a vibrant team with flexible working hours, work-from-home options, casual dress code, and an inclusive, community-focused startup culture.

  • Career Growth: Clear pathways for post-internship career opportunities, including full-time roles and additional internship options.

  • Perks & Community: Paid full-time internship, catered lunches, team outings, happy hours, access to gaming consoles, recreational games, employee resource groups, and great swag.

What You Will Learn & Gain

  • How to build enterprise-grade, reliable, and secure cloud software and services.

  • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge database internals, large-scale distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Practical knowledge in compiler design, query execution, streaming pipelines, and advanced SQL features.

  • Colleague mentorship and collaborative problem-solving experience in a modern tech stack (C++, Java).


What We Are Looking For

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university program during the time of the internship (from 3rd year Bachelor up to Master’s or PhD levels) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Physics, Math, or a related technical field.

  • Duration: 4 month minimum, 6 months recommended, up to 12 months supported, start date flexible

  • Target start dates: February 2027 and onward

  • Foundational knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and operating systems.

  • Programming experience in C++ or Java, and familiarity with systems programming concepts (e.g., multi-threading, concurrency).

  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and solve problems creatively.

  • Fluent written and spoken English skills.

  • Required to work from designated office full time

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have, Not Required):

  • Coursework or familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, cloud computing, or compilers.

  • Experience or interest in big data engineering, data processing, or geospatial features.

  • Contributions to open-source projects, research experience, or publications in databases/distributed systems.

jobs.title: Associate Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Associate Solutions Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Associate Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Observability
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is a high-growth SaaS observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, enabling businesses to troubleshoot modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the Snowflake platform. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high-visibility, high-impact projects within Observe by Snowflake, our observability platform built for modern data-driven organizations. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability, and remain open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team is deeply curious, always learning, and continuously pushing the boundaries of how customers gain insight from their data to operate more effectively.

 

AS AN ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, OBSERVE BY SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Become an expert on the Observe platform and its integration with Snowflake, conducting discovery calls, tailored demos, and presentations for prospective customers focused on observability, monitoring, and data-driven operations

  • Act as a trusted advisor by understanding customers’ existing and future data, infrastructure, and observability strategies, positioning Observe as a critical component of their modern data stack

  • Qualify prospects and develop new sales opportunities, while building and maintaining a strong pipeline of recurring revenue

  • Drive full-cycle sales motions—land, adopt, expand, and deepen relationships with accounts in your region

  • Achieve and exceed sales quotas on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a strategic territory plan, target account list, and regional go-to-market approach

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales engineering, product, professional services, marketing, legal, and finance teams to deliver value-driven solutions

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 6+ years of Enterprise sales experience with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding quotas, selling technical solutions and enterprise software products

  • Experience executing complex enterprise sales strategies within observability, monitoring, DevOps, infrastructure, data platforms, or adjacent spaces such as Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, or AI/ML

  • A solution-oriented sales approach, with experience managing long, complex sales cycles and strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills

  • The ability to operate like an owner—building the business, defining and executing sales strategies, and leveraging ecosystem, partner, and go-to-market knowledge to drive results

  • A commitment to providing open, honest, and respectful feedback while contributing to an inclusive and high-performing team culture

  • A reputation for “Making Each Other Better,” demonstrated through strong internal collaboration and long-standing cross-functional relationships

  • Proven ability to independently prospect, develop, and close new enterprise client relationships

  • Experience consistently achieving multi-million dollar annual revenue targets

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

How do you want to make your impact?

About the role

We are looking for a Demand Generation Manager to lead integrated marketing campaigns that drive acquisition and adoption initiatives for the Snowflake platform. You will own and execute campaigns that include: thought-leadership, virtual events/webinars, virtual labs, web experiences and more; and deliver tailored marketing messages to key personas, in alignment with business objectives.

You will own integrated marketing campaigns end-to-end: driving strategy, execution, and optimization to maximize growth in alignment with EMEA strategic business priorities. This is a highly collaborative role, working closely with Product Marketing, ABM, Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Field Marketing and Sales Development to deliver high-impact programs.

This role lands well for an AI-native, results-oriented marketer who thinks big and uses data-driven insights to shape the future of growth marketing at Snowflake.

This role is based out of Snowflake’s London office.

What you’ll do:

  • Integrated Marketing Campaign Ownership: Own and lead EMEA Demand Generation Plan for the Snowflake Platform product areas from awareness to pipeline. Build campaigns that attract our target ICP and convert prospect interest into qualified meetings and sales opportunities.

  • Campaign Management: Execute and optimise multi-channel demand generation campaigns, including webinars and hands-on labs, email marketing, content marketing, social media and paid advertising

  • Reporting and Performance Analysis: Use performance data and marketing insights to optimize channel mix, conversion rates, and ROI.

  • Implement structured testing methodologies to increase the demand generation processes and impact. Share insights to guide Growth Marketing best practices and develop new ways to accelerate the team’s results.


What you’ll have:

  • Minimum 3-5 years developing & executing integrated marketing campaigns.

  • Experience in planning, promoting, and executing high-impact webinars tailored to enterprise prospects, including collaboration with subject matter experts to ensure relevant content and audience engagement.

  • Strong project management and hands-on execution skills, with a focus on metrics and details driven accuracy.

  • Ability to craft compelling and persuasive content for a variety of formats including emails, landing pages, ad copy, and thought leadership content.

  • Highly collaborative, with a natural ability to align multiple marketing, product and sales functions and global/regional stakeholders in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Expertise in data storytelling and executing across channels to create a customer-focused experience.

  • Experience with martech tools for running campaigns (e.g. Marketo, Salesforce, ON24, AEM)

  • Experience implementing AI capabilities for demand generation workflows, that accelerate conversion and unlock new growth opportunities.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with B2B SaaS marketing

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Foundation DB
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

There is only one Data Cloud. Snowflake’s founders started from scratch and designed a data platform built for the cloud that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. But it didn’t stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

FoundationDB (FDB) is an open source, highly scalable database capable of ACID transactions at high frequencies and low latencies. FDB has been a core component in Snowflake's unique shared-metadata architecture since 2014, making possible Snowflake's vision to build the greatest data warehouse for the cloud. FDB performs millions of transactions per second across thousands of processes. The FDB team builds features on open-source FDB that improve the performance, scale, reliability and operability of the product.

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Software Engineer with a passion for large scale databases and distributed systems to help us take FoundationDB to the next level. FoundationDB powers all of Snowflake’s products and services and is rapidly evolving to meet Snowflake’s future needs. We are growing at a fast rate and we need to scale FoundationDB by at least one order of magnitude over the next few years. Additionally, new workloads are emerging that need FoundationDB’s reliability, high availability and strong consistency semantics. These workloads will require innovation to re-architect the core components of our system.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Identify strategically important problems, inefficiencies or opportunities for impactful improvements

  • Own the end to end delivery of your projects, from identifying a solution, to design, implementation, test and safe production rollout

  • Design and implement critical high performance systems to handle the ever growing request rate of our database

  • Build the next generation transaction system, caching, storage engine and multi tenant capabilities

  • Evangelize best practices in database usage and end-to-end architecture.

  • Analyze and understand performance and scalability bottlenecks in the system and solve them.

  • Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 6+ years hands-on software engineering experience.

  • Systems programming skills including multi-threading, concurrency, etc. Fluency in C++, C, or Java is preferred.

  • Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or web services

  • Experience with scalable Key-Value stores such as FoundationDB, RocksDB/LevelDB, DynamoDB, Redis, etc. a plus.

  • Strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Track record of delivering highly complex projects in the distributed systems space

  • Intense curiosity, willingness to question and passion for making systems better

  • Strong technical problem solving, communication, and collaboration skills

  • Excitement by the challenge of hard technical problems

  • BS in Computer Science; Masters or PhD Preferred.

Snowflake SIGMOD 2016 paper

FDB SIGMOD 21 Paper

FoundationDB Summit 2018 and FoundationDB Summit 2019
