jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

We're looking for a talented and motivated Software Engineer to join the Cortex AI Functions Platform team. AI functions are how Snowflake customers call AI directly from SQL, running models over their own tables without moving data out of the platform. Our team builds the platform that makes this work at data warehouse scale, where a single statement can expand into a large volume of inference requests that must complete predictably, within expected cost, and without compromising the query when a dependency degrades or fails.

Current projects include a new architecture for multi-modal inference, quality gates that let us ship new functions and models with confidence at batch scale, and support for input data beyond plain text. Alongside these, we work continuously on throughput, cost and reliability as customer usage grows, and on making failures in the inference path easier to detect, diagnose and recover from.

For this role, you don’t need to have a research background, including pre-training or fine-tuning models.

 

Your journey as a Software Engineer

Working in our team you will:

  • Think creatively to find optimal solutions to our complex, often ambiguous problems

  • Participate in all stages of building and running the platform behind Snowflake’s AI functions, from design and implementation through rollout and production support

  • Work closely with research teams, as well as product and engineering partners, to understand and shape the short and long-term product development strategy

  • Serve as a mentor to less experienced engineers

Ideal candidate

  • 4+ years of experience building production backend or distributed systems in C++, Java, Go, Python, or a comparable language

  • BSc in a technical field (CS, EE, Physics, Math, etc), MSc/PhD is a plus

  • Experience designing and operating high-throughput services, including handling concurrency, backpressure, partial failures, and observability

  • Experience designing service or RPC APIs, such as REST or gRPC

  • Experience with software engineering best practices (programming, testing, version control, CI/CD, containers, agile development, etc)

  • Experience with building distributed systems that guarantee high throughput without compromising on reliability

  • High levels of curiosity and eager enthusiasm for open-ended problems, and the ability to turn a loosely defined problem into a scoped, testable design

  • Ability to articulate results and complex concepts to leadership

  • Must be able to produce solutions independently in an organized manner, as well as work in a team

  • Experience with SQL engines, query execution, or other large-scale data systems is a strong asset

  • Hands-on experience in the MLOps field (e.g., deploying ML models) is a plus

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Cloud Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Cloud Support Engineer (CSE)

Snowflake seeks early-career Cloud Support Engineers who combine technical expertise, customer empathy, and an AI-first mindset. You'll leverage and refine AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, improve knowledge bases, and reduce time to resolution—safely and responsibly. Experience in 24x7 technical support, escalation handling, on-call rotations, and incident management is ideal.

 

Key Responsibilities:

As a Cloud Support Engineer, you manage customer cases and are accountable for accelerating their time-to-resolution, ensuring platform stability, and driving a world-class support experience. Operating as a full-stack technical support resource, this role blends deep hands-on troubleshooting with the customer empathy and communication skills of a trusted advisor.

Customer Value and Incident Ownership

  • Own the Customer Experience: Manage customer issues from initial triage through resolution and follow-up, ensuring clear communication and timely updates.

  • Deliver Support Value with AI: Leverage AI assistants and diagnostics to accelerate triage and root-cause analysis while maintaining accuracy and safety standards.

  • Outcome-Based Support: Focus on business impact, ensuring resolutions fix issues, reduce recurrence, and improve reliability.

  • Customer Empathy and Communication: Provide technical analysis and guidance via email, web, and phone, adapting to customer expertise levels.

Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • AI-Assisted Triage: Use AI to summarize logs, generate hypotheses, and draft responses—critically validating outputs before sharing.

  • Tooling Expertise: Utilize Snowflake environment, connectors, and internal tools to investigate and test solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to resolve systemic issues.

  • Knowledge Management: Document solutions in knowledge bases, refining AI-assisted drafts for quality.

  • Feedback and Innovation: Provide input on product behavior, documentation gaps, and AI-tool performance.

  • Bug Reporting: Document and collaborate on bugs and feature requests with engineering teams.

  • Operational Coverage: Support holiday/weekend rotations and on-call requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • 2+ years in technical support (customer-facing, ideally 24x7).

  • Strong AI fluency, including prompt engineering, context management, and the ability to critically validate AI outputs and know when to fall back to manual investigation.

  • Experience with AI-powered tooling (e.g., coding assistants/agentic IDEs) and modern support environments.

  • Solid technical troubleshooting skills, including comfort with SQL, log analysis, and scripting/automation (e.g., Python, APIs, workflow tools) to diagnose issues and streamline tasks.SQL, log analysis, and scripting skills (Python, APIs).

  • Strong written/verbal English communication.

  • Basic understanding of Windows and Linux Operating Systems.

  • Basic understanding of Data Warehousing fundamentals and concepts.

  • Ability to write and understand basic SQL queries

  • Familiarity with end-to-end ML pipeline including ML modeling, feature engineering, ML model training, etc.

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, and associated tools within the LLM ecosystem, including Langchain, vector databases, co-pilot, and open-source Hugging Face models.

  • Being able to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to MLOps pipelines, model performance, and infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and web services

Preferred:

  • Snowflake or cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Advance Workflow automation / CI/CD tooling experience

  • AI-powered support or SRE workflow experience

  • Relevant certifications (SnowPro, cloud certs)

  • Knowledge about GPUs, CUDA, and low-level optimizations will be a plus.

  • Experience developing CI/CD components for production-ready MLOps pipelines.

  • Location: Bellevue, WA or Dublin, CA

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Staff Escalation Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Escalation Manager

Our Staff Escalation Manager reviews automatic and manual escalation nominations and can quickly assess the viability of the escalation request. They can strike the proper balance between serving customers' needs and being Snowflake ambassadors. They assemble multiple data points from different systems to create an overall picture of the customer’s current situation.

A Staff Escalation Manager relies heavily on reporting and analysis to translate the overall customer situation into a consumable view for management.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Work on non-routine problems that require techniques for which solutions are not always established

  • Work within defined processes and helps determine the appropriate approach for new
    issue types

  • Work independently with almost no supervision on day-to-day operations

  • Prioritize tasks to manage their escalation queue effectively, rarely requiring input from their managers

  • Serve as a mentor to junior staff on escalation practices; however, has no direct supervisory responsibilities

  • Optimize AI-assisted workflows for escalation management, refining prompt strategies and tooling to improve team efficiency and output quality

In this role, you will:

  • Own medium to high complexity cases and account escalations that may require a higher technical aptitude

  • Work independently to define strategies for addressing highly complex escalations

  • Leverage data from escalation models to drive and influence action on escalations

  • Use AI tools independently to aggregate multi-source data, identify escalation patterns, and accelerate root-cause analysis, serving as a resource for peers on effective AI usage

  • Suggest improvements to the overall escalation process and methodology

  • Lead escalations for highly visible customers, including those nominated by senior leadership

  • Able to prioritize and manage multiple highly visible escalations, keeping all parties updated on progress regularly

  • Drive internal team alignment in preparation for customer meetings

  • Drive consensus from all necessary internal resources at the appropriate level before making commitments on behalf of Snowflake

  • Expertly navigates the right teams using the appropriate channels to create the action plan

  • Ability to influence resources across cross-functional teams involved in handling the escalation

  • Ability to take a big-picture approach to determine the root cause of escalations to ensure an adequate long-term solution is provided

  • Work independently across the org to create, polish, and send customer-facing post-mortems/RCAs based on the specifics of the escalation

Customer Advocacy:

  • Demonstrate strong escalation management practices to address customer issues for the long term

  • Provide guidance and mentorship in quality escalation management to team members

  • Present the Global Escalation program, process, and principles to an internal and external audience

  • Continuously monitor and keep a pulse on the customer's temperature

  • Demonstrate heightened awareness of the overall customer situation, how the customer responds to progress updates, and pivot approach as needed to drive customer satisfaction

Team Player and Community:

  • Proactively help others

  • Develop expertise in others

  • Cool under challenging situations; holds things together in tough times

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and making difficult decisions

  • Embody Snowflake Values, acting as a role model to more junior team members

  • Participate in the hiring process as a key interviewer and demonstrates the ability to assess the skills and potential of interview candidates accurately

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior User Researcher
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As a Senior User Researcher at Snowflake, you’ll shape what we build and how customers experience it. You’ll work alongside product, design, engineering, and marketing leads to set priorities, make tough calls, and bring ideas to market. Your deep understanding of customer needs and business goals will make you a trusted partner in those decisions.

This role calls for deep research craft, strong business judgment, and fluency with AI. You’ll know when to move quickly, when to dig deeper, and how to turn what you learn into better outcomes for Snowflake’s customers.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with product, design, engineering, and marketing leads to set priorities that make a meaningful difference for Snowflake’s customers.

  • Become an expert on your customers’ needs and goals, your product area, and the business objectives your team is working toward.

  • Lead qualitative and quantitative research, choosing the methods and level of rigor each decision demands.

  • Make product and go-to-market decisions alongside your partners. Work through tradeoffs, build alignment, and carry decisions through launch and adoption.

  • Combine customer research, product usage data, and prior findings to identify opportunities and understand what needs to change.

  • Identify where AI can strengthen your research, apply it deliberately, and hold the results to a high standard.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of industry user research experience, with examples of decisions that changed because of your work and the customer or business outcomes that followed.

  • Deep experience across qualitative and quantitative methods. You can explain how you chose an approach, what its limits were, and why the evidence was sufficient for the decision.

  • A track record of earning the trust of cross-functional leads and working with them through difficult product or go-to-market tradeoffs.

  • Experience connecting customer needs to product and business goals, including identifying opportunities that weren’t apparent from the initial question.

  • Experience using product usage data alongside primary research to reach a more complete understanding of a problem.

  • Examples of AI applications you’ve put into practice in your research work—and the judgment you used to decide where they belonged.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist, Campaign Automation & AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is seeking a Senior Marketing Operations Specialist to rethink how campaigns get done. You already understand how campaign operations work: intake, program build, QA, launch and reporting. You will take that knowledge, study where it breaks down, and redesign it using agents, dashboards, automation and purpose-built apps.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a builder's mindset. You will start by understanding what Snowflake has already built, including Marketo programs and templates, intake processes, Wrike workflows and reporting, then interview the stakeholders who depend on them. From there, you will design and deliver a better operating model for campaign execution. You will build much of it yourself and partner with Marketing Technology, Marketing Intelligence and regional teams to scale it.

The ideal candidate is a strong Marketo practitioner who thinks in systems, asks why a process exists before changing it, and is comfortable replacing manual steps with tools that work reliably at scale.

YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:
3+ years in marketing operations, campaign operations or marketing automation, with deep experience running campaign programs end to end.
Hands-on Marketo program and architecture experience, including program structure, smart campaigns and lists, tokens and templates.
Working knowledge of how campaign operations work across intake, planning, build, QA, launch and reporting, and an understanding of where these processes typically slow down.
Experience managing campaign membership, lifecycle stages, segmentation, suppression, consent and lead routing across systems.
Experience using AI tools or agents to automate or accelerate operational work, with results you can describe.
Able to write clear prompts and supply the right context so an AI tool returns useful results.
Basic database and data-model awareness, including how marketing data is organized across CRM, marketing automation and campaign systems.
Able to evaluate AI output, catch errors or unsupported conclusions, and validate findings against source systems.
Strong facilitation, documentation and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders who are not in your reporting line.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:
Map current operations and stakeholder needs: Review how Snowflake plans, builds, launches and reports on campaigns today, including Marketo programs, templates, intake, Wrike workflows and dashboards. Interview campaign managers, regional and field marketing, sales operations and marketing intelligence to find friction, workarounds and priorities.

Reimagine the workflow: Design a future-state campaign operating model that uses agents, dashboards, automation and apps to replace manual steps. Examples include agent-assisted intake, automated campaign setup from approved templates, self-service status and performance dashboards, and automated QA checks for audiences, tokens, links and suppression.

Build and deliver: Build workflows and automations in Marketo, Salesforce and the broader martech stack, and pilot them with a small group of users before scaling. Partner with Marketing Intelligence, Sales Operations, Marketing Technology and IT to align the design with enterprise data and systems. Own the documentation, controls and training needed for adoption.

Keep campaigns running: Support in-flight email, webinar, event, nurture and integrated programs while the new model rolls out, so campaign delivery stays reliable.

Measure and iterate: Track cycle time, rework, error rate, self-service adoption and stakeholder satisfaction, and improve the design based on the results.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Fluency in funnel reporting, lead routing and lead scoring, including how lifecycle stages, routing rules and scores affect campaign follow-up.
Fluency in Salesforce campaigns, including campaign hierarchy, member statuses, and how campaign membership relates to Marketo program membership and lead or contact records.
Working knowledge of SQL for exploring marketing data.
Experience with Workato, Zapier, Tray.io or another workflow platform.
Experience building or piloting AI agents or LLM-based workflows with a measured outcome.
Experience building dashboards or lightweight internal apps that operations teams use.
Familiarity with attribution, ABM or intent data.
Experience with Wrike, Asana or another work-management platform.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:
First 30 days: Map current campaign operations, complete the first round of stakeholder interviews, and identify the highest-friction handoffs.
First 60 days: Publish a future-state workflow design with requirements, priorities and success metrics, and secure stakeholder alignment on the first two or three changes.
First 90 days: Launch a pilot that replaces a manual campaign process with an agent, automation, dashboard or app, and show measurable improvement in cycle time, rework or self-service adoption.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, building the world’s greatest data, applications and AI/ML platform. Our get it done culture empowers everyone at Snowflake to innovate, create work with lasting impact, and thrive in a collaborative environment.

Snowflake EMEA product marketers conceive of and execute go-to-market plans that drive awareness, adoption and drive success for our customers. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to build messaging and positioning around Data and AI Sovereignty in EMEA, execute targeted go-to-market strategy for the Public Sector, scale our impact through Snowflake’s partner ecosystem, and maintain momentum behind key regional sovereignty partnerships.

This is a highly cross-functional role, working closely with Account Teams, Field Marketing, Technical Sales, ABM, Partner Marketing, Demand Generation, and Global Product Marketing to align strategy with execution. The successful candidate will thrive on GTM orchestration, partner co-marketing, field enablement, and navigating complex regulatory and public sector buying landscapes.

This role is based out of Snowflake’s London office.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and align messaging and positioning for Data and AI Sovereignty in the EMEA region, ensuring Snowflake’s narrative addresses sovereign control, regulatory compliance, operational autonomy, and cloud resilience

  • Scale sovereignty messaging and regional reach through Snowflake’s cloud, systems integrator, and specialized partner ecosystem, orchestrating joint GTM motions and co-marketing programs that drive pipeline impact

  • Maintain and accelerate momentum around recent strategic sovereignty partnerships, converting key alliance milestones into high-impact sales plays, field enablement assets, and customer-facing collateral

  • Lead targeted campaigns on Data and AI Sovereignty in key markets based on local nuances, such as Digital Trust, Greater Local Control, and Data Residency with Global Innovation

  • Develop regional GTM strategy and execution for the Public Sector, designing targeted campaigns tailored to specific government departments, public institutions, and regulated markets

  • Enable field sales and technical teams at scale on sovereignty frameworks, public sector compliance requirements, procurement pathways, and competitive differentiation

  • Lead cross-functional working groups with ABM, Demand Generation and other Marketing teams to run high-touch campaigns against key public sector targets

  • Amplify the EMEA voice by synthesizing customer feedback, regulatory trends, and field insights to shape global product roadmaps, GTM priorities, and core messaging

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, solutions marketing, or GTM strategy within data, cloud, or enterprise software, specifically supporting Public Sector or highly regulated industries

  • Domain knowledge of Public Sector procurement dynamics, government compliance standards, and Data/AI Sovereignty requirements across EMEA (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR, national sovereignty frameworks)

  • Proven track record of developing and scaling joint GTM programs, partner co-marketing initiatives, and ecosystem alliances

  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate cross-functional, account-based campaigns targeting public sector institutions and government bodies

  • Excellent communication and storytelling abilities, with a strong talent for translating complex regulatory, governance, and architectural concepts into compelling narratives

  • Strong collaboration and influence skills, aligning global product strategy with localized EMEA market needs

  • Commitment to being a culture champion who builds trust, collaboration and inclusivity across functions and regions

  • An analytical, data-driven mindset focused on measuring campaign effectiveness, pipeline impact, and account engagement

  • BS/BA degree preferred

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time

Snowflake is scaling fast in EMEA, and we need builders who can think strategically and execute with urgency. If you are energised by building market positioning, driving public sector transformation, collaborating across partner ecosystems, and amplifying the voice of the region to shape global impact, we’d love to meet you.

How will you orchestrate impact at Snowflake?

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer (Expansion)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Senior Solution Engineer (Expansion Patch)

As a Senior Solution Engineer, you will be a strategic technical leader for Snowflake’s existing enterprise customers in Singapore, with a primary focus on Financial Services (FSI) and Digital Native sectors.

You will partner closely with Account Executives to drive adoption, workload expansion, and multi‑line-of-business growth across your accounts. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior technical and business stakeholders, guiding them on how to use Snowflake as the core of their data, analytics, and AI strategy.

This is a field-facing, customer-first role that combines deep technical skills, strong industry context , and the ability to design and communicate high‑impact architectures.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Drive Adoption in Existing Accounts

  • Own the technical expansion strategy for a portfolio of Snowflake customers in Singapore.

  • Identify and map customer business objectives to workloads, use cases, and lines of business that will benefit from Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

Solution Design, Demos & POCs

  • Design and deliver compelling demos and technical narratives tailored to each customer’s architecture and use cases.

  • Lead and execute POCs/Pilots that prove value and de‑risk platform decisions, including success criteria definition and joint execution plans.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value and ROI for senior non-technical audiences.

Cross-Functional & Partner Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Partners to ensure successful customer outcomes.

  • Work with SI, ISV, and cloud partners to incorporate their solutions into customer architectures where relevant.

  • Capture and relay field feedback to Product and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities.

Thought Leadership & Evangelism

  • Represent Snowflake at customer workshops, executive briefings, industry events, and community meetups.

  • Create and share technical content (presentations, reference architectures, playbooks, demos).

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Extensive 10 years working experience in customer facing solution engineering role

  • Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science, Gen AI and Data Apps

  • Open Data Architecture Mastery: Proven experience implementing or migrating architectures to Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi. Solid understanding of object storage optimization (Parquet/ORC layouts) and catalog management (Project Nessie, Polaris, Hive Metastore).

  • Data Engineering Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Extensive experience with distributed compute frameworks (Apache Spark, PySpark) and modern data stack tools like dbt.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience architecting data solutions within major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), specifically around networking and security .

  • Excellent ability to present to both technical and executive audiences, whether through impromptu whiteboarding or structured presentations and demos.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Team

Snowflake engineering takes pride in building highly reliable and scalable products.In the era of autonomous AI agents and continuous deployment, a traditional testing model breaks down under massive PR volume. Our AI pilled engineers treat validation as a scalable, developer-first platform. The Release Validation Team builds test frameworks that make continuous deployment safe, cost-efficient, and agent-friendly. Our customers are Snowflake engineers and their army of agents. How do Snowflake engineers keep their agents running autonomous for hours and days, landing quality PRs with human interventions? They rely on layers of validation that agents can execute in high-fidelity production simulation.

We give Snowflake the confidence to ship at speed without compromising Snowflake’s core brand promise: extreme reliability.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and grow the team. Hire, mentor, and develop engineers working on test infrastructure, automation, and developer tooling. Build a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and focus on the customer.

  • Set strategy and roadmap. Define and drive the multi-quarter vision for release validation: faster signals, fewer blockers, better test quality, and lower cost.

  • Own the validation platform. Be accountable for the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of our distributed regression and workload test frameworks, pre-production environments, and release validation pipeline..

  • Improve test health across the company. Work with feature teams to reduce flaky, non-hermetic, duplicate, and low-value tests, and set standards and incentives that keep them healthy.

  • Cut down release blockers. Lead efforts to improve how failures are traced to their cause, filter out noise from infrastructure problems, and speed up triage so real regressions reach the owning team quickly.

  • Drive AI and automation. Invest in AI-driven failure analysis and automated routing that remove manual work for engineers across Snowflake.

  • Work across teams. Act as the main partner to Release Engineering and engineering leaders on release quality

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience hiring, coaching, and developing engineers at different career stages.

  • Experience building and running large-scale CI/CD, test infrastructure, or developer productivity platforms, ideally for complex distributed systems.

  • A strong technical background, with enough depth to review designs, make architecture tradeoffs, and earn the respect of senior engineers.

  • A solid grasp of test strategy: regression vs. workload testing, hermeticity, flakiness, coverage tradeoffs, and release gating.

  • Experience driving work across many teams and influencing without authority.

  • A data-driven leadership style: you set measurable goals and use metrics to prioritize and show impact.

  • Strong communication skills, including explaining complex technical tradeoffs to both engineers and executives.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer 2 - OLTP
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Principal Software Engineer 2 - OLTP

Snowflake is building the next generation of transactional systems for applications, AI and agents. Across Snowflake Postgres and Unistore, we are combining the performance, reliability and developer experience expected from modern operational databases with Snowflake's cloud-native architecture and governed data platform.

We're looking for a Principal Engineer 2 to help define and drive the architecture across database internals, storage, compute and cloud infrastructure. A core part of the role is designing transactional systems for agent-driven workloads, where isolated state, rapid database lifecycle, safe autonomous operations, and deep integration with enterprise data are first-class requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Define and drive the long-term technical architecture for OLTP across Snowflake Postgres, Unistore and the infrastructure they depend on.

  • Lead major architectural decisions across transactions, storage, concurrency control, replication, recovery, query execution and database scalability.

  • Shape the compute and storage architecture for low-latency, highly available transactional systems, including resource isolation, elasticity, networking, caching and container infrastructure.

  • Build database primitives for agent-driven workloads, including fast creation of isolated transactional environments, checkpointing and rollback, and efficient lifecycle management.

  • Define how agents safely read and modify operational state, with strong guarantees around consistency, recovery, access control and governance.

  • Determine where PostgreSQL architecture and compatibility provide leverage and where alternative approaches can deliver meaningful advantages.

  • Design for workloads where databases and transactional environments are created and operated programmatically at machine speed rather than primarily through human administration.

  • Lead complex, cross-organizational engineering efforts and establish technical direction across multiple teams.

  • Work closely with product leaders, senior engineering leadership, and strategic customers on the most important technical and product decisions.

  • Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, mentoring and hands-on leadership on the hardest systems problems.

What We're Looking For

  • 15+ years of experience building databases, distributed systems, storage systems or large-scale cloud infrastructure, with sustained impact at significant technical scope.

  • Deep expertise in OLTP and database systems, including areas such as transactions, concurrency control, storage engines, indexing, query processing, replication, recovery and high availability.

  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure for low-latency stateful systems, including compute, storage, networking, resource isolation and failure handling.

  • Experience designing highly elastic, multi-tenant, or rapidly provisioned stateful systems where isolation and efficient lifecycle management are first-class concerns.

  • Strong instincts for how database architecture should evolve for AI-native applications and autonomous agents, including ephemeral state, sandboxing, safe transactional actions and programmatic database lifecycle.

  • Experience making difficult architectural tradeoffs across latency, throughput, consistency, availability, durability, scalability, isolation and cost.

  • A track record of taking technically ambitious systems from architecture through production at meaningful scale.

  • Experience influencing technical direction across multiple teams or a broad product area.

  • Strong systems engineering instincts and the ability to work across abstractions, from database internals to distributed infrastructure.

  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise is a strong advantage, but experience building other sophisticated transactional or distributed database systems is equally relevant.

  • Strong systems programming experience; C, C++, or Rust experience is a plus.

  • Exceptional technical judgment and communication skills, including the ability to influence engineers, executives and customers.

Why Join Snowflake Engineering

  • Define the architecture of a major expansion of Snowflake into transactional and operational workloads.

  • Work on fundamental database and distributed-systems problems spanning transactions, storage, compute and cloud infrastructure.

  • Build transactional systems designed for a new generation of applications and agents.

  • Influence Snowflake Postgres, Unistore and how transactional systems integrate with Snowflake's broader Data & AI platform.

  • Have technical impact at a scope where architectural decisions can shape Snowflake's product direction for years.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Prepare financial statements and notes to accounts in accordance with local GAAP and internal policies.

  • Convert US GAAP trial balances to local GAAP or IFRS, reconcile balances periodically, and document GAAP differences.

  • Ensure entries in the local GAAP ERP are recorded accurately and on time.

  • Partner with the Tax team to provide information for interim and final tax provisions.

  • Prepare and review balance sheet account reconciliations.

  • Establish audit timelines with external auditors and standardize prepared-by-client (PBC) lists.

  • Communicate audit requirements and deadlines to stakeholders, monitor progress, resolve queries, and drive audits to completion.

  • Manage statutory filings, including certified annual financial statements and supporting documents required by local authorities.

  • Review financial close activities regularly to identify and resolve unusual items.

  • Collaborate with global Accounting Operations and cross-functional teams, including Tax, HR, Legal, and Compliance.

  • Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Maintain organized, accessible records and ensure timely data backups in accordance with internal policies.

  • Identify and implement accounting and process improvements to streamline operations.

  • Research changes to accounting standards, income tax regulations, and compliance requirements, and assess their impact.

  • Prepare disclosure checklists and ensure compliance with applicable accounting and disclosure requirements.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager in the area of Control Plane and/or RSC (Regulatory and Sovereign Cloud). Control Plane is the production platform layer that creates and manages the infrastructure Snowflake runs on, converting intent into continuously managed, reliable infrastructure across cloud providers and regions. RSC extends that foundation to regulated and sovereign environments, including US government, air-gapped regions, and sovereign deployments worldwide. Together, these teams play a critical role in making Snowflake available to new customers, clouds, and regulatory environments. This role will own one of these two areas, or both, depending on your background and the teams’ needs.

AS A SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

• Set the technical strategy and roadmap for your team, and be accountable for team plans and deliverables.

• Advance AI-driven automation and software development across deployments, operations, and compliance workflows to improve consistency, scalability, and efficiency.

• Own key delivery aspects of bringing up new commercial, regulated and sovereign deployments, and partner with product and other engineering teams to bring feature parity to existing and these environments.

• Partner with Compliance, Legal, Security, and IT on authorizations and access models for restricted environments.

• Recruit, develop, and mentor engineering leaders and engineers, while remaining technically engaged in end to end delivery aspects.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

• 12+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure, or cloud services.

• 5-7 years of engineering management experience.

• Significant cloud experience in one or more CSPs such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud or others including experience in IaC tools and infrastructure automation

• Experience operating highly available SaaS platforms, including release and configuration management and multi-region rollout

• Experience delivering in regulated or sovereign environments is a plus.

• A track record of leading cross-organizational programs with many dependencies and tight timelines.

• Strong hands-on technical ability, including diving deep into system design and implementation, and a working understanding of AI-assisted software development.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and regulatory topics to executive audiences.

• BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Build and secure the foundational infrastructure that the Snowflake AI Data Cloud runs on, for some of the most regulated customers in the world.

• Set the technical strategy and roadmap for your team, and be accountable for team plans and deliverables.

• Advance AI-driven automation and software development across deployments, operations, and compliance workflows to improve consistency, scalability, and efficiency.

• Own key delivery aspects of bringing up new commercial, regulated and sovereign deployments, and partner with product and other engineering teams to bring feature parity to existing and these environments.

• Partner with Compliance, Legal, Security, and IT on authorizations and access models for restricted environments.

• Recruit, develop, and mentor engineering leaders and engineers, while remaining technically engaged in end to end delivery aspects.



OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

• 12+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure, or cloud services.

• 5-7 years of engineering management experience.

• Significant cloud experience in one or more CSPs such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud or others including experience in IaC tools and infrastructure automation

• Experience operating highly available SaaS platforms, including release and configuration management and multi-region rollout

• Experience delivering in regulated or sovereign environments is a plus.

• A track record of leading cross-organizational programs with many dependencies and tight timelines.

• Strong hands-on technical ability, including diving deep into system design and implementation, and a working understanding of AI-assisted software development.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and regulatory topics to executive audiences.

• BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.



WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

• Build and secure the foundational infrastructure that the Snowflake AI Data Cloud runs on, for some of the most regulated customers in the world.

• Lead and grow a team of industry veterans and rising stars, in a role that will push you to grow both technically and as a leader.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Deal Desk Manager for our Deal Desk team. This is a strategic, high-influence role at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations, where your commercial judgment shapes how Snowflake structures its most complex transactions and advances the deal frameworks that underpin our go-to-market motion.

AS A DEAL DESK MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales VPs and executive leadership on the structure, negotiation, and approval of complex, high-value transactions across Snowflake's Acquisitions and Enterprise accounts.

  • Own and drive deal strategy for a portfolio of strategic opportunities, setting the analytical and commercial framing that enables Sales leadership to make confident decisions at speed.

  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Accounting, Professional Services, and Operations, ensuring deal processes scale with Snowflake's growth and complexity.

  • Define, design, and continuously improve deal policies, approval frameworks, and escalation paths, serving as a primary voice on what good deal governance looks like at Snowflake.

  • Synthesize deal concession data and commercial trends into structured insights that directly inform Finance and Sales leadership decisions.

  • Mentor and develop junior Deal Desk team members, raising the overall capability of the team through coaching on deal structuring, commercial judgment, and stakeholder communication.

  • Partner with Sales Enablement and Operations to drive adoption of improved deal processes across the field, influencing behavior at scale.

  • Champion AI-assisted deal workflows and automation tooling to accelerate review cycles and free the team to focus on strategic judgment over process administration.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR DEAL DESK MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of experience in deal desk, commercial finance, contracts, or sales operations, with a demonstrated track record of owning complex deal cycles end-to-end.

  • Ability to read, understand, and draft contractual business terms and conditions for complex, multi-year transactions.

  • Deep understanding of revenue recognition principles and US GAAP, and their practical application in SaaS and consumption-based commercial models.

  • Proven ability to influence executive-level stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills that translate complexity into clarity across all levels of the organization.

  • Experience defining or significantly evolving deal policies and approval frameworks within a high-growth organization.

  • Ability to work across functional boundaries, building credibility and alignment with Legal, Finance, Sales, and Operations without formal authority.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to surface patterns in deal data and translate them into actionable guidance for leadership.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Previous experience with complex contract negotiations and long enterprise sales cycles.

  • Exposure to AI-assisted contract review or deal intelligence tooling.

  • Background working cross-functionally on GTM transformation or commercial strategy initiatives.

  • Experience scaling deal desk operations in a hypergrowth environment.

WHY JOIN OUR DEAL DESK TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Our Deal Desk team sits at the forefront of Snowflake's growth, working in close partnership with the Sales organization on the most complex and strategic transactions the company pursues. You'll operate at the center of every major deal, coordinating across Sales, Legal, Finance, and Operations to move opportunities from concept to close. In this role, you'll build relationships at every level of the company and have a direct line of sight to the decisions that drive Snowflake's revenue.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Partner Development Manager, Federal Partnerships
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the future of data. Join the Snowflake team.

Snowflake is building the future of data and AI. Our public sector partners play a critical role in helping federal agencies modernize their data environments, improve mission outcomes, and deliver better services to constituents.

As Partner Development Manager - Federal Partnerships, you will build and execute joint go-to-market strategies with a portfolio of strategic partners, including Global System Integrators (GSIs), cloud and technology partners, and value-added resellers (VARs). You will align Snowflake and partner sales teams around priority federal accounts, create actionable business plans, and develop programs that generate partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue.

This role combines executive relationship management, sales strategy, partner activation, and operational discipline. You will work across sales, solution engineering, professional services, marketing, product, legal, and public sector leadership to help partners develop Snowflake expertise, bring differentiated solutions to federal customers, and scale repeatable routes to market.

Success will be measured by net-new partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won opportunities, partner activation and competency growth, execution of joint GTM programs, and the quality of the customer and partner experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Management: Own the alliance development lifecycle for your assigned partners, from strategy and business planning through pipeline management and execution. Identify priority federal customer targets and establish joint GTM initiatives with clear owners, milestones, and metrics.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with sales, sales engineering, professional services, product, legal, and marketing to deliver a seamless partner and customer experience. Share partner and customer insights with internal teams to drive continuous improvement, and work with technical experts to build solutions with partners.

  • Co-Marketing: Plan and execute co-marketing activities, including events, webinars, and content, to increase partner visibility and generate qualified leads.

  • Deal Support: Help partners navigate Snowflake's partner program and sales process, including deal registration, proposal support, and reporting. Align with Sales Leadership and internal teams to keep sales cycles smooth and efficient.

  • Performance Delivery: Monitor partner performance against defined metrics, including sourced pipeline, partner activation, and competency growth. Shift priorities, take calculated risks, and think creatively to deliver results while managing multiple priorities at scale.

  • Build AI-First Operating Practices: Use Snowflake CoWork, CoCo, Salesforce, Slack, and related tools to streamline partner planning, opportunity tracking, deal registration, executive briefings, and partner scorecards. Identify repeatable workflows that can be automated or augmented with AI, and experiment responsibly to improve speed, visibility, and decision quality. Experience building MCP-based workflows or applying AI to sales and partner operations is a strong plus.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. We look for AI-native thinkers who are curious, low-ego, and energized by reinventing how work gets done. You treat AI as a high-trust collaborator, thrive in fast-moving environments, and rapidly test emerging capabilities to find simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results.

Desired Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic alliances, partner development, channel sales, technology sales, or business development

  • Experience managing system integrators, resellers, cloud providers, or other technology partners in the federal or public sector market

  • Demonstrated success generating partner-sourced pipeline and revenue against measurable business targets

  • Ability to create and execute joint business plans, account strategies, and GTM programs, and to track and articulate partner progress

  • Strong executive presence, negotiation skills, and written and verbal communication

  • Ability to operate effectively across sales, solution engineering, marketing, professional services, legal, and product teams

  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms, AI, and frontier model environments

  • Established relationships with Snowflake's System Integrators and Value-Added Resellers is preferred

  • Experience using AI or automation to improve sales and partner workflows is preferred

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; MBA or equivalent experience is a plus

Travel: Approximately 25%, depending on business needs

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager, Planning
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Revenue Operations team is hiring a Sales Operations Manager to own planning operations for our Partner and Product Specialist organizations. In this role, you'll run complex planning workstreams end to end, including territory design, quota setting, capacity planning, and in-year quota management. You'll be the trusted expert that Partner and Specialist leaders come to for methodology, tradeoffs, and decisions. At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise and we are building an AI-native planning organization. That means AI does the analysis and production work, and you own the judgment and decisions. You'll be expected to turn your expertise into reusable skills, self-service tools, and automated workflows that grow the team's impact.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of territories, quotas, and compensation plans for Partner and Specialist organizations across all geographies, and drive alignment with Finance, Commissions, HR, and Field Ops.

  • Define and govern global policies for account moves, quota changes, and in-year adjustments, including the methodology, guardrails, documentation, and change management behind them.

  • Lead quota and attainment reviews across global Partner and Specialist teams. You'll find root causes, surface tradeoffs, and drive resolution with senior stakeholders.

  • Anticipate how changes affect the field, Commissions, reporting, and systems, and design scalable solutions instead of one-time fixes.

  • Translate business requirements into process, data, and tooling changes in Pigment, Salesforce, and Snowflake.

  • Design workflows that produce decision-ready outputs, with methodology, confidence levels, and edge cases surfaced and validation built in from the start.

  • Encode institutional knowledge, such as quota methodology, territory logic, and planning rules, in versioned skills and documentation that capture the why along with the how.

  • Build and maintain production AI skills that encode planning methodology, validation logic, and recurring analysis for your domain. If a task runs more than twice, it should be a skill.

  • Lead small cross-functional project teams, present recommendations to senior leadership, and drive decisions forward.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 6 to 8+ years of experience in GTM strategy, planning, or sales operations, ideally at a high-growth enterprise technology company.

  • A track record of owning complex planning work-streams end to end, such as territory design, quota setting, capacity modeling, or compensation operations.

  • Experience solving ambiguous, cross-functional problems where the path isn't defined, especially during periods of rapid growth.

  • Strong influence skills with senior stakeholders, including the ability to frame tradeoffs clearly and move a group to a decision.

  • Hands-on experience building automated or AI-assisted workflows, such as scripts, bots, AI skills, or self-service tools, that replaced manual work, with the results to show for it (hours saved, errors caught, cycles shortened).

  • Deep experience with Salesforce and sales planning platforms such as Pigment or Anaplan.

  • A bachelor's degree in business, statistics, economics, or another quantitative field. An MBA is a plus.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company's confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company's data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

____

  • コンピュータサイエンス、エンジニアリング、数学、または関連分野の大卒、または同等の経験をお持ちの方

  • 日本語と英語に堪能な方

 

Japan Benefits（一部）

  • Free lunch at office

  • 401K（企業型確定拠出年金）

  • RSU

  • Phone & Gym reimbursement

  • 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

jobs.title: Senior Brand Content Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our get-it-done culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact and excel in a culture of collaboration.

Role

Snowflake is looking for a talented senior brand content strategist and writer to join our expanding content team. You will play a role in planning and executing a variety of projects, including managing a content calendar, writing customer stories, web pages, blog posts and thought leadership, editing articles, managing content metrics, leading operations and learning to turn deeply technical concepts into easy-to-understand assets. This role requires a high level of collaboration across the organization, including the customer marketing, web, product marketing, design, social, PR and legal teams.

We’re looking for someone who knows how to manage stakeholders, has a roll-up-your-sleeves work ethic, is an AI-native strategist, writer and editor who can turn copy around quickly and efficiently, and who has a passion for all aspects of developing and creating great content. The ideal candidate will have experience managing detailed content calendars and process workflows, working on and packaging content with cross-functional teams, and turning technical concepts into compelling copy that engages our target audiences. This role is equally operational and demands extensive project management, systems building, stakeholder management and AI workflow experience. If you’re ready to join a fast-paced company in a creative role and love to build incredible content, systems and AI workflows at the forefront of the data revolution, this is your dream job.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

In this role you will:

  • Develop and write customer stories, web pages, blog posts, thought leadership and much more on a tight timeline, working with a variety of stakeholders

  • Manage and coordinate with internal content team and marketing partners on content calendars and content needs, keying in upon promotion-worthy content, topic ideas and higher-level strategy

  • Manage a content calendar and content processes for a range of publishing channels; juggle competing priorities with stakeholders

  • Use AI tools and agents to increase the scale and efficiency of content creation, editing and operations, building repeatable workflows that help the team do more, faster, without sacrificing quality

  • Continually test and improve content strategy for reaching and engaging key target audiences

  • Partner with web, product marketing, design, customer marketing, growth marketing, social, PR and legal teams to build assets for campaigns

  • Proactively be a fountain of ideas for new and engaging content that drives results

Requirements:

  • 8+ years experience with proven end-to-end content strategy in editorial or digital marketing role delivering content in a wide array of formats

  • Fast, proficient writer and editor (and content packager) — with demonstrated strength in storytelling — across a wide range of topics in a variety of formats

  • Very strong project management and AI workflow skills — the ability to own and drive schedules from start to finish, including managing peers and stakeholder relationships while simultaneously building, testing, scaling and optimizing AI-native systems where nothing existed before

  • Ability to prioritize and adapt to change in a high-velocity and dynamic environment

  • Experience using analytics to determine the impact and effectiveness of content communication channels to better inform our strategy

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to scale content production and streamline workflows; fluency with Snowflake CoCo and CoWork is a very strong plus

  • Previous experience with technical, enterprise, industry or public sector content is a plus

  • Journalism and reporting experience or a background creating and developing magazine-level business and consumer content is a very, very strong plus

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make an impact?

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Lead Practice Manager, Financial Services
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact.
