At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

LEAD. STRATEGIZE. TRANSFORM. JOIN US AS A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES PRACTICE MANAGER!

Are you ready to own your impact at the forefront of the data revolution? As a Services Practice Manager, you’ll be a key driver in transforming businesses through cutting-edge cloud data solutions. You’ll collaborate with top-tier clients, strategize with elite sales teams, and lead groundbreaking professional service engagements—all while working with the best minds in the industry!

This role is completely remote and can be based anywhere in the Eastern Timezone.

WHY THIS ROLE?

  • Be a Market Leader: Own and execute a strategic vision for Professional Services.

  • Drive Meaningful Change: Work with clients to unlock the power of data and fuel digital transformations.

  • Lead from the Front: Manage high-impact projects, ensure seamless delivery, and drive revenue growth.

  • Collaborate with the Best: Work cross-functionally with top industry experts to shape the future of cloud data solutions.

  • Crush Your Goals: Meet and exceed bookings, utilization, and consumption targets while delivering exceptional customer experiences.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Spearhead services sales execution and project delivery success for key accounts.
    Engage C-level executives to create and execute services roadmaps that drive real business outcomes.

  • Own the entire professional services lifecycle—from deal strategy and proposal creation to execution and forecasting.

  • Be the go-to expert for cloud-based data warehousing, business intelligence, and AI-powered solutions.

  • Lead high-performing teams while ensuring top-tier customer satisfaction.

AS A SERVICES PRACTICE MANAGER, YOU WILL:

  • Report to an Consulting Practice Director on the Americas Professional Services teams

  • Be aligned to markets or industries as part of the practice, with services sales alignment to a Sales District Manager and Account Executives

  • Be responsible for both driving service sales enablement/execution and ensuring the successful delivery of services for your assigned accounts. Focus on achieving quarterly bookings targets (for Professional Services & Training) while meeting utilization targets by actively managing select project deliveries.

  • Be measured on consumption progress and meeting consumption targets at your accounts as part of the broader account team

  • Be the Professional Services point of contact for your accounts, through the following:

    • Help create and execute on the overall vision for services - both sales and delivery

    • Own the services delivery roadmap (proposals, closing services opportunities and delivery)

    • Collaborate with cross functional teams to find opportunities, scope, propose and sell services (Professional Services and Training) to both new and existing clients

    • Develop scope and associated SOWs for customer services engagements

    • Drive deal reviews internally to ensure alignment - ensure the scope of the project is well defined for customer success

    • Understand and help optimize business operations processes for services sales

    • Build strong cross-functional relationships within Snowflake GTM teams (legal, deal desk, account teams, sales, PS&T leadership - including workload services - and partner team)

    • Provide bookings forecast and demonstrate strong command of your book of business

    • Align services engagements to key customers business outcomes

    • Drive alignment with executive sponsors and/or customer stakeholders

    • Collaborate with other delivery partners (SIs, GSIs, other PS orgs, etc) in support of project delivery

    • Serve as the initial point of escalation for customer and project team

    • Own project outcomes and manage project financials (revenue forecasting and expense management)

    • Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction as reflected in customer survey scores

    • Collaborate with Education Services team for training delivery

    • Provide specific services delivery activities for the role/engagement (Business Value roadmap, Business value assessment, strategic roadmap, Data Cloud Assessment, etc)

    • Deep collaboration with AE/SEs on the account for account strategy

  • Own and contribute to internal process improvements across your team and the broader Professional Services organization

  • Develop expertise within their aligned market through working closely with other Practice Directors, Sales teams, and Global Industry Leaders to understand transformational specific use cases and through external research on the current business and technology landscape for your customer base.

OUR IDEAL SERVICES PRACTICE MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience in a Sales and Services Delivery role (or similar capacity) interfacing with executives and dealing with complex, technical implementation projects, roadmapping and revenue forecasting

  • Direct experience, ideally within the respective market (see job title), in a Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence and/or Cloud field

  • Strong understanding of business solutions of our target clients, leveraging data as an enabler. Examples include Customer Data Platforms, cross-industry Data sharing, AI, personalization, etc.

  • Proven track record of meeting booking, utilization, and consumption (or similar) targets

  • Proven ability to communicate and translate effectively across both internal teams and customer organizational structures, developing technology programs, defining milestones, success criteria, resource allocation, and on-time delivery.

  • Strong organizational skills, ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Differentiator: Big 5 or boutique strategy consulting experience, ideally with experience achieving or exceeding sales targets.

  • Differentiator: Experience in a client support and advisory technical role (solution architect, system administrator, technical account manager or equivalent)

  • Differentiator: Experience in designing, leading, influencing and selling functional solution sets (e.g. Digital Marketing, Supply Chain optimization, Manufacturing Re-engineering) or cross-functional Digital Transformations.

WHY JOIN OUR PROFESSIONAL SERVICES TEAM:

  • Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product

  • Get unique, hands-on experience with bleeding edge data warehouse technology

  • Develop, lead and execute an market-changing initiative

  • Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world’s leading data platforms.

The Team:

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Productivity for our Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake.

As part of Engineering Productivity at Observe by Snowflake, you will empower engineering teams across the organization by building scalable developer tools, robust build and test infrastructure, and automated release systems. Working at the intersection of developer experience, build systems, AI agent systems, and cloud infrastructure, you will play a critical role in driving engineering velocity and reliability at scale.

In this role your will:

  • Design, build, and maintain internal tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and AI agent based developer workflows

  • Build and scale test infrastructure and test execution frameworks to accelerate developer feedback loops

  • Improve developer velocity, developer and agent environment tooling, as well as local debugging/testing workflows

  • Partner with development, infrastructure, and SRE teams to streamline release engineering, deployment reliability, and artifact management

  • Monitor and optimize build times, test flakiness, and CI performance across the engineering organization

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on engineering productivity, developer tooling, agentic workflows, build systems, or release engineering

  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD systems, build orchestration tools (e.g., Bazel, Nix, Go build tooling), and test automation infrastructure

  • Strong proficiency in server-side languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++

  • Hands-on experience with containerization, cloud infrastructure, and release automation

  • Deep interest in developer experience, developer velocity metrics, and building developer-facing products

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in backend application development

  • Experience with open-source developer tools, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code

  • Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or distributed tracing and logging systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger)

  • Open-source contributions to observability, data infrastructure, or developer productivity projects

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Frontier Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

LEAD. STRATEGIZE. TRANSFORM.

Summary

Frontier Engineering's mission is to engineer guaranteed customer outcomes on Snowflake, the trusted control plane for AI-first business. We bring Snowflake engineers, AI specialists, and industry experts together with customers to modernize their data foundations and put AI into production, delivering measurable ROI in weeks and months, not quarters and years. We operate through two transformation engines: Data Transformation, which helps customers migrate, modernize, consolidate, and govern the data foundation that AI depends on; and Agentic Transformation, which helps customers build agents, intelligent applications, and AI-powered workflows that reimagine how their business runs.

As our first Engagement Manager based in New Zealand, you will be Frontier Engineering's in-market leader for your accounts across both Data Transformation and Agentic Transformation, and the single point of accountability for engagement outcomes, from first conversation through scoping, contracting, delivery, and expansion. You will work hand-in-hand with New Zealand account teams and with our Australia-based Services Solution Managers and Sales Solution Architects as one team: you bring local customer intimacy, deal shaping, and delivery leadership; they bring commercial and technical scoping depth. Together you will sell, shape, and deliver Frontier Engineering engagements that turn into production outcomes: Snowflake consumption and realized customer value.

Why This Role?

  • Build a market: Be the founding Frontier Engineering Engagement Manager in New Zealand, shaping how Snowflake delivers outcomes for some of the country's most important organizations.

  • Sell, shape, and deliver: Own the engagement lifecycle end to end, with clear line of sight from a customer's business problem to the value delivered in production.

  • Work at the frontier: Lead engagements across both Data Transformation (migration, modernization, governance) and Agentic Transformation (agents, AI applications, intelligent workflows), bringing capabilities like Cortex, Horizon, Iceberg, and Openflow into production for customers.

  • Grow with us: A clear pathway to Principal level for those who demonstrate portfolio ownership, deal engineering, and market leadership.

What You'll Do

Sell & Shape

  • In-Market Pursuit Leadership: Be the local Frontier Engineering point of contact for New Zealand Account Executives; qualify opportunities with account teams and engage early with executive sponsors to identify the business problem worth solving.

  • Discovery & Value Shaping: Lead customer discovery and journey workshops in New Zealand that align on use-case priorities, target outcomes, and the business case; anchor every engagement to measurable value (revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction, faster time to value).

  • Deal Shaping in Partnership: Work with Services Solution Managers on commercial strategy, value-based pricing, proposals, and Statements of Work (SOWs), and with Sales Solution Architects on solution scoping and estimation. Pressure-test scope, assumptions, and estimates for deliverability and margin before contract, and support internal Deal Review and approval.

  • Forecast & Pipeline: Contribute to and maintain an accurate bookings forecast and pipeline for your New Zealand accounts alongside your Services Solution Manager and account team partners.

  • Account Expansion: Build services roadmaps with account teams and identify "white space" where new Snowflake capabilities solve customer business problems, turning point engagements into multi-phase transformation programs.

  • Partner Ecosystem: Work with SI, GSI, and ISV partners in New Zealand on co-delivery and co-sell approaches, extending delivery capacity under Frontier Engineering standards.

Deliver

  • Sales-to-Delivery Ownership: Own the handoff from pursuit to delivery, ensuring delivery readiness and that what was sold is what gets delivered; lead engagement kick-off to align stakeholders on scope, roles, timeline, and success metrics.

  • Integrated Execution: Lead engagements through go-live and close-out; manage Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), RAID logs, and critical-path scheduling to mitigate schedule variance across multi-workstream technical implementations.

  • Scope Protection: Identify scope creep in real time and negotiate protective Change Orders that safeguard project integrity and customer trust.

  • Financial Ownership: Own engagement financials, including revenue forecasting, budget burn-down, cost control, and high Estimate at Completion (EAC) accuracy, protecting margin while delivering customer satisfaction.

  • Escalation Leadership: Serve as the initial point of escalation for customers, partners, and project teams; lead decision-making in high-pressure situations.

  • Value Realization & Close-out: Drive knowledge transfer, final retrospectives, and value readouts; secure customer references and identify the next opportunity.

Advise & Improve

  • Executive Engagement: Engage C-level and VP stakeholders to create and execute services roadmaps that drive real business outcomes; communicate risks and wins with clarity and transparency.

  • Voice of the Customer: Translate field-level technical blockers into actionable feedback for Snowflake Product and Engineering teams.

  • Practice Contribution: Feed delivery learnings back into scoping and estimation with Sales Solution Architects, contribute to Frontier Engineering reusable assets and playbooks, and use AI-assisted workflows (e.g., Snowflake Cortex Code for SOW drafting and engagement summaries) to work faster and smarter.

  • Operational Hygiene: Maintain accurate Salesforce and financial system data for your portfolio, and support utilization of delivery resources.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have

  • Experience: Typically a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.

  • Sales & Delivery Background: 10+ years in a Sales and Services Delivery role interfacing with executives on complex technical implementation projects such as cloud data warehouse and data platform implementation, modernization, or AI/ML adoption.

  • Track Record: Proven achievement of quantitative targets such as bookings, utilization, consumption, and delivery margin.

  • Deal Shaping: Demonstrated experience leading discovery, shaping scope and value propositions, and closing services deals as part of a sales team.

  • Execution Rigor: Hands-on mastery of project governance (WBS, RAID, critical path), change management, and project financials (EAC).

  • Executive Presence: Ability to command a room of C-suite executives while holding technical credibility in deep-dives with engineering and data science teams.

  • Domain Expertise: Direct experience across data platform modernization (data warehousing, migration, BI, cloud data platforms) and AI/ML or GenAI adoption, with the range to lead both data foundation and AI application engagements; able to pivot from a high-level architecture discussion to a detailed task breakdown.

  • Collaboration Across Distance: Proven ability to work as one team with sales, pre-sales, and delivery colleagues across locations, building trust and alignment without relying on co-location, as a remote-based team member.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable switching instantly between sales support, project governance, and hands-on crisis management, and managing multiple accounts and projects in parallel with a high degree of autonomy.

Bonus Points

  • Established network across New Zealand enterprise, government, or the local SI and partner community.

  • Big 5 or boutique strategy consulting experience.

  • Experience in a technical advisory role such as solution architect or technical account manager.

  • Hands-on project experience with the Snowflake AI Data Cloud or other cloud data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience building a services practice or team presence in a new market.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Enterprise Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world’s leading data platforms.

The Team:

We are hiring a Software Engineer, Enterprise for our Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake. As part of the Enterprise Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake, you’ll build and scale core features, APIs, and business logic powering a high-performance observability platform. You’ll develop reliable, production-grade systems designed to handle massive volumes of telemetry for enterprise customers. Working at the intersection of data, infrastructure, and user experience, you’ll help deliver solutions that enable fast, actionable insights at scale. This is an opportunity to own impactful systems that directly support the reliability and performance of some of the world’s largest organizations.

In this role your will:

  • Design, build, and own core features, APIs, and business logic powering a high-performance observability platform for enterprise customers

  • Take end-to-end ownership from technical scoping and architecture through deployment, ensuring systems meet enterprise reliability and performance standards

  • Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and data teams to deliver solutions that enable fast, actionable insights for engineering teams worldwide

  • Partner with SREs and customer-facing teams to diagnose and resolve production issues, applying AI-assisted workflows to accelerate root-cause analysis

  • Contribute to high engineering standards through thoughtful code review, mentorship, and architectural influence

Qualifications:

  • 2 - 5 years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on backend application systems or distributed platforms

  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems at scale, handling high throughput, low latency, and enterprise reliability requirements

  • Strong proficiency in one or more server-side languages such as Go, Java, Scala, Python, or similar

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical problems from scoping through delivery, without waiting to be directed

  • Experience collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a track record of shipping impactful, customer-facing work

  • A BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or distributed tracing and logging systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger)

  • Experience building or contributing to AI-assisted developer tools or LLM-integrated workflows

  • Background in SRE practices, incident response automation, or root-cause analysis tooling

  • Open-source contributions to observability, data infrastructure, or developer productivity projects

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Warehouse UX pod at Snowflake. This team owns critical warehouse capabilities spanning features, billing, and usability across the warehouse experience. Warehouses are one of the most mission-critical parts of Snowflake’s platform and a major revenue driver for the company, making this an opportunity to work on high-impact systems at significant scale.

Despite the UX pod name, this is not a front-end role. This team builds backend distributed systems that power warehouse behavior, customer-facing warehouse capabilities, metering and billing-related functionality, and the reliability and usability of core warehouse workflows.

This role is best suited for an engineer with 4 to 7 years of experience who can independently drive medium-sized projects end to end, contribute effectively to larger cross-team efforts, and bring strong technical judgment to systems that matter deeply to customers and the business.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate backend software and distributed systems that power Snowflake Warehouses.

  • Own medium-sized engineering projects independently from design through delivery, and contribute to larger initiatives across the warehouse organization.

  • Build and evolve capabilities related to warehouse features, billing, and usability.

  • Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational health of warehouse systems in production.

  • Work across the full software lifecycle, including technical design, implementation, testing, rollout, on-call participation, issue triage, and follow-through on production improvements.

  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, and adjacent teams to deliver durable solutions to customer and business problems.

  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, maintainability, and long-term architectural health.

  • Use strong debugging and systems thinking to resolve complex production issues and improve service behavior over time.

  • Raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews, operational rigor, and clear technical communication.

  • Apply AI-assisted workflows where they increase engineering leverage, speed, or quality without compromising judgment.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • BS in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4 to 7 years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong programming, debugging, and software design skills in one or more modern languages.

  • Experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in production.

  • Ability to independently execute on medium-sized projects and deliver them to completion.

  • Ability to contribute as a strong technical partner on larger, cross-team projects.

  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and engineering best practices across design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.

  • Experience participating in on-call, production support, or incident response for live systems.

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, low-ego working style.

  • A customer-oriented mindset and good judgment about reliability, usability, and business impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical field.

  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or large-scale backend services.

  • Experience working on billing, metering, control plane systems, or customer-facing platform capabilities.

  • Familiarity with performance-sensitive or highly reliable production environments.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and breaking down complex technical problems into practical solutions.

Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud, a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Inside the AI Data Cloud, organizations unite their siloed data, easily discover and securely share governed data, and execute diverse analytic workloads. Wherever data or users live, Snowflake delivers a single and seamless experience across multiple public clouds. Snowflake’s platform is the engine that powers and provides access to the AI Data Cloud, creating a solution for data warehousing, data lakes, data engineering, data science, data application development, and data sharing. Join Snowflake customers, partners, and data providers already taking their businesses to new frontiers in the AI Data Cloud.

 

WHO YOU ARE:

Snowflake is experiencing exponential growth, and we are expanding our Alliances team to help us scale. We are looking for a strategic leader to scale our most critical Technology partnerships. As Partner Development Director, Enterprise Technologies, you will own the 360-degree relationship for high-value technology partners. The primary focus of the role is supporting our joint customers and sales teams with effective joint go-to-market and resell/co-sell success. Reporting to Snowflake’s Enterprise Technology Partner leader, you will have a unique opportunity to work for the AI Data Cloud and lead one of Snowflake’s most important strategic partnerships.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive the Americas focused - North America and LATAM end-to-end strategy across co-sell, resell, marketing, and product integration pillars.

  • Partner with Snowflake's sales teams across North America and LATAM to hit annual sales targets and by developing sales plays to improve field collaboration.

  • Collaborate with technical experts to develop joint solutions and create high-impact enablement materials that highlight differentiators for both Snowflake and partner teams

  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with senior executives and partner with marketing teams to create compelling programs that highlight the value of joint solutions.

  • Foster deep relationships across Product, Legal, and Professional Services to ensure a seamless experience. Act as the voice of the partner by sharing insights to drive continuous platform improvement.

  • Coordinate co-marketing initiatives (events, webinars, content) and utilize Snowflake systems to track key metrics, including joint pipeline and deal registration.

     

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Over 12 years of relevant work experience, including a minimum of 8 years in sales and alliances and at least 3 years at a director level or higher.

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience leading an ISV partnership (particular interest in experience managing enterprise technology partnerships with SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow) that generated more than $10M in annual co-sell/resell revenue.

  • A proven history of success leading alliance partnerships and identifying mutual business interests, with a background in software and SaaS.

  • A highly analytical, data-driven, and strategic mindset, with the capability for creative problem-solving and pragmatic execution.

  • Strong verbal, executive presentation, and communication skills to effectively articulate the partnership's strategy and impact, with a history of success working with cross-functional teams.

  • A proven track record as a self-starter with a high degree of initiative and the ability to learn quickly.

 - Drive the Americas focused - North America and LATAM end-to-end strategy across co-sell, resell, marketing, and product integration pillars.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Ingestion
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Software Engineer – File Ingestion (Customer-Facing Services)

Build the Future of the AI Data Cloud

Snowflake’s File Ingestion team owns the core engines behind COPY INTO and Snowpipe — the primary arteries landing customer data into the AI Data Cloud at hundreds of petabytes per quarter.

We are expanding our core mission to build next-generation, external-facing ingestion services that directly expose file-ingest capabilities to external platforms, partner ecosystems, and customer applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the architectural vision and execution for these mission-critical, customer-facing services. You will operate at the intersection of high-throughput distributed systems, API platform design, and direct customer feature delivery, defining how enterprise data seamlessly flows into Snowflake at global scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Technical Vision & Architecture: Define the multi-year architecture and technical strategy for high-throughput, external-facing ingestion services and APIs across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Deliver Customer-Facing Innovations: Lead the end-to-end execution of enterprise-grade external features, ensuring low-latency data landing, high availability, and seamless ecosystem integration (e.g., Snowpark Connect, partner connectors).

  • Set Technical Direction: Author foundational design documents, establish technical standards for reliability, security, and scalability, and lead high-stakes architectural reviews across engineering orgs.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Principal Architects, Product Management, Security, and external developer platforms to translate customer requirements into resilient system architecture.

  • Elevate Engineering Excellence: Mentor and sponsor Senior, Mid-level, and Junior engineers; raise the bar for system design, code quality, testing methodologies, and operational maturity.

  • Direct Customer & Strategic Impact: Engage with enterprise customer engineering teams to solve complex integration challenges, debug production edge cases at scale, and turn direct customer feedback into core platform capabilities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud-native infrastructure in production.

  • Proven track record of architectural leadership, having successfully taken complex, customer-facing services or external APIs from initial concept to General Availability (GA) and global scale.

  • Expert proficiency in Java or C++ (strong preference for engineers comfortable working across both systems-level C++ and managed service Java frameworks).

  • Deep expertise in external API design, cloud service orchestration, and building resilient, multi-tenant customer-facing endpoints.

  • Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following: high-throughput ingestion pipelines, distributed query execution engines, messaging/streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar), or database internals.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to drive technical consensus across cross-functional leadership, product partners, and external technical stakeholders.

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building and scaling external developer platforms, SDKs, or public SaaS APIs serving external consumers.

  • Deep expertise with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and integration with ecosystems like Apache Spark or Ray.

  • Advanced performance engineering expertise: memory management, SIMD, vectorization, lock-free data structures, or I/O optimization at PB-scale.

  • Strong background in metadata management, transactional state machines, or consensus protocols (e.g., Raft, Paxos).

  • Active contributor to open-source data infrastructure, cloud-native compute systems, or query engines.

Why This Team

  • Massive Strategic Impact: You will lead the expansion of Snowflake's most critical data-path surface into direct, customer-facing integrations that unlock new platform ecosystems and drive platform volume.

  • Broad Architectural Scope: Your work will bridge edge API layers, control-plane orchestrators, file scanners/parsers, query planners, and underlying storage engines.

  • High Customer Visibility: Work directly on features that power the external integrations for Fortune 500 enterprises, seeing the immediate revenue and performance impact of your architecture.

  • Culture of Technical Leadership: Partner directly with Snowflake’s top architects and leads in an environment that values deep technical autonomy, rigorous engineering, and long-term architectural stewardship.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Agent Marketplace
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake Marketplace is the trusted enterprise channel for governed data sharing at scale. This role advances that mission into the next paradigm shift: transforming data-sharing infrastructure into an AI-first intelligence marketplace for autonomous agents, semantic models, remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and AI-ready data primitives.

As a Senior Product Manager for the Marketplace, you will own the strategy and execution for making Snowflake the definitive destination where third-party AI agents are built, governed, distributed, and monetized. You will act as a general manager operating at the intersection of platform engineering, developer ecosystems, and commercial strategy—connecting partner innovation directly to enterprise customer adoption.

Interested in our recent momentum? Check out our H1 2026 update on Snowflake Marketplace & Agentic AI Growth for context on where we're heading and the foundation you'll be building on.

AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Define the Strategic Vision: Set and socialize the product strategy for Snowflake’s AI-first marketplace, aligning product leadership, developer relations, partner engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams behind key primitive releases (including AI agents, semantic layers, and remote MCP integrations, etc.) – and be the trusted subject matter expert to educate and inspire our customers' adoption of these technologies .

  • Ship Category-Defining Primitives: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for third party agents, MCPs, Semantic Views and future AI Products.

  • Design Commercial Mechanics: Drive monetization design as a core product surface, including pricing and packaging, usage- and outcome-based billing and partner revenue-share structures.

  • Operate AI-Natively: Prototype listing workflows, build partner integrations, and utilize advanced telemetry and generative tools to inform roadmap prioritization and evaluate third-party agent performance hands-on.

  • Deliver Measurable Impact: Own overall business metrics, driving partner supply growth, enterprise buyer adoption of AI-first listings, and platform consumption pulled through agentic workflows.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • Product Experience: 6+ years in product management, with a track record of bringing AI, developer platform, or infrastructure products from 0-to-1 and scaling them to commercial adoption.

  • Ecosystem Building: Proven background in building two-sided markets—such as developer platforms, API marketplaces, enterprise app stores, or partner ecosystems—where you successfully curated supply and drove buyer demand.

  • Commercial Architecture Mastery: Direct experience designing productized commercial mechanics, including meter-based consumption, usage/outcome pricing, committed-spend drawdowns, and multi-sided revenue distribution.

  • Technical Depth in AI Architecture: Hands-on familiarity with modern AI agent stacks (MCP, agent-to-agent protocols, tool calling, semantic layers, and non-human identity/delegation mechanisms) to engage credibly with enterprise architects and developer teams.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Ability to navigate extreme ambiguity, define new product categories, and execute hypothesis-driven roadmaps without relying on existing templates.

  • Relevant Industry Background: Experience in cloud marketplaces, AI platform ecosystems, developer tools, or enterprise SaaS ecosystems (e.g., major cloud platforms, AI-native infrastructure vendors, or developer infrastructure companies).

Why Join Our Team at Snowflake?

This position offers true general-manager scope on a category at the absolute frontier of enterprise software—defining how third-party AI agents are commercialized and deployed at enterprise scale. You will work directly alongside cross-functional engineering and product leaders across core platform capabilities, governance, identity, and business development. As the voice of Snowflake’s agent ecosystem, you will lead high-visibility bets, shape the commercial model for the agentic enterprise, and build a career path toward executive product leadership.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake is actively seeking a Life Sciences Industry Principal to join our Global Industry Go-to-Market team. This team is made up of subject matter experts that come from the industry. They serve an internal strategy role as well as an external customer-facing role to provide context and establish credibility on how Snowflake can deliver on business use cases and outcomes.

In this role you will be responsible for working with our field sales teams and customer executives to develop and close new business for targeted accounts within the Life Sciences sub-vertical. You will act as a visionary and an innovative industry expert as it pertains to data, analytics and AI. You will have the opportunity to apply your successful track record of building, overseeing, and developing enterprise solution go-to-market strategies.

RESPONSIBILITIES :

  • Provide industry experience and insight within our most strategic life sciences accounts developing account strategies, building trusted relationships, and presenting Snowflake’s vision for the industry to a C-level audience

  • Build customer-facing industry content

  • Build strategic relationships with the life sciences vertical ecosystem including customers, partners, and data providers

  • Partner with the industry architect and industry marketing teams to develop and drive a cohesive industry go-to-market strategy

  • Collaborate to further strengthen the life science industry’s enablement strategy within the organization, including leadership of “industry communities of practice”

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, ENTERPRISE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build and execute a territory strategy, target-account plan, and regional sales plan to achieve quarterly and annual goals for the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Become a trusted advisor by understanding each customer’s business priorities, data estate, cloud strategy, and AI roadmap, then connecting those needs to Snowflake’s platform.

  • Lead executive and CxO conversations that position Snowflake as a strategic platform for data engineering, analytics, application development, collaboration, and AI.

  • Orchestrate complex sales cycles across customer stakeholders, Snowflake solution engineering, professional services, partners, marketing, and customer success.

  • Develop regional marketing and partner plans that generate qualified pipeline and accelerate new-logo growth.

  • Apply MEDDPICC to improve qualification, stakeholder alignment, deal strategy, and forecast accuracy.

  • Negotiate and close enterprise agreements, then support a smooth transition into onboarding and long-term adoption of Snowflake.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, ENTERPRISE WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of relevant field sales experience, with a demonstrated record of selling complex data, cloud, or enterprise technology solutions.

  • A consistent record of generating new business, developing enterprise pipeline, and delivering against ambitious sales goals.

  • Proven ability to independently develop, manage, negotiate, and close complex new-client relationships.

  • Experience engaging executives and translating business and IT priorities into clear value propositions and commercial outcomes.

  • Strong discovery, presentation, listening, communication, and relationship-management skills.

  • Experience coordinating complex buying groups and aligning internal specialists around a customer outcome.

  • Practical experience using MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise qualification methodology.

  • The judgement, resilience, curiosity, and ownership mindset needed to perform effectively in a fast-moving environment.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Enterprise sales experience within industries that are strategic to the New Zealand market.

  • Experience selling cloud platforms, data infrastructure, analytics, cybersecurity, or AI solutions.

  • Familiarity with Snowflake, major cloud providers, modern data architectures, and enterprise AI use cases.

  • Experience using AI-assisted workflows to improve account research, prospecting, deal preparation, and customer engagement.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is an opportunity to shape Snowflake’s enterprise growth in New Zealand while working on visible, high-impact customer opportunities. You will partner with talented specialists across Snowflake to help new customers modernize how they use data and build for the AI era.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer, Public Sector
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As a Senior Solution Engineer – Public Sector at Snowflake, you will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to drive ongoing success and growth within our existing Public Sector customer base in Singapore and the broader ASEAN region. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping government agencies and public sector institutions realize full value from the Snowflake Data Cloud, expand their workloads, and adopt new capabilities such as AI/ML and data applications.

This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong knowledge of the public sector landscape, and excellent customer engagement skills. You will lead technical discovery, architect new use cases on top of existing deployments, deliver compelling demonstrations, and guide customers through proof-of-value and production expansion. A strong understanding of the Singapore and ASEAN public sector regulatory environment (e.g., IM8, GovTech policies, data residency, cloud security and compliance requirements) is essential.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers to identify, qualify, and execute expansion opportunities within existing Public Sector accounts (new workloads, users, departments, and data products).

  • Present Snowflake’s technology, roadmap, and vision to executives, technical leaders, and practitioners at public sector customers, clearly articulating business value and technical differentiation.

  • Work hands-on with customers to design and validate new solutions on Snowflake across analytics, data sharing, data engineering, AI/ML, and data applications – from ideation to proof-of-concept and production rollout.

  • Conduct technical discovery and architecture reviews to understand current usage, identify gaps, and propose best-practice architectures that increase adoption, performance, security, and cost efficiency.

  • Build and deliver tailored demos and technical workshops that showcase how Snowflake can power key government and public sector use cases (e.g., citizen 360, smart nation initiatives, public health analytics, regulatory reporting, fraud and risk, operational analytics).

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to:

    • Provide public sector–specific feedback and influence product roadmap.

    • Create and share reusable assets such as reference architectures, demo environments, playbooks, and best practices tailored to public sector expansion.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer technical stakeholders, helping them adopt Snowflake platform features (governance, security, performance optimization, data sharing, marketplace, AI/ML integrations) and embed Snowflake into their long-term data strategy.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies (data platforms, analytics, AI/ML tools, integration and BI ecosystems) and how to position Snowflake relative to them in the public sector context.

  • Support RFPs, RFIs, and security/compliance reviews with detailed technical input, ensuring alignment with government standards and procurement requirements.

  • Advocate for and demonstrate cost management and FinOps best practices on Snowflake to drive sustainable, value-based expansion.

  • Contribute to the broader SE and Public Sector community by mentoring peers, sharing learnings, and supporting field enablement.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Extensive working experience in a customer-facing solution engineering / pre-sales role, ideally focused on data, analytics, or cloud platforms.

  • Proven track record of driving expansion or upsell within existing enterprise or public sector accounts (e.g., increasing platform consumption, enabling new workloads, or landing cross-departmental use cases).

  • Strong competency across modern data stacks:

    • ETL/ELT, data warehousing / data lakes / lakehouse

    • Analytics, data science, AI / ML / Generative AI, and data applications

  • Excellent ability to present to both technical and executive audiences, whether through impromptu whiteboarding or structured presentations and demos.

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and at least one of the following: Python, Spark, or similar data processing technologies.

  • Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and key data-related services.

  • Strong familiarity with security, governance, and compliance concepts relevant to public sector workloads (identity and access management, encryption, data residency, auditing).

  • Experience working in or with Singapore / ASEAN Public Sector customers, or other regulated environments, with an understanding of government procurement and regulatory expectations.

  • Solid understanding of Singapore Government Commercial cloud - infrastructure, networking, security and data classification levels.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and value-based selling skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

STRONGLY DESIRED:

  • Experience with large-scale data platforms (e.g., Teradata, Netezza, Exadata, Greenplum, Hadoop) and migrations to cloud data platforms.

  • Programming/scripting experience (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, or Spark) for data engineering, automation, or proof-of-concept development.

  • Experience selling or supporting enterprise data / analytics / AI platforms in a pre-sales, consulting, or architecture role.

  • Familiarity with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and how they integrate with cloud data platforms.

  • Experience designing or optimizing OLAP data models and enterprise data architectures.

  • Background in Public Sector or Government – either as a practitioner (e.g., in a ministry, statutory board, or government-linked entity) or as a vendor/partner supporting public sector programs.

  • Experience working with ecosystem partners (GSIs, ISVs, resellers) to drive joint solutions and market motions in the public sector.

  • Exposure to Data Science / AI / ML / Generative AI workloads, including integration patterns with Snowflake and cloud-native AI services.

  • Cloud platform certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or data/analytics certifications (including Snowflake) are an added plus.

ADDED BONUS FOR:

  • Hands-on experience designing or operating data platforms on Snowflake or similar cloud-native data platforms in production at scale.

  • Experience with data sharing, data exchange, or data marketplace concepts, particularly for cross-agency or cross-domain collaboration.

  • Deep understanding of Singapore and ASEAN public sector frameworks, such as:

    • Government security and compliance standards

    • Data residency and sovereignty expectations

    • GovTech and Smart Nation initiatives

  • Experience driving multi-stakeholder programs in complex environments, including C-level sponsors, architects, procurement, and operational teams.

  • Experience with enterprise SaaS solutions and subscription-based business models.

  • Passion for helping public sector organizations unlock the value of data to improve citizen services, policy-making, and operational efficiency.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Director, Field Sales Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Revenue Operations organization is seeking a Director, Field Operations to support our USMajors Sales organization. In this role you will partner with cross functional teams in defining, landing and executing our key strategic priorities. You will apply your strategic planning, financial acumen, creative thinking and deep analytic background to sales engagements.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Field Operations, you will play a critical part in providing insightful analyses and actionable recommendations to the sales leadership team that will influence strategy and implementation of objectives that appropriately reflect our business goals. Our hyper-growth environment requires an ever-evolving approach to managing our go-to-market strategy, and increasingly, that means using AI as a core part of how the team plans, analyzes, and executes.

In this role you will get to:

  • Serve as a strategic operating partner to USMajors Sales leadership, translating business priorities into a focused operational agenda, territory designs, and optimal resource allocation.

  • Lead and scale a high-performing Field Operations team, setting clear expectations, coaching strategic judgment, and building talent for expanded organizational responsibility.

  • Represent the voice of the field across cross-functional decisions (planning, compensation, reporting, etc.), synthesizing insights and leadership relationships to resolve systemic barriers and influence investment priorities.

  • Own the end-to-end Majors sales funnel and revenue governance, maintaining disciplined tracking of pipeline growth, win/loss rates, coverage models, and quota attainment to deliver actionable insights to executive leadership.

  • Lead long-range operational planning for the theater, looking beyond the immediate fiscal year to build scalable multi-year GTM strategies, capacity models, and growth frameworks.

  • Establish and drive accountability for a unified operating rhythm, inspecting the pipeline, forecast, revenue performance, and overall book of business across the field, ensuring high-quality, reliable delivery while balancing standardized processes with regional flexibility.

  • Actively collaborate with cross-functional business partners (such as Finance, Planning & Compensation, Alliances, HR/Recruiting, etc.) to ensure an aligned approach to managing the business, all in an effort to maximize seller productivity and retain top talent.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Solution Engineering (SE) leadership to streamline operational workflows, optimize resource alignment, and support the continued expansion of the technical and field GTM organizations.

  • Drive the practical adoption of AI and automated workflows across core GTM operations—including forecasting, reporting, and pipeline hygiene—to increase capacity, accelerate analysis, and improve seller and manager productivity.

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • 10+ years of experience in sales operations, enablement, revenue operations or equivalent function with significant exposure to global sales teams

  • Demonstrated understanding of SaaS go-to-market models, sales support roles, business metrics and growth best practices

  • Ability to structure complex problems, derive insights from data, and articulate clearly with diverse teams up to the senior leadership level

  • Strong presentation skills and ability to influence varying org functions at varying levels of seniority throughout the org; basically you can execute as well as recommend

  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Cortex, Copilot, or similar assistants) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and decision-making

  • Bachelor's degree; MBA a plus

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Horizontal UI Experiences
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Snowflake’s product experience is how customers engage with our data and AI platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Horizontal UI Experiences, you will improve the quality, speed, consistency, and reach of Snowflake’s UI experience across the workflows and shared UI capabilities customers rely on every day.

You will own a focused, cross-product charter spanning core customer journeys, UI platform components, design systems, performance, accessibility, and global readiness. You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, and product teams to turn customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable improvements.

AS A SENIOR PM AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for horizontal UI experiences, balancing customer needs, product quality, technical constraints, and business impact.

  • Improve end-to-end experiences across login and authentication, the homepage, and core customer journeys.

  • Partner with design and engineering to evolve shared UI capabilities, including the design system and personalization, so experiences feel coherent across products.

  • Drive improvements to performance and product latency, working with engineering teams to identify the highest-impact opportunities and measure progress.

  • Make Snowflake work for more customers by advancing accessibility, localization, URL readiness, and support for additional regions.

  • Build a strong understanding of customer friction through research, usage data, customer feedback, and cross-functional input.

  • Define success measures, establish baselines, and use evidence to prioritize work and assess whether changes improve customer experience.

  • Create alignment across partner product teams and functions, making ownership, trade-offs, and decisions clear.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:

  • 4+ years of product management experience owning and delivering customer-facing software products or substantial product areas.

  • A track record of turning customer problems into a focused product strategy, roadmap, and shipped outcomes.

  • Strong product judgment for end-to-end workflows, usability, and consistent experiences across multiple surfaces.

  • Comfort using qualitative and quantitative evidence to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.

  • The ability to partner effectively with engineering and design on technically complex product areas, and to communicate trade-offs clearly.

  • Experience influencing multiple teams and stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain decisions and bring teams along.

BONUS POINTS:

  • Enterprise SaaS, data platforms, or complex multi-product environments.

  • Shared UI platforms, design systems, or horizontal product experiences.

  • Product work involving performance and latency, authentication, accessibility, localization, or regional availability.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You’ll work on product experiences that cut across Snowflake and matter to customers throughout their day-to-day use of Snowflake. The charter combines visible customer-facing journeys with foundational improvements to speed, accessibility, and global reach—and gives you the opportunity to shape a focused roadmap with engineering, design, and product partners.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Incident Response Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Security Incident Response Engineer to join our Incident Response team. You will help redefine how incidents are handled at scale, pairing autonomous AI agents with human judgment so that we can detect, investigate, and contain threats faster across a rapidly growing cloud and AI footprint.

AS A SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Join a high-impact team of security experts to scale security at one of the fastest-growing software companies ever

  • Spearhead an agentic approach to Incident Response by deploying, guiding, and refining autonomous AI agents that execute initial triage, context gathering, and rapid investigation alongside human Incident Commanders

  • Handle escalations, lead security investigations, and act as Incident Commander for critical incidents

  • Build scripts, automation pipelines, and agentic workflows that continuously enhance Snowflake's incident response capabilities

  • Partner closely with our Threat Detection, Automation, Product Security, Legal, HR, Cloud, and Data teams

  • Create and improve detections, threat signatures, and guardrails for both traditional and AI-driven attack vectors

  • Participate in a periodic on-call rotation, which may involve non-traditional working hours

OUR IDEAL SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in incident response or security operations preferred

  • Strong experience in incident response, security investigations, and running incidents as the Incident Commander

  • Advanced experience using security stack capabilities (EDR, SIEM, SOAR, DLP) across endpoints, identity providers, SaaS, and cloud workloads

  • Deep familiarity with AI/LLM tooling, security copilots, and AI-driven telemetry to accelerate investigations, threat triage, and post-incident reporting

  • Knowledge of securing frontier AI infrastructure, including model training and serving pipelines and AI agent permissions

  • Proven ability to detect and respond to modern AI-driven attacks

  • Proficiency in Python to build automated orchestration pipelines, reduce manual incident response toil, and programmatically enrich security alerts

  • Expert-level understanding of cloud security architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container runtime isolation (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Ability to translate incident findings and root-cause analysis into short-term tactical fixes and long-term security engineering objectives

  • Ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis using sandbox environments and modern AI-assisted reverse engineering tools

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with threat hunting or building detection-as-code programs

  • Experience running sensitive investigations alongside Legal and HR, such as insider risk cases

  • Familiarity with large-scale data platforms and using them to analyze security telemetry

  • Contributions to open-source security tooling, detection rules, or the broader security community

  • Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, or GREM

WHY JOIN OUR INCIDENT RESPONSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is an opportunity to shape what incident response looks like in the agentic era. You will work on the front line of defending one of the world's most important data platforms, building the AI-driven workflows that let a team of experts respond with the speed and precision that modern threats demand.

You will work across Detection, Product Security, Cloud, Legal, and HR, see incidents end to end, and turn what you learn into lasting improvements to how Snowflake protects its customers and its people.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Data Transformation (Frontier Engineering)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Data Transformation is the foundational product portfolio that makes enterprise Agentic AI possible. Our mission is to transform the full enterprise data estate. We build the product that guides customers through every layer of a modern AI architecture: from Platform Foundation & Migration, through Data Ingestion & Engineering, to Semantic, Context, Ontology, & Governance layers. By unlocking each layer, we enable customers to deploy Agentic AI with full, governed access to their complete Snowflake data estate. The Data Transformation workflows are some of the most complex enterprise challenges and the most impactful for our customers and for Snowflake.

FRONTIER ENGINEERING

Sitting within Snowflake’s Frontier Engineering organization—a specialized team of Engineers, Product Managers, Solutions Architects, and AI Experts—you will own Snowflake’s Data Transformation product portfolio. Your scope spans intelligent migration products that understand and rewrite legacy application logic, multi-source ingestion pipelines, legacy data warehouse modernization, ETL/ELT transformation, and data platform rationalization. In this role, you will set product vision, lead a team of PMs, and deliver the tooling that turns fragmented legacy infrastructure into an AI-first enterprise platform.

AS A DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT, YOU WILL:

  • Define Vision & Strategy: Own the strategic roadmap across the full transformation stack—from platform migration to semantic and context layers—ensuring every initiative moves enterprises closer to an AI-ready Snowflake platform.

  • Lead & Scale a High-Performing PM Team: Build, mentor, and manage a team of product managers, fostering a culture of high velocity, accountability, and technical rigor.

  • Partner with Engineering Leadership: Deeply engage with technical leaders to shape execution strategies, balancing engineering effort and long-term architectural scalability across complex pipeline and query transformation workloads.

  • Drive Execution with an MVP Mindset: Champion speed and clarity, setting precise roadmap milestones, prioritizing ruthlessly, and ensuring seamless cross-functional alignment.

  • Own GTM & Customer Adoption: Partner with Marketing, field teams, and executive customers to position transformation capabilities, accelerate migrations, and drive platform adoption.

  • Drive Thought Leadership: Serve as an external voice for Snowflake, helping shape the industry narrative around legacy modernization, automated pipeline refactoring, and AI-first data architecture.


OUR IDEAL DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT WILL HAVE:

  • 12+ Years in Data Infrastructure: Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, migration tooling, query engines, or pipeline infrastructure.

  • Proven PM Leadership: Strong experience building, managing, and mentoring high-performing product management teams.

  • Deep Technical Foundation: Hands-on familiarity with modern data ecosystems—including SQL execution, ETL/ELT patterns, declarative pipelines, and workflow orchestration.

  • Applied GenAI Exposure: Practical understanding of AI-assisted capabilities, such as automated code translation, developer co-pilots, semantic validation, and LLM-driven refactoring.

  • Strategic & Analytical Execution: Ability to navigate technical ambiguity, make sound decisions using data and instincts, and reduce time-to-value for enterprise customers.

  • Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for customers, field leadership, and executives.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
