jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Frontier Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

At Snowflake, we are building a high-impact team to help the world's most innovative companies unlock the power of AI. As a Forward Deployed Engineer on our Frontier Engineering team, you will be a hands-on builder and a key technical partner to our most strategic customers, placing you at the forefront of the enterprise AI revolution. You won't just work with cutting-edge technology – you'll deploy it to solve real-world business problems at scale, building production-grade AI systems using Snowpark, Cortex, and our native LLM capabilities.

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Build Customer Solutions: Architect, build, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions, including sophisticated AI agents. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of your workstreams – from prototype to production – directly solving customers' most complex business challenges.

Own the Quality of What You Ship: Define what "good" means for the systems you build. Translate ambiguous customer goals into measurable quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and golden datasets – then run systematic eval loops to hill-climb on agent quality, catch regressions before customers do, and continuously raise the bar on accuracy, faithfulness, and safety. Treat measurement as a first-class part of building, not an afterthought.

Deliver with Velocity: Rapidly design, iterate, and ship high-quality code and pipelines. Translate ambiguous business objectives into robust, scalable, and performant solutions using Python and SQL.

Productionize AI at Scale: Own the full implementation lifecycle for your solutions – from prototype through deployment, monitoring, and optimization in secure, large-scale production environments. Build the safety guardrails, observability, and human-review workflows that keep AI applications reliable and trustworthy, and close the loop from production traces and user feedback back into your evals so quality compounds over time.

Be a Technical Partner: Partner directly with customer data science and engineering teams as a hands-on technical resource and trusted advisor on how to best leverage AI for their business challenges.

Collaborate to Innovate: Work cross-functionally with Snowflake's Product and Engineering teams, sharing real-world feedback from the field to directly influence the future of Snowflake's AI platform.

Have the opportunity to travel: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite, working closely with Snowflake's most strategic customers.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Willingness to travel.

  • Proven experience building applications using LLMs, especially with technologies like RAG and agentic workflows.

  • Hands-on experience defining quality metrics and running evaluations for LLM or agent systems, and using evals to systematically improve quality.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with an ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a desire to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing Generative AI environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building eval sets from production traces and synthetic data, and running structured experimentation (A/B tests, ablations, offline evals) to compare prompts, models, or agent architectures.

  • Familiarity with eval and observability tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Arize, Weave, Promptfoo) or experience building custom eval harnesses.

  • Experience with failure-mode analysis on agent or RAG systems – categorizing errors (hallucination, retrieval miss, planning failure, tool misuse) and driving each down with targeted evals.

  • Hands-on experience with the MLOps lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and evaluation in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Familiarity with core data science libraries and tools (e.g., pandas, numpy, Snowpark).

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., solutions architect, sales engineer, or professional services).

  • Startup experience.

Translate ambiguous customer goals into measurable quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and golden datasets – then run systematic eval loops to hill-climb on agent quality, catch regressions before customers do, and continuously raise the bar on accuracy, faithfulness, and safety. Treat measurement as a first-class part of building, not an afterthought.

Deliver with Velocity: Rapidly design, iterate, and ship high-quality code and pipelines. Translate ambiguous business objectives into robust, scalable, and performant solutions using Python and SQL.

Productionize AI at Scale: Own the full implementation lifecycle for your solutions – from prototype through deployment, monitoring, and optimization in secure, large-scale production environments. Build the safety guardrails, observability, and human-review workflows that keep AI applications reliable and trustworthy, and close the loop from production traces and user feedback back into your evals so quality compounds over time.

Be a Technical Partner: Partner directly with customer data science and engineering teams as a hands-on technical resource and trusted advisor on how to best leverage AI for their business challenges.

Collaborate to Innovate: Work cross-functionally with Snowflake's Product and Engineering teams, sharing real-world feedback from the field to directly influence the future of Snowflake's AI platform.

Have the opportunity to travel: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite, working closely with Snowflake's most strategic customers.




WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Willingness to travel.

 - Proven experience building applications using LLMs, especially with technologies like RAG and agentic workflows.

 - Hands-on experience defining quality metrics and running evaluations for LLM or agent systems, and using evals to systematically improve quality.

 - Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with an ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a desire to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing Generative AI environment.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building eval sets from production traces and synthetic data, and running structured experimentation (A/B tests, ablations, offline evals) to compare prompts, models, or agent architectures.

 - Familiarity with eval and observability tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Arize, Weave, Promptfoo) or experience building custom eval harnesses.

 - Experience with failure-mode analysis on agent or RAG systems – categorizing errors (hallucination, retrieval miss, planning failure, tool misuse) and driving each down with targeted evals.

 - Hands-on experience with the MLOps lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and evaluation in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Our Solution Engineering organization is seeking an AI Specialist who can provide hands-on expertise and support while working with technical decision makers and data scientists to design and architect AI solutions built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

This is a strategic role that works closely with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and the broader field organization to ensure successful execution and customer adoption of Snowflake’s AI & ML solutions.

 

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Be the technical expert in the room that positions Snowflake’s AI and ML features and value to technical stakeholders at Snowflake’s customers across the Americas.

  • Partner with Snowflake account team teams and customer champions to scope and drive POCs to success and technical wins that prove the value of Snowflake’s capabilities, including executive readouts and business value cases.

  • Collaborate with Snowflake’s product and engineering teams to influence Snowflake’s AI and ML roadmaps based on customer feedback.

  • Publish content that helps the team and company scale beyond your individual efforts, like blog posts, presentations at conferences, or technical collateral like notebooks and demos.

  • Influence, tailor and maintain Sales Engineering AI and ML selling assets, including customer presentations, demonstrations, and customer stories.

 

ON DAY ONE, WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning and generative AI solutions in the cloud.

  • Familiarity and associated knowledge of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning that are used to operationalize enterprise AI use cases like interactive chat applications or text processing.

  • Deep knowledge of Python and common ML packages (such as LangChain, pandas, sklearn, and PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies like dbt, Airflow, and Spark.

  • Strong presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos.

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred.

 

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

  • Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.

  • Experience and understanding of large-scale infrastructure-as-a-service platforms (e.g. AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, etc.)

  • 1+ years of practical Snowflake experience.

  • Knowledge of and experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Snowflake, Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, etc.)

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager, Data Processing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world's leading data platforms.

The Team

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our Data Processing team in Zurich. You will start with a pizza sized team with the goal to grow further.

The team owns the core engine that makes Observe work. That includes the systems that compiles our query language OPAL into SQL, the query execution pipeline that executes user queries, the scheduler which autoscales warehouses and packs workloads for high utilization and low query latencies, and our incremental view maintenance. Building features in these systems while keeping the system healthy, cost-efficient, and resilient at petabyte scale is a constant challenge. The team sits at the heart of Observe's differentiation: a full observability platform built entirely on Snowflake.

In this role you will

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of backend engineers working on compiler internals, distributed scheduling, query execution, and data materialization. Coach them on their careers and help each of them reach their full potential.

  • Hire top talent, and represent Observe and Snowflake to candidates.

  • Work closely with other Observe product and backend teams to plan and execute new product features and scale existing systems to meet new challenges.

  • Work with core Snowflake engineering teams in Germany and the US to integrate Observe more deeply with Snowflake technologies. Communicate Observe's needs clearly and drive improvements in the underlying platform together.

  • Strategically reduce technical debt in the area. Know where it lives, build a plan to pay it down, and balance that plan against new feature work.

  • Keep many ongoing projects moving in parallel, setting clear priorities and making sure nothing important falls through the cracks.

  • Own the operational health of the area: performance, compute cost efficiency, on-call load, and support cost. Lead the team through production incidents and customer escalations, and drive postmortems and follow-up work.

  • Stay close to the code: write, review, and fix code when needed, and dig into real production workloads alongside the team.

Qualifications

  • Proven record managing a team of 5+ engineers that delivered complex backend or infrastructure systems in a fast-paced environment.

  • A background in database systems, such as query processing, query optimization, storage, or compilers.

  • Solid experience building and operating distributed systems.

  • Hands-on engineering skills: able to write, review, and fix production code.

  • Able to run many concurrent projects at once and to prioritize clearly between them.

  • Able to balance short-term operational needs with long-term architecture, and to make cost and performance tradeoffs based on data.

  • Experience running a team that owns production services with on-call responsibilities.

  • Excellent communicator, comfortable working across time zones and organizational boundaries.

  • A bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Snowflake or other large-scale data platforms or databases and knowledge of their internals.

  • Familiarity with the observability space.

  • Experience building an enterprise-grade SaaS product.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and engineered for scale. We ingest and store logs, metrics, traces, and events on an open, scalable data lakehouse, using open formats like Apache Iceberg, at dramatically lower cost. A dynamic Context Graph and chat-based AI SRE provide rich context and automated workflows so teams can move from detection to root cause of production issue and resolution 10x faster.

Leading engineering teams at companies like Capital One, Topgolf, and Dialpad rely on Observe to troubleshoot hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining reliability at enterprise scale. As part of Snowflake, Observe combines startup-style ownership and velocity with the global reach, operational excellence, and ecosystem of one of the world’s leading data platforms.

The Team:

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise for our Engineering team at Observe by Snowflake.

In this role your will:

  • Design, build, and own core features, APIs, and business logic powering a high-performance observability platform for enterprise customers

  • Take end-to-end ownership from technical scoping and architecture through deployment, ensuring systems meet enterprise reliability and performance standards

  • Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and data teams to deliver solutions that enable fast, actionable insights for engineering teams worldwide

  • Partner with SREs and customer-facing teams to diagnose and resolve production issues, applying AI-assisted workflows to accelerate root-cause analysis

  • Contribute to high engineering standards through thoughtful code review, mentorship, and architectural influence

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on backend application systems or distributed platforms

  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems at scale, handling high throughput, low latency, and enterprise reliability requirements

  • Strong proficiency in one or more server-side languages such as Go, Java, Scala, Python, or similar

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical problems from scoping through delivery, without waiting to be directed

  • Experience collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a track record of shipping impactful, customer-facing work

  • A BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with observability platforms, telemetry pipelines, or distributed tracing and logging systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger)

  • Experience building or contributing to AI-assisted developer tools or LLM-integrated workflows

  • Background in SRE practices, incident response automation, or root-cause analysis tooling

  • Open-source contributions to observability, data infrastructure, or developer productivity projects

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Trust & Platform Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Software Engineer for our Trust & Platform Security team. This team is building the next generation of cyber security monitoring for Snowflake customers where discovery, detection and remediation occurs in the same system. In the agentic era, threats and vulnerabilities occur at machine speed and scale and we are building a platform to detect and respond to these threats in real time. This team is also responsible for building the next generation of network and data enforcement engines: context aware ingress, data exfiltration protection and unified data movement policies for Snowflake's cloud security infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of security policy and system enforcement, building features that help keep perimeter controls robust, scalable, and integrated with context-aware access frameworks.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build and ship components to detect security vulnerabilities and threats, shadow AI and other agentic threats.

  • Develop data loss and ransomware detection mechanisms and ensure signals yield low false positive rates.

  • Write and contribute to design documents for product features, with attention to reliability, latency, and auditability

  • Work with senior engineers and Product Management to turn requirements into well-scoped tasks and deliver them independently

  • Write well-tested, secure code and take part in code reviews

  • Own features through implementation, testing, and production rollout with guidance from senior teammates

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Working knowledge of network security fundamentals (TLS/SSL, HTTP/S, DNS), Zero Trust principles, or Data Loss Prevention (DLP) concepts

  • Solid coding skills in SQL, Java, Python and exposure to building distributed or backend systems and willingness for full stack exposure

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and their security or networking controls

  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow ownership over larger parts of the system

  • Clear communication and comfort collaborating with cross-functional partners

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Exposure to cloud-native security controls (e.g., VPC Service Controls, Private Link)

  • Experience with egress control, network perimeter enforcement, or policy engines

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling

  • Contributions to open-source security projects, security research, or CTFs

WHY JOIN OUR TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will work on security controls that protect customer data across Snowflake, at a scale few companies operate. This is an early-career role with real ownership: you will ship production features in a high-impact security area while learning from experienced infrastructure and security engineers.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Software Engineer – Metadata

Company Pitch

Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud. Thousands of organizations run their most critical data, analytics, and AI workloads on our platform. We built Snowflake for the cloud from day one: near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Our goal is to make every organization's data instantly useful and always available.

Team Pitch

The Metadata team owns the brain of Snowflake. Every query, table, transaction, and permission depends on the metadata layer we build. Our systems handle millions of metadata operations per second. We also power cross-region and cross-cloud replication and failover, keeping customer data available through outages. If you want hard distributed-systems problems with direct customer impact, this is the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design of core metadata and replication systems across multiple teams.

  • Set technical direction for scalability, consistency, and fault tolerance of the metadata layer.

  • Drive cross-region and cross-cloud replication toward lower RPO and higher reliability.

  • Solve hard problems in performance, availability, and correctness at global scale.

  • Partner with Product and architects to turn customer needs into durable designs.

  • Raise the operational bar through observability, safe rollouts, and blast-radius controls.

  • Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders on the team.

Requirements

Core Requirements:

  • 10+ years building large-scale distributed systems or database internals.

  • Strong development skills in Java or C++.

  • Proven record leading multi-team technical initiatives from design to production.

  • Deep understanding of consistency, transactions, and fault tolerance.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Any of the following would make you a stronger candidate:

  • Experience with FoundationDB or other distributed key-value stores.

  • Experience building replication, disaster recovery, or geo-distributed systems.

  • Experience with database metadata, catalogs, or query compilation.

  • Experience running services on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our Majors sales team is expanding and we are seeking a qualified Account Executive, Media & Entertainment with expertise in the industry and a “hunter” mentality. In this role you will use your creative prospecting skills to strategically pursue net new business and customer acquisition.

Your role will encompass prospecting, developing, and closing business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability and be open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team carries a deep curiosity to learn and are always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers needs.

 


AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

 - Become an expert on Snowflake’s product and conduct discovery calls, customized demos, and presentations to prospective customers

 - Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace

 - Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

 - Land, adopt, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

 - Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

 - Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

 


ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

 - 10+ years  sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

 - A track record in securing new logos

 - Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML

 - A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

 - The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

 - This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

 - A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment

 - Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

 - Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Principal Customer Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This position requires a hybrid work schedule with regular in-person attendance at our Menlo Park.

WHO WE ARE

Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud, a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Inside the AI Data Cloud, organizations unite their siloed data, easily discover and securely share governed data, and execute diverse analytic workloads. Wherever data or users live, Snowflake delivers a single and seamless experience across multiple public clouds. Snowflake's platform is the engine that powers and provides access to the AI Data Cloud, creating a solution for data warehousing, data lakes, data engineering, data science, data application development, and data sharing. Join Snowflake customers, partners, and data providers already taking their businesses to new frontiers in the AI Data Cloud. snowflake.com\


WHO YOU ARE
Snowflake is seeking a strategic, customer-obsessed Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy Programs to lead and scale Snowflake's flagship global advocacy programs, turning our most valued customers into powerful brand champions on the world's biggest stages.

You are the architect of Snowflake's most visible customer programs: iconic billboard campaigns, customer activations around LA28, our executive Customer Advisory Board (the Black Diamond Council), and Alpine Club, our premier co-marketing program for Snowflake's most strategic customers. At the same time, you are grounded in the fundamentals of customer marketing: identifying, recruiting, and nurturing the right customer voices, building durable advocacy, and translating customer outcomes into stories that create mutual value across the customer lifecycle. You see customer advocacy as a growth lever, not just a program, a way to deepen trust with strategic accounts, inform business and product strategy, and act as a true partner to Sales.

You thrive at the intersection of executive relationship management, program strategy, and creative ambition. You know how to earn the trust of a Fortune 500 CDO, design experiences executives want to be part of, navigate complex brand and legal approvals, and orchestrate a cross-functional team from concept through launch. You are equally comfortable facilitating a room of senior technology leaders and in a working session with a creative agency, and you operate with a bias toward bold ideas, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and a deep commitment to making the customer the hero.

This role reports to the Director of Customer Marketing and partners closely with Brand, Creative, Media, Events, PR, Product Marketing, Social, Web, and Sales teams, as well as Snowflake's external agency partners.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the strategy and end-to-end execution of Snowflake's customer advocacy programs, including billboard activations, LA28 customer activation, the Black Diamond Council, and Alpine Club

  • Lead billboard strategy and activation, identifying customer stories through creative development, customer approvals, media placement, launch, and amplification

  • Develop and execute Snowflake's LA28 customer activation strategy, designing differentiated experiences and storytelling moments that engage strategic customers and showcase their innovation

  • Lead engagement and strategic programming for the Black Diamond Council, Snowflake's executive-level Customer Advisory Board, including in-person meetings, virtual sessions, member communications, and recruitment

  • Translate Black Diamond Council insights into actionable recommendations that inform Snowflake's business, product, and marketing strategy

  • Oversee Alpine Club strategy, planning, and execution, recognizing and elevating Snowflake's most strategic customers through long-term, multi-faceted brand partnerships

  • Build program frameworks, activation calendars, and repeatable processes that ensure consistency, quality, and impact across all advocacy programs and regions

  • Put the customer first by building trusted, long-term relationships with senior executives at Snowflake's top customers and creating experiences and stories that deliver mutual value

  • Serve as a strategic partner to Sales, using high-visibility programs and executive engagement to strengthen relationships with strategic accounts and support retention, expansion, and growth

  • Serve as the central orchestrator across Brand, Creative, Media, Events, PR, Product Marketing, Social, and Web, owning timelines, dependencies, budgets, and launch readiness

  • Track, analyze, and report on program performance and impact; deliver regular program updates to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

WHAT YOU’LL HAVE

  • A customer-obsessed mindset with an instinct for the stories and experiences that move markets - and the patience and persistence to bring them to life

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives, including CIOs, CDOs, and communications leads, at enterprise-scale organizations

  • Strong understanding of the customer lifecycle and the role customer marketing and advocacy play across acquisition, expansion, and retention

  • Deep experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder advocacy programs, executive programs, or integrated campaigns from strategy through launch

  • Exceptional program and project management skills, with the ability to run multiple high-visibility programs and orchestrate cross-functional teams simultaneously

  • Strong strategic judgment - you know which customers, stories, and moments are ready to go big, and you know how to get them there

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to executives both internally and externally

  • Experience managing agency and vendor relationships and budgets, and translating creative feedback effectively

  • Highly organized, self-directed, and effective operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EDUCATION

  • 8+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, executive programs, or integrated campaign management in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology

  • Experience building and running a Customer Advisory Board or executive community program for senior technology leaders

  • A track record of delivering high-profile brand moments, such as billboard and out-of-home campaigns, major sporting event or sponsorship activations, and marquee event programs featuring recognizable customer brands

  • Familiarity with corporate communications dynamics and the sensitivities of co-marketing with publicly traded or privacy-conscious enterprise brands

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders with confidence and credibility

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

  • Experience with Google Suite, Salesforce, Tableau, and Wrike

LET’S DO THIS!

The Snowflake Customer Marketing team is a small, tight-knit, dynamic group responsible for building and maintaining customer relationships to drive retention, loyalty, and advocacy. These programs represent the pinnacle of that work - putting Snowflake's most strategic customers at the center of our most iconic moments, from billboards to LA28 to the executive boardroom. We're looking for someone who wants to build something, not just manage it. If you want to shape the stories that define how the world sees the AI Data Cloud, we want to hear from you.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee’s duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Service
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

There is only one Data Cloud. Snowflake’s founders started from scratch and designed a data platform built for the cloud that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. But it didn’t stop there. They engineered Snowflake to power the Data Cloud, where thousands of organizations unlock the value of their data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. This is our vision: a world with endless insights to tackle the challenges and opportunities of today and reveal the possibilities of tomorrow.

Our product offering runs on multiple cloud providers, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Our infrastructure self-optimizes and provides high availability and data protection across cloud providers, so our users can focus on using their data, not managing it.

Our team is the Compute Service team. We build and operate the systems that schedule and run warehouse-backed work beyond a user’s interactive query: asynchronous and scheduled compute, elastic capacity for parts of live queries, and the scheduling control plane those workloads run on. We balance usability, performance, cost, and reliability for the teams and customers that depend on this compute.

We are actively hiring talented distributed systems developers. This role is an opportunity to shape the architecture and operation of core services that the rest of Snowflake runs on.

As a Senior Distributed Systems Engineer at Snowflake you will:

  • Solve real business needs at large scale by applying software engineering and analytical problem solving.

  • Design and implement scalable distributed systems for scheduling, queueing, dispatch, and completion of warehouse-backed work.

  • Analyze fault tolerance, high availability, performance, and scale challenges, and solve them.

  • Build admission control, isolation, and capacity management so shared compute stays fair and predictable.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives, and collaborate with engineers, product managers, and technical program managers across teams.

  • Judge trade-offs among consistency, durability, latency, and cost, and build systems that meet the demands of rapidly growing services.

  • Ensure operational readiness of the services, and meet commitments to customers on availability and performance.

Our ideal distributed systems engineer will have:

  • Substantial industry experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

  • Experience building large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant services and control planes, including compute placement, queueing, and monitoring.

  • A strong understanding of operating-system concepts, including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, performance, and scale.

  • Strong computer-science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Systems programming skills, including multi-threading and concurrency. Fluency in Java is preferred.

  • A track record of identifying problems and implementing creative solutions.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • A BS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is a plus.

Why join the engineering team at Snowflake?

  • Build an industry-leading cloud data platform.

  • Solve challenging technical problems in parallel and distributed systems, resource management, scheduling, and large-scale system operation.

  • Work closely with partner teams, understand their use cases and needs, and choose the right problem to solve at the right time.

  • Contribute to a highly scalable and reliable cloud platform that runs on a very large fleet of machines, and to the Java systems that schedule and execute work on it.

  • Join a world-class team of industry veterans and rising engineers.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who thrives at the intersection of data, AI, and complex enterprise architecture. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the data challenges of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, deliver compelling data-driven demonstrations, and support enterprise Proof of Concepts that showcase measurable business outcomes.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion for transforming how organizations use data — from raw ingestion to real-time analytics to AI-powered applications. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are equally comfortable whiteboarding a medallion architecture with a data engineering team and presenting data ROI to a C-suite, and you bring deep opinions about what good data platform design looks like.

Location Requirement: Must be in North Carolina or South Carolina.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Present Snowflake's Data Cloud vision to data engineering leaders, analytics teams, data scientists, and executive stakeholders at prospects and customers

  • Lead hands-on technical discovery to map a customer's existing data architecture — pipelines, warehouses, lakehouses, governance gaps — and design a Snowflake-native path forward

  • Build and deliver tailored demos and proof of concepts across Snowflake's full data platform: data engineering (Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe), AI/ML (Cortex AI, ML model registry), and data sharing (Data Clean Rooms, Marketplace listings)

  • Guide customers through modern data architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, real-time streaming pipelines, and unified governance frameworks

  • Translate ambiguous business problems — churn prediction, supply chain visibility, financial consolidation, operational analytics — into concrete Snowflake data solutions

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

  • Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

  • Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

  • Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

  • Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

  • Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

  • A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

  • University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

  • Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

  • Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

 

ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

 

ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Our built-for-the-cloud architecture delivers the performance of a data warehouse, the flexibility of a data lake, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of traditional costs.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who thrives at the intersection of data, AI, and complex enterprise architecture. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the data challenges of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, deliver compelling data-driven demonstrations, and support enterprise Proof of Concepts that showcase measurable business outcomes.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion for transforming how organizations use data — from raw ingestion to real-time analytics to AI-powered applications. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are equally comfortable whiteboarding a medallion architecture with a data engineering team and presenting data ROI to a C-suite, and you bring deep opinions about what good data platform design looks like.

Location Requirement: Must be in North Carolina or South Carolina.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

 - Present Snowflake's Data Cloud vision to data engineering leaders, analytics teams, data scientists, and executive stakeholders at prospects and customers

 - Lead hands-on technical discovery to map a customer's existing data architecture — pipelines, warehouses, lakehouses, governance gaps — and design a Snowflake-native path forward

 - Build and deliver tailored demos and proof of concepts across Snowflake's full data platform: data engineering (Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe), AI/ML (Cortex AI, ML model registry), and data sharing (Data Clean Rooms, Marketplace listings)

 - Guide customers through modern data architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, real-time streaming pipelines, and unified governance frameworks

 - Translate ambiguous business problems — churn prediction, supply chain visibility, financial consolidation, operational analytics — into concrete Snowflake data solutions

 - Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Field teams to feed customer data architecture patterns back into the product roadmap

 


ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

 - 3–8 years of industry experience, in a pre-sales or solutions architecture role focused on data platforms

 - Deep hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and cloud data warehouse / data lakehouse architectures; able to write working code in a customer session without hesitation

 - Broad experience across the modern data stack: ETL/ELT tools (dbt, Fivetran, Informatica, Spark), streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis), orchestration (Airflow, dbt Cloud), BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 - Proven ability to conduct deep data architecture discovery — understanding a customer's source systems, transformation layers, consumption patterns, and governance requirements — and connect those findings to a Snowflake reference architecture

 - Experience positioning AI and ML capabilities within a data platform context: feature stores, model training pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and AI governance

 - Strong intuition for data governance, quality, and compliance challenges (GDPR, CCPA, PCI) and how platform design decisions affect them

 - Ability to quantify the business value of a modern data architecture — cost reduction, time-to-insight, pipeline reliability, data product monetization

 - A demonstrated track record using AI code generation tools to accelerate prototyping and proof-of-concept delivery

 - University degree in computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's in Data Science or Business Analytics is a plus

 - Experience working with GSIs (EY, Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom, etc.) on large data platform programs is beneficial but not required

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

 - $220,000 - $288,000 OTE (On Target Earnings = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

 - Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

 


ABOUT OUR TEAM:

Our Solution Engineers are customer-obsessed data practitioners. We believe in rigorous discovery before prescribing solutions, we stay honest about what Snowflake can and can't do, and we hold ourselves accountable to outcomes — not just demos. We love to learn, give and receive direct feedback, and are relentless about making our customers' data more accessible, reliable, and valuable. If you have strong opinions about data architecture and enjoy proving them with working code, you'll fit right in.

 


ABOUT SNOWFLAKE:

Snowflake started with a clear vision: make modern data warehousing effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Today the Snowflake Data Cloud goes far beyond warehousing — it's where organizations build data pipelines, run ML workloads, share live data across the ecosystem, and power AI applications, all on a single governed platform. Our built-for-the-cloud architecture delivers the performance of a data warehouse, the flexibility of a data lake, and the elasticity of the cloud at a fraction of traditional costs.

We are hiring a Principal Enterprise Architect, Data and AI for our Applied Field Engineering (Field CTO) team, focused on the Financial Services Industry across Australia. This role sits at the intersection of Snowflake's most strategic FSI customers and our product and engineering organizations, shaping how banks, insurers, and capital markets firms adopt the AI Data Cloud. Success here is measured not by artifacts produced, but by the architecture decisions you influence and the industry outcomes you unlock.

AS A PRINCIPAL ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Serve as the senior technical authority and trusted advisor to CxO and chief-architect stakeholders at Australia's largest financial institutions, translating business strategy into durable data and AI architecture.

  • Define reference architectures and modernization roadmaps for FSI workloads such as risk, fraud, regulatory reporting, customer 360, and generative AI, grounded in the Snowflake platform including Cortex AI and Snowpark.

  • Lead high-stakes architectural engagements end to end, from discovery through to a defensible target-state design that balances governance, data residency, and regulatory requirements.

  • Influence the Snowflake product roadmap by channeling field insight and FSI regulatory needs back to product and engineering teams.

  • Partner with account teams, solution engineers, and SI and GSI partners to unblock the most complex technical decisions and accelerate platform consumption.

  • Set the technical bar for the Field CTO practice in the region, mentoring architects and solution engineers and codifying reusable patterns.

  • Represent Snowflake as a thought leader at executive briefings, industry forums, and regulatory working groups across the Australian FSI market.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture, cloud data platforms, or enterprise architecture, with deep exposure to financial services.

  • A track record of company-wide or industry-wide technical influence, shaping architecture decisions at the most senior stakeholder levels.

  • Deep understanding of data platform, analytics, and AI and machine learning architecture, including modern approaches to generative AI and retrieval-augmented workflows.

  • Fluency in the FSI regulatory and risk landscape, including data governance, residency, privacy, and operational resilience expectations relevant to Australian financial institutions.

  • While the role primarily focuses on Financial Services Industry (FSI), experience in the Telecommunications sector is highly desirable.

  • Proven ability to personally lead technical discovery and solutioning, not only to orchestrate specialists.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills with executive and technical audiences, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, or comparable cloud data platforms across AWS, Azure, or GCP, as a supporting capability.

  • Experience building or advising on generative AI and large language model applications in a regulated environment.

  • Familiarity with the Australian FSI partner, SI, and GSI ecosystem.

  • Prior experience in a Field CTO, office of the CTO, or principal customer-facing architect capacity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to join Frontier Engineering in Sydney. You will lead the technical program across Forward Deployed Engineering engagements, working embedded with strategic customers' engineering teams to take data and AI solutions into production. You will partner with Engagement Managers and Program Managers, and connect customer needs to Snowflake's global Product & Engineering teams.

Frontier Engineering delivers Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements across Data Transformation and Agentic Transformation for strategic enterprise customers. You will work alongside Engagement Managers, who own the customer relationship and engagement commercials, and Program Managers, who own program coordination, reporting, and operating cadence. You will own technical execution across workstreams, including integration, engineering readiness, dependencies, and production delivery.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the integrated technical plan, cross-workstream dependencies and technical risk across multiple FDE workstreams building on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Drive workstreams from engineering readiness through integration, release, production cutover, and operational handoff, resolving blockers across customer and Snowflake engineering teams. Lead release and production cutover of Snowflake-based data and AI solutions.

  • Identify and prioritize customer-driven product gaps and defects, distinguish one-off requirements from recurring product issues, and drive resolution with global Snowflake Product & Engineering teams across time zones.

  • Give technical estimates, effort and risk input to Engagement Managers and Program Managers to protect delivery feasibility.

  • Provide commercial awareness of SOW/exhibit scope, change control and delivery done at risk.

  • Identify scope changes, delivery-at-risk decisions, and emerging technical constraints; provide the impact assessment needed by Engagement Managers to manage SOW scope and change control.

  • Report technical status clearly to Snowflake and customer stakeholders, from engineering teams to executives.

  • Use AI-assisted workflows, including Snowflake Cortex capabilities, to improve delivery tooling and execution.

  • Help establish the FDE Technical Program Management practice in ANZ.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • Typically 8+ years leading complex, multi-workstream technical programs.

  • Hands-on delivery leadership of technical programs into production, such as data platform, MLOps, GenAI/AI, or software and application development projects.

  • Experience leading technical delivery within enterprise customer environments, navigating customer-owned infrastructure, access constraints, and shared delivery responsibilities (e.g. consultancy, SI, vendor professional services).

  • Strong dependency and technical risk management across multiple engineering teams.

  • Technical depth to challenge engineering estimates, assess architectural and integration trade-offs, identify delivery risks, and drive sequencing decisions with engineering leads.

  • The conviction to challenge customers, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders when assumptions, technical decisions, or delivery plans don't hold up.

  • Operates independently in ambiguous environments, exercises sound judgment without waiting for consensus, and takes ownership of getting to an outcome.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience leading forward-deployed engineering engagements, with direct responsibility for integrating solutions into customer environments and taking them to production.

  • Strong point of view and the confidence to challenge customers and senior stakeholders when technical decisions or delivery commitments don't hold up.

  • Willingness to challenge conventional approaches, identify what's not working, and push for a better technical or delivery strategy.

  • Delivery in regulated financial services (e.g. banking, APRA-regulated environments).

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake (Cortex, Openflow) or other cloud data platforms.

  • An engineering manager or tech lead background in data platform or software/application development.

  • Consultancy or Big-4 technical program leadership.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

  • Own a small portfolio of complex public sector accounts, building multi-year strategic account plans that combine consumption expansion with targeted net-new acquisition.

  • Shape and close large, transformational programs that position the Snowflake AI Data Cloud as the enterprise data foundation for whole-of-government data sharing, analytics, and AI.

  • Grow strategic workloads across agencies and business units, including Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, Snowflake Marketplace, secure data sharing and clean rooms, and Snowflake Horizon governance.

  • Engage and influence senior executives, including Department Secretaries, Deputy Secretaries and Business Leaders, CIOs, CDOs, and program sponsors, aligning Snowflake to national digital, data, and AI agendas.

  • Forecast with precision and run rigorous deal strategy using MEDDPICC or a similar methodology across long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

OUR IDEAL ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, PUBLIC SECTOR WILL HAVE:

  • A deep, consistent track record of selling complex technical solutions (SaaS, cloud, data, or AI) into the largest, most strategic public sector or enterprise accounts.

  • Proven success closing large, multi-year, multi-million dollar agreements and growing them through disciplined expansion.

  • Demonstrated ability to run both expansion and acquisition motions within a strategic, named-account portfolio.

  • Established credibility with senior government executives and the ability to influence at the most senior levels of an organisation.

  • Expert command of public sector procurement, enterprise agreements, and the security and data sovereignty requirements that shape major government technology decisions.

  • Experience leading virtual account teams and partner ecosystems to deliver complex, high-visibility programs.

  • Mastery of MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification framework, with a reputation for accurate forecasting.

  • Strong existing relationships with global systems integrators and hyperscalers serving the public sector.

  • Background driving consumption-based growth across large, decentralised organisations.

  • Ideally experience working with large Public Sector Agencies such as Health and ACC

  • Strategic thinking about how to advance all of government outcomes and cross agency value

  • Proven strategic engagement skills: the ability to navigate multi-stakeholder environments, challenge the status quo, and shape long-term, outcome-based agency roadmaps rather than transactional deals.

  • Fluency in New Zealand government procurement, including tenders, framework agreements, and multi-level approval processes.

  • Experience articulating the value of data, analytics, or AI platforms to non-technical and technical agency stakeholders alike.

  • The energy, independence, and low-ego collaboration style to help revamp and grow a strategic public sector book with ambition.

  • Experience helping public sector organizations adopt AI and generative AI use cases responsibly.

  • Existing relationships across New Zealand public sector agencies.

Location: Bangalore, India | Workplace: Hybrid
Team: Solutions Engineering | Business Unit: Go-to-Market

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to help customers across India turn complex data and AI priorities into measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical expertise, consultative discovery, and executive communication to shape secure, scalable solutions on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

 

AS A SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Lead technical discovery with customers and translate business priorities into architectures built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Design and demonstrate solutions using Snowflake capabilities such as Cortex AI, Snowpark, Dynamic Tables, Streamlit in Snowflake, and secure data sharing.

  • Build proofs of concept that validate performance, governance, interoperability, and business value for high-priority customer workloads.

  • Advise customers on modernizing data platforms and migrating analytical workloads to Snowflake while reducing complexity and operational overhead.

  • Partner with Account Executives, Product Management, Professional Services, and Snowflake partners to develop account strategies and remove technical barriers.

  • Guide customer stakeholders on security, governance, privacy, and responsible AI patterns using Snowflake Horizon and related platform controls.

  • Influence technical and executive decision makers through clear architecture narratives, workshops, demonstrations, and value-focused presentations.

  • Mentor Solutions Engineering peers and contribute reusable field assets, reference architectures, and product feedback that improve execution across the region.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in solutions engineering, data architecture, cloud platforms, analytics, or an equivalent customer-facing technical role.

  • A strong foundation in data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, and enterprise security.

  • Experience leading technical discovery and designing solutions for complex enterprise requirements.

  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, business leaders, and executives.

  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and at least one major cloud platform as supporting capabilities for solution design and validation.

  • A record of influencing customer decisions through consultative problem solving, demonstrations, and proofs of concept.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to lead across sales, product, services, partners, and customer teams without direct authority.

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with Snowflake, Cortex AI, Snowpark, Streamlit in Snowflake, or native application development.

  • Familiarity with GenAI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation, model governance, and AI-assisted solution engineering workflows.

  • Experience supporting data platform modernization or migration programs in large enterprises.

  • Knowledge of data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations relevant to customers in India.

  • Experience mentoring technical presales professionals or leading cross-account technical initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager and Evangelist, ASEAN
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

 
 

BUILD WHATS NEXT FOR AI AND DATA IN ASEAN

This is not a typical product marketing role.

At Snowflake, you’ll help shape how the ASEAN market understands, adopts, and accelerates the future of the AI Data Cloud. You’ll sit at the intersection of product marketing, technical evangelism, go-to-market strategy, and industry influence—bringing together customers, partners, sellers, and marketers around one of the most important technology shifts of our time.

If you thrive on turning complex technology into market momentum, love being in front of customers and communities, and want to make a visible impact in one of the world’s most exciting growth regions, this role was built for you.

 
 

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

Snowflake is scaling fast, and ASEAN is a strategic growth market. In this role, you won’t just support the business—you’ll help define how Snowflake wins in-region.

 

You’ll be the voice of Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud across the market, translating innovation into relevance for customers, shaping go-to-market strategy, and influencing adoption at scale. With more than 13,000 customers already using Snowflake to modernize data access, accelerate analytics, and unlock data-driven insight, you’ll help drive the next wave of growth powered by AI.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead Snowflake’s Product Marketing and Evangelism efforts across the ASEAN market.

  • Build and execute go-to-market strategies and innovative programs that strengthen Snowflake’s market position and accelerate growth.

  • Evangelize the AI Data Cloud through speaking engagements, social media, video, and community engagement across customers, partners, media, analysts, and broader industry audiences.

  • Develop compelling messaging, content, and sales enablement assets for Snowflake teams and partner teams.

  • Partner cross-functionally with demand generation, content marketing, sales, product management, and global stakeholders to align and execute regional go-to-market plans.

  • Own and lead end-to-end product launches for ASEAN, including internal and external briefings, spokesperson support, enablement content and sessions, and alignment with marketing and PR on launch campaigns and events.

  • Build market and competitive intelligence, and serve as a thought leader on the trends shaping the industry.

  • Champion diversity and belonging as part of how we work, lead, and grow as a company.

 
 

WHAT MAKES YOU A STAND OUT

You’re equal parts strategist, storyteller, and technologist. You can move comfortably from executive conversations to technical narratives, from launch planning to live evangelism, and from market insight to field execution.

 

Our ideal candidate brings:

  • 15-20+ years of experience spanning technology, product, and market-facing roles, with strong exposure to data management and AI/ML.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to influence without authority and work effectively with senior stakeholders.

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging internal leaders, external stakeholders, and public audiences.

  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling presentations and plans.

  • A track record of working on complex data solutions and demonstrating architectural or technical leadership.

  • An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret information and turn it into actionable insight.

  • Strong understanding of both the technical foundations and business value of modern data technologies, across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience with database products.

  • A BS/BA or equivalent practical experience.

  • A proven history of partnering with field GTM teams—across marketing, sales, and solution engineering—to create high-impact content and messaging that connects with diverse personas, from technical practitioners to C-level executives like the CMO, CFO, and CRO.

  • Deep insight into the unique technological landscape and market dynamics across the ASEAN region.

  • Professional fluency in regional languages including Bahasa, Mandarin, Cantonese or Thai is strongly advantageous, complementing English proficiency.

 

WHY SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is growing quickly, and we’re building a team of people who challenge conventional thinking, move with urgency, and create meaningful impact. We care deeply about our people, customers, culture, and values—and we’re looking for people with the growth mindset to solve for today while building for the future.

If you want a role with visibility, influence, and the opportunity to shape one of the most important categories in enterprise technology, this is your moment.

 
 

READY TO MAKE YOUR IMPACT

Join Snowflake and help define how the AI Data Cloud wins in ASEAN.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
