jobs.title: Senior Workplace Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are seeking a proactive, highly adaptable Senior Workplace Technician to be the full-time, on-site anchor (Mon–Fri) of our office campus. You are a natural self-starter who brings a warm approachable energy, a customer-first mindset and a sharp eye for the details that make a workplace feel exceptional.
Beyond your technical and practical know-how, your greatest strength lies in taking complete ownership—stepping up in grey areas, adapting to quick pivots, and executing high-impact solutions with ease.

GENERAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

In this role, you will keep our daily office environment running smoothly by taking ownership of a diverse set of workplace and operational functions, including:

  • Lead physical office modifications, move/add/change (MAC) activities, furniture assemblies, and spatial reconfigurations.

  • Skilled in both digital workplace platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, ticketing systems, space planning apps) and practical, hands-on physical execution like furniture assembly, basic repairs, and everyday maintenance.

  • Oversee campus EV charging stations by monitoring usage, troubleshooting technical issues on the spot, and partnering directly with vendors for hardware or software resolutions.

  • Operational Optimization: Stay three steps ahead by spotting bottlenecks early and bringing fresh, creative ideas to make our physical facilities run smarter and more efficiently.

  • Builds strong in-person relationships with cross-functional partners and team members to plan, coordinate, and deliver exceptional everyday workplace services.

  • Resolve facilities tickets efficiently and with care, keeping communication transparent and ensuring every workplace request is handled to the highest standard.

  • Manage project budgets efficiently: monitoring spend, driving cost-effective vendor solutions, and maintaining tight fiscal responsibility across all on-site initiatives.

  • Vendor Management: Manage on-site third-party vendors and contractors, ensuring service partners consistently meet standards of accountability and performance quality.

    WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience: You’ve spent 5+ years in facility operations, managing multi-floor spaces or large corporate campuses where things move fast. If you have trade certifications (IFMA, BOC, LEED AP, or similar), that's definitely a big plus in our book.

  • Ownership & Initiative: Drive project results from conception to completion with minimal supervision, keeping key stakeholders updated every step of the way.

  • Self-Starter Energy: You don't wait for a manual. You love taking ownership, solving unstructured problems, and getting things done.

  • Customer-Obsessed: You care deeply about people, bring great energy to every interaction, and take pride in crafting spaces people love working in.

  • Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive in fast-paced environments, ride the waves of change effortlessly, and stay cool under pressure.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving skills, strong verbal and written communication, and a customer-service mindset.

  • On-Your-Feet Readiness: Ready to move, lift up to 50 lbs, assemble or configure setups, and jump in to support occasional cool workplace events.

  • In-Office Dedication: Thrilled to be on-site 5 days a week, acting as the anchor for our physical space and community.


DISCLAIMER

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

How do you want to make your impact?

 - Experience: You’ve spent 5+ years in facility operations, managing multi-floor spaces or large corporate campuses where things move fast.  If you have trade certifications (IFMA, BOC, LEED AP, or similar), that's definitely a big plus in our book.

 - Customer-Obsessed: You care deeply about people, bring great energy to every interaction, and take pride in crafting spaces people love working in.

 - Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive in fast-paced environments, ride the waves of change effortlessly, and stay cool under pressure.

 - Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving skills, strong verbal and written communication, and a customer-service mindset. 

 - On-Your-Feet Readiness: Ready to move, lift up to 50 lbs, assemble or configure setups, and jump in to support occasional cool workplace events.

 - In-Office Dedication: Thrilled to be on-site 5 days a week, acting as the anchor for our physical space and community.

You will partner closely with customers to understand their business challenges, then design, build and implement modern data solutions on Snowflake. You'll act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers unlock the full potential of their data, drive insights, power AI initiatives and achieve significant business value with Snowflake.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Migration Leadership: Work across multiple FDE teams, each focused on a specific customer. Set the architecture and technical direction as teams design, build and deploy the software systems, tooling and automation needed for customer migrations to Snowflake.

  • Software Development: Contribute directly to Snowflake's product, as every Migration FDE does. Build prototypes, contribute to feature development and fix the problems we find, helping shape the product roadmap and deepening your product expertise.

  • Customer Collaboration and Enablement: Provide expert technical guidance, mentoring and training to customer teams on using Snowflake effectively, including data management, analytics, AI/ML capabilities and BI/reporting integration.

  • Platform Implementation: Design scalable data pipelines and modern data architectures on Snowflake, ensuring data quality, integrity and efficient processing.

  • Performance Optimisation and Best Practices: Analyse and optimise data models, queries and processing workflows for performance, efficiency and cost. Champion Snowflake best practices.

  • Modern Data Solutions: Evaluate, recommend and implement modern data integration tools and techniques that help customers evolve their data capabilities.

  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve technical challenges, performance bottlenecks and operational issues.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Experience working directly with customers on complex, multi-faceted technical projects

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages, such as Python, Go, Java or C++

  • Experience developing AI/ML applications

  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data warehousing, data lakes and cloud data platforms

  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a customer-facing environment

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

PREFERRED:

  • Experience delivering complex data and application migrations to the cloud

Travel: This role may involve up to 20% travel to collaborate with customers, teams and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Principal Security Architect, Applied Field Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our Solution Engineering organization is seeking a Security Architect to join our APJ Field CTO Office to act as a security evangelist, architect, and hands-on subject matter expert/practitioner. In this role, you will cultivate key customer and partnership relationships, demonstrate thought leadership, and act as a trusted security advisor to current and potential customers. You will also collaborate with internal and external technical and business stake Security Architect, you must share our passion and vision in helping our customers and partners secure their Snowflake Accounts, thrive in a dynamic environment, and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop and deep diving with technical audiences.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Help to scope security related feature enhancements on behalf of customers to work with Product Management on ways to improve the product from a security perspective.

  • Assist in clarifying concepts of data engineering, data warehousing, data collaboration, AI and Machine Learning. Share industry best practices, and features in the Snowflake platform; Assist in building demos and prototypes using Snowflake in conjunction with other integrated solutions; Engage with other relevant Snowflake stakeholders internally.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support in order to drive customer security feature adoption.

  • Partner with our Product Marketing team to define and support Snowflake's AI and Data Cloud posture and Security DataLake workload awareness and pipeline building via marketing initiatives including conferences, trade shows, and events.

  • Work and collaborate with other Field CTO members in areas of: Enterprise AI, Gen AI, Data Engineering, Applications, as a security export you may be involved in collaborative engagements.

  • Partner with the best in the industry product team, helping to shape vision and capabilities for Snowflake Data Marketplace.

  • Share knowledge with internal and industry communities via webinars & conferences.


ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 10+ years of industry, customer-facing, and hands-on implementation experience with a core focus on data concepts, privacy, governance, networking, infosec and security technologies.

  • Strong understanding of security related concepts such as RBAC, OAuth, Identity and Access Management, encryption and data governance.

  • Expertise and in-depth working knowledge and hands-on experience in cloud platforms (at least one of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP), and its corresponding security, data encryption, and networking architecture and technologies.

  • Ability to build out demos, configure CSP environments, build out prototypes, and test use cases on the Snowflake platform and relevant integrations with CSP services and external security tools.

  • Ability to create security and networking-related reference architectures, security best practices and hardening guides, and articulate them to a customer audience.

  • A demonstrated knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK and how to articulate controls and security mechanisms within a Risk Assessment centred approach.

  • Knowledge of ANSI SQL compliant databases and / or data warehousing is preferred

  • AWS/Azure/GCP security and / or networking specialty related certification achievement is a plus

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IP routing, DNS, Proxies and CSP private networking technologies including NAT, Firewalls, TLS and related design and troubleshooting.

  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including cloud service providers like Azure, AWS, and GCP

  • Strong understanding of identity management use cases, including authentication (SAML), authorization (OAUTH), and identity governance (SCIM & RBAC)

  • Deep experience with large-scale infrastructure-as-a-service platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.)

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills, presentation and whiteboarding skills to a large audience, and the ability to successfully communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Fair understanding of the culture diversity across Asia Pacific Japan region and flexibility of working with customers and colleagues from multiple APJ time zones.

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Management Systems, or related field required. Masters preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Solution Engineer dedicated to one of Snowflake's most strategically important enterprise customers. Depending on alignment, your client will sit within either Financial Services or technology, telecommunications & industrial manufacturing. You will own the full technical relationship, drive use case expansion across business units, and act as the go-to trusted advisor to CTO, CDO, and engineering leadership within the account. This is a senior-level, high-visibility role with global scope and direct exposure to Snowflake's leadership.


What You Will Do:

  • Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a single strategic Global Account in financial services or manufacturing/telco, from discovery and technical qualification through proof of concept, technical close, and ongoing expansion

  • Build and deliver compelling demonstrations, solution architectures, and executive presentations that connect Snowflake's platform capabilities to the specific data and AI priorities of enterprise buyers

  • Design and lead proof of concept engagements covering risk analytics, regulatory data platforms, real-time fraud detection, or smart manufacturing, supply chain telemetry, and AI/ML workloads

  • Act as a subject matter expert on enterprise data architecture, translating complex regulatory, operational, and technical requirements into practical, production-ready Snowflake solutions

  • Partner closely with the Account Executive/GAM and leadership as the sole technical owner of the account, co-developing the joint success plan and ensuring technical alignment across every active opportunity

  • Serve as the primary internal advocate for the account within Snowflake, coordinating across Product, Professional Services, Support, and Engineering to resolve blockers and accelerate adoption

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in pre-sales solution engineering, technical consulting, or data engineering in enterprise B2B technology, with significant exposure to financial services or manufacturing/telco customers

  • Deep understanding of enterprise data use cases across financial services or manufacturing

  • Strong hands-on expertise with cloud data platforms, ideally including Snowflake, and the ability to architect and demo enterprise-grade solutions live

  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, and data engineering tools commonly used in enterprise environments (dbt, Spark, Kafka, or equivalent)

  • Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to engage credibly with CDOs, CTOs, and CIOs at global institutions

  • Track record of leading complex technical evaluations, winning competitive PoCs, and building lasting technical relationships with strategic enterprise accounts

  • Experience using AI and LLM-based tools in technical workflows, with the ability to articulate Snowflake's Cortex AI capabilities in an enterprise context

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience working within or selling to global financial institutions or enterprise manufacturers

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake including Cortex AI, data sharing, Snowpark, and Native Apps

  • Familiarity with enterprise cloud migration patterns and the technical landscape of legacy platforms (Teradata, Oracle, Hadoop)

  • Experience with real-time data architectures, streaming ingestion, and event-driven data platforms in regulated or industrial environments

  • Background in data mesh, data product design, or enterprise data governance frameworks relevant to industry compliance and operational requirements

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Identity & Access Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


The Identity & Access Management (IAM) team enables customers to confidently bring their most sensitive data and workloads to Snowflake. We build the authentication and authorization capabilities that help customers secure their Snowflake data and apps, including core AI security capabilities like MCP servers, agent identity and administrative guardrails for agentic workflows.

Our systems are foundational to customer trust, security, reliability, and performance. The team is highly collaborative, with opportunities to learn from and partner with experienced engineers across the organization.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER - IDENTITY & ACCESS MANAGEMENT, YOU WILL:

  • Design and implement secure identity and access management capabilities for Snowflake’s cloud services.

  • Build features that support authentication and authorization for human users, service identities, agents, and external applications.

  • Contribute to AI security capabilities that enable controlled, auditable, and appropriately restricted agent workflows.

  • Develop authorization frameworks that provide fine-grained access control across large numbers of users, objects, and services.

  • Design and implement integrations with identity providers and industry-standard authentication protocols.

  • Build reliable solutions for secure data sharing, application access, and external service integrations.

  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, security partners, and other teams to deliver high-quality projects.

  • Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical decisions, and help improve engineering practices.

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • Experience designing, building, testing, and supporting distributed software systems in production.

  • Strong programming skills in Java, C++, C#, or a comparable language.

  • Understanding of core identity and access management concepts, including authentication, authorization, identity federation, or access control.

  • Familiarity with one or more security protocols or standards, such as SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC, or RBAC.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design.

Security Architect, Applied Field Engineering (AFE)

OVERVIEW

Enterprises are modernizing data platforms at an exponential rate to meet demands for innovation, specifically with the rise of Generative and Agentic AI. As the leading AI and BI platform, Snowflake requires a secure-by-design foundation to drive business value. The Security Applied Field Engineering (AFE) organization is at the forefront of this effort, ensuring that security is a strategic accelerator rather than a bottleneck.

As a Senior Security Architect on the Applied Field Engineering team, you will drive strategic customer engagements and build the prescriptive frameworks required for the modern era. You will transition customers from legacy, siloed security tools to a unified Security Data Architecture. You will partner closely with Sales, GTM, Engineering, and Marketing to help customers transform their business within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud while maintaining a world-class security posture.

 
 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Field Engineering & Security Architecture

  • Security Architecture Foundation: Drive strategic engagements focused on the Security Architecture, ensuring robust foundations across Identity, Data, and Infrastructure for applications built on Snowflake.

  • AI Security & Trust Foundations: Support customer strategy for secure AI adoption, leveraging Snowflake Cortex to bring state-of-the-art LLMs directly to customer data within a secure environment.

    • Architect trusted Agentic AI frameworks where Cortex Agents operate within governed boundaries, autonomously orchestrating tasks while inheriting Snowflake's native security perimeter.

    • Deploy Cortex Guard and AI Observability to filter harmful content and provide transparent, explainable AI interactions through rigorous monitoring and tracing.

    • Ensure AI governance by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and data masking across all AI-driven insights and automated actions.

  • Modern Security Operations (SecOps): Deliver workshops and hands-on engagements to transition customers from legacy infrastructure to advanced SIEM Augmentation, Log Ingestion (Otel/Logs into Snowflake), and Cybersecurity Data Lake.

  • Governance & Identity: Build repeatable reference architectures and frameworks for Identity (IAM), Data Governance, Row-Level Security, and Encryption to accelerate well-architected deployments.

  • Resilience & Compliance: Guide customers through end-to-end journeys for BC/DR (Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery), including multi-region deployment patterns and measurable recovery outcomes.

  • Tooling and Content: Drive the creation of relevant technical content and tooling to showcase security best practices, accelerate new use case deployments, and adoption of new platform functionality.

  • Voice of the Field: Influence product roadmaps by serving as the Voice of the Field to Snowflake's product and engineering teams, translating customer needs into actionable feedback.

Core Experience

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Data, Security, Networking, Infrastructure or AI Engineering

  • Communication Skills: Strong technical communications skills with the ability to deliver compelling demos, whiteboard sessions, and presentations to both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Customer-facing Skills: The ability to act as a trusted advisor and establish credibility with senior leadership and enterprise architects.

Relevant Security Skill Sets

  • Generative AI Security: Deep understanding of LLM security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage) and mitigation strategies using tools like Cortex Guard.

  • Agentic AI Governance: Expertise in governing Autonomous Agents, ensuring "Human-in-the-loop" controls and auditability for agent-driven actions.

  • Data Privacy for AI: Mastery of techniques like Differential Privacy, Data Masking, and Secure Sandboxing to protect sensitive training and inference data.

  • Platform Observability: Proficiency in observability techniques including logging, monitoring, and distributed tracing on a platform level.

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Expertise in modern authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect) and implementing robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models across cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Secure Networking: Hands-on expertise in securing cloud and hybrid network architectures, including micro-segmentation, zero-trust principles, and secure deployment of services like Apache NiFi.

  • Programming: Hands-on expertise with SQL, Python, and APIs.

  • Container and Kubernetes Security: Proficiency in securing the container lifecycle, from build (image scanning) to runtime (Pod Security Standards, network policies, service mesh), and managing secrets within Kubernetes.

  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC): Strong background in aligning security programs with regulatory frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and managing security risk through continuous monitoring and auditing.

Compliance & Standards (nice to have)

  • AI Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of emerging AI regulations (e.g., EU AI Act) and their impact on enterprise data strategy.

  • Trust Certifications: Familiarity with how Snowflake’s AI Trust Center maps to SOC2, HIPAA, and HITRUST requirements for AI/ML workloads.

  • Industry Certifications: CISSP

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

For every enterprise ready to harness the AI Data Cloud, there is a complex web of legacy systems that can take years and millions of dollars to untangle. We believe generative AI is the key. We are building products that don't just move data, but understand and rewrite the logic of entire data applications.

We are hiring a Software Engineering Manager, AI Migrations (Forward Deployed) to work at the intersection of customer delivery and product engineering. Your team will be the bridge between field realities and product innovation, turning hard-won migration patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER, AI MIGRATIONS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

Lead and develop the team

  • Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, giving clear feedback and building growth paths

  • Recruit, hire and onboard engineers who can succeed in both customer delivery and engineering

  • Grow technical delivery leads and engineering leaders, including staff-level engineers

  • Foster a culture of creativity, innovation and practical decision-making

Deliver customer migrations

  • Lead complex migrations from legacy platforms such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza and SQL Server to Snowflake

  • Provide strategic oversight so projects align with customer objectives and Snowflake's goals

  • Act as the primary escalation point for delivery, working closely with customers and system integrators

  • Stay hands-on in strategic projects to assess quality and unblock teams

  • Partner with sales teams to scope opportunities, estimate effort, develop proposals and support account strategy

Build AI-powered migration products

  • Drive the design, development and iteration of AI-powered migration tools based on real customer needs

  • Guide the team in building AI-first products, including code translation, developer co-pilots and semantic validation

  • Turn field insights into engineering roadmap items and product improvements

  • Partner with Engineering and Product Management to align priorities and deliver high-quality solutions

  • Develop and share best practices, utilities and accelerators that speed up migrations and feed back into the product

Drive cross-functional impact

  • Influence go-to-market strategy and lead improvements across Sales and Engineering

  • Encourage knowledge sharing between field engineers and product engineering teams

  • Present migration strategy, product vision and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences

OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • A university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 7+ years of experience in technical roles spanning customer-facing delivery and engineering

  • 5+ years of people management experience, mentoring and developing technical teams

  • 3+ years of experience building and delivering enterprise software products, ideally involving AI/ML or developer tools

  • A proven track record of leading teams through complex data platform migrations and cloud transformations

  • A strong foundation in databases, data warehousing and data processing, with hands-on experience on large-scale systems such as Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, SQL Server, Greenplum or Hadoop

  • A deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and the full data analytics stack, including ETL, data platform design and BI

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in SQL and scripting (Python, Perl or Bash)

  • Experience scoping engagements, including delivery estimates, proposals and project plans

  • The flexibility to step into product manager, program manager or architect roles when needed

  • Excellent presentation skills for technical and executive audiences

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • Experience with data integration and transformation tools such as Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion or dbt

  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, MicroStrategy or Business Objects

  • Experience building GenAI-powered developer tools, such as code translation or co-pilots

We are growing our Global Communications team and hiring a Director of Product PR to own the global Product PR function and shape Snowflake’s AI narrative. This high-impact leadership role drives communications across the company's end-to-end product portfolio, translating complex innovations into compelling stories. You will lead product launches, AI-native partnerships, M&A communications, and executive visibility, including direct C-level communications strategies. We are looking for a strategic powerhouse and modernized media thinker who can seamlessly pivot from advising the C-suite on high-stakes decisions to architecting 360° global campaigns and immersive press experiences.

AS A DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT PR, YOU WILL:

  • Own the Global Product PR Function: Shape Snowflake's AI narrative and drive communications across the end-to-end product portfolio. Translate complex innovations into compelling stories and lead PR for product launches, AI-native partnerships, customer success, and more.

  • Drive Executive Communications: Lead the communications strategy for Snowflake’s product executives, shaping messaging for media interviews, thought leadership, and major product announcements. Develop strategic messaging, keynote narratives, and social content for product leadership.

  • Manage 360° Integrated Campaigns: Lead communications campaign management for Snowflake's highest-priority initiatives, aligning global teams and delivering integrated campaigns spanning corporate, product, executive, customer, partner, analyst, employee, and social communications.

  • Modernize Media Strategy: Expand Snowflake's media footprint beyond traditional outlets, securing visibility across podcasts and Substack. Create high-impact, non-traditional journalist experiences, including curated executive dinners and "speed dating" press sessions.

  • Oversee Flagship Events: Lead communications for major events (Snowflake Summit, BUILD/Expedition, and Snowflake World Tour), driving integrated media programs, executive storytelling, reporter engagement, and press experiences that maximize awareness and business impact.

  • Lead and Develop Talent: Manage, mentor, and inspire a high-functioning team of PR professionals, fostering a high-performance, AI-native culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous growth.

  • Innovate with AI: Build and optimize AI-powered workflows to streamline media monitoring, reporting, content development, and other PR operations, always looking for smarter, faster ways to work.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience in public relations, corporate communications, or a related field, with deep expertise in B2B technology and enterprise SaaS.

  • Demonstrated people management experience, with a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and leading high-performing PR and communications teams.

  • A proven track record of owning global Product PR functions, launching complex technical products, and shaping AI or data narratives.

  • Extensive experience working directly with C-suite executives on strategic communications, keynote development, and high-stakes media engagements.

  • Deep expertise in crisis and issues communications, with the ability to remain calm and strategic while advising senior leadership during sensitive moments.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with a talent for translating technical product capabilities into compelling, business-outcome-focused content.

  • A modernized approach to media relations, with strong existing relationships and proven experience leveraging new media (Substack, podcasts) and experiential PR tactics.

  • Experience managing integrated PR for massive-scale tier-one flagship events and global corporate campaigns.

  • A natural curiosity about AI and automation, with demonstrated experience building AI-assisted workflows or integrating new tools into day-to-day work.

  • A bias for action and a builder mentality. You see gaps and fill them without waiting for direction.

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.

This role requires remote and in-office work at our Menlo Park, CA office.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

  • Land, adopt, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

  • Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

  • 6+ years sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

  • This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

  • A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment

  • Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

The Senior Manager will lead strategic sourcing and commercial initiatives across the M&E portfolio, including event agencies, hotels and venues, production partners, destination management companies (DMCs), event technology, and other strategic suppliers. The role will leverage enterprise spend and demand to improve commercial outcomes, strengthen supplier performance, and create greater visibility and consistency across the M&E ecosystem.

Beyond individual sourcing initiatives, this role will help build the infrastructure of a modern M&E program — including preferred supplier strategies, sourcing and contracting standards, service tiers, spend analytics, performance measurement, and self-service capabilities.

Working closely with M&E Operations, Travel, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and business stakeholders, this role will help transform M&E sourcing into a scalable, data-driven global program.

Core Responsibilities

M&E Program Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and execute the global M&E program roadmap.

  • Establish scalable processes, governance, service tiers, sourcing thresholds, and decision frameworks across the M&E lifecycle.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize how meetings and events are sourced across regions and business functions.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that advance the future-state M&E operating model, including playbooks, tools, and self-service capabilities.

  • Drive adoption of new processes and ways of working through stakeholder engagement and change management.

  • Partner with M&E leadership, Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to establish clear roles, responsibilities, and handoffs across strategic sourcing, program governance, and event planning and execution.

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management

  • Lead strategic sourcing for complex and high-value M&E spend, including agencies, hotels and venues, production, DMCs, event technology, and other event-related categories.

  • Develop sourcing and preferred supplier strategies that leverage aggregate enterprise demand and increase purchasing power.

  • Lead complex RFPs, supplier evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contracting in partnership with Procurement, Legal, and business stakeholders.

  • Establish commercial frameworks, preferred terms, and supplier models that optimize cost, service, flexibility, and risk.

  • Develop supplier governance and performance management, including KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, business reviews, and escalation mechanisms.

  • Identify and deliver measurable savings, cost avoidance, negotiated value, and process efficiencies.

  • Establish commercial standards and controls for event-related spend, including pricing transparency, contract terms, payment structures, and cancellation protections.

Analytics & Program Performance

  • Establish visibility into M&E demand, spend, supplier utilization, sourcing activity, and negotiated value.

  • Define and track program KPIs including savings, supplier performance, sourcing cycle time, preferred supplier adoption, and compliance.

  • Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations for leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Use portfolio-level insights to identify opportunities for demand management, supplier consolidation, increased leverage, and program optimization.

Technology, Automation & AI

  • Support the strategy, implementation, and adoption of M&E technology and self-service capabilities.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline intake, sourcing, supplier selection, contracting, and reporting.

  • Apply AI and advanced analytics to improve sourcing decisions, supplier insights, spend visibility, and program efficiency.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to drive adoption and measure the impact of new capabilities.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to event owners and business stakeholders on sourcing strategy, supplier selection, commercial considerations, and appropriate engagement models.

  • Build strong partnerships across M&E Operations, Travel, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and regional teams.

  • Balance business requirements with enterprise standards, commercial objectives, risk, and scalability.

  • Communicate program performance, opportunities, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in meetings & events, strategic sourcing, procurement, category management, program management, or related disciplines.

  • Significant experience sourcing meetings and events and negotiating with agencies, hotels and venues, production partners, DMCs, and other event suppliers.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex RFPs, negotiations, supplier selections, and contracts.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with spend analysis, savings methodologies, and supplier economics.

  • Experience developing preferred supplier strategies and supplier performance programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to build scalable programs and lead complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple regions and business functions.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence in a highly matrixed global organization.

  • Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to translate data into business recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or transforming a global enterprise M&E program.

  • Experience with M&E technology, sourcing platforms, and self-service meeting solutions.

  • Experience developing global supplier strategies and governance models.

  • Experience applying automation, AI, or advanced analytics within M&E, Sourcing, or Procurement.

  • Experience working within a large, global technology organization.

Success Measures

Success will be measured by the development of a scalable global M&E program; measurable commercial value and savings; increased visibility into M&E spend and demand; strong preferred supplier adoption and performance; improved sourcing and contracting efficiency; effective adoption of technology and self-service capabilities; and consistent, data-driven M&E sourcing practices across the organization.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Information Systems Security Engineer (Principal)

About the role

Snowflake's national security deployments are authorized to operate inside classified environments, and each authorization stands or falls on the security documentation behind it. This role owns that documentation. You assess the system against its security control baseline, assemble the evidence the authorizing official reviews, and you are accountable for the package getting to authorization on schedule.

Arc Reactor, a classified deployment for a US government customer, is the immediate assignment. The same work will apply to the deployments that follow it.

What you will do

  • Lead the security control assessment for an assigned deployment, from control selection and tailoring through the body of evidence to authorization.

  • Produce the assessment plan, the evidence collection schedule and the residual risk that goes to the authorizing official, and keep them current.

  • Direct the engineers and security staff producing control artifacts. Tell them which evidence to collect, review what they produce, and catch gaps in the requirements before they surface during assessment.

  • Be the person who can explain a Snowflake control implementation to a government security reviewer, and explain a reviewer's finding back to the engineering team in terms they can act on.

  • Track authorization status and blockers, and report them weekly to the engineering lead and the program.

What you bring

  • You have taken at least one system through authorization to operate under a government security control framework (NIST 800-53 / RMF, FedRAMP, or the DoD RMF and its Impact Levels), and you can point to the package you were responsible for.

  • You can read an engineering implementation and decide which control it satisfies and what evidence it produces.

  • You have worked with government authorizing officials or security control assessors, and you know what they reject and why.

  • You write the plan down. Assessment scope, control status, evidence gaps and residual risk live in a document the team can run without you, not in your head.

  • You are eligible for TS/SCI with a full-scope polygraph, or already hold it.

How this team works

The ISSE does not work alone and does not do all the collection. Engineers and supporting security staff produce the artifacts; you decide what is needed, review it, and own the result. The role reports into national security engineering and sits in the deployment's weekly engineering and security cadence. The work is done from the Washington, DC area, with regular time on site.

How do you want to make your impact?

AS A SENIOR SOLUTION ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Present Snowflake's AI Data Cloud vision to executives and technical teams at retail and telco prospects, showing the value of Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark and Snowflake Horizon

  • Work hands-on through the whole sales cycle: tailored demos, enterprise proofs of concept, solution design and implementation planning

  • Build retail and telco use cases such as customer 360, demand forecasting, personalisation, churn prediction, and data collaboration through Snowflake Marketplace and secure data sharing

  • Stay current on competing and complementary technologies and position Snowflake clearly against them

  • Work with Product Management, Engineering and Marketing to keep improving Snowflake's products and messaging

  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience, ideally in pre-sales or solution engineering

  • Proven experience with Retail or Telecommunications organisations, including their data, business drivers and stakeholders

  • Excellent presentation skills with technical and executive audiences, whether on a whiteboard or in a demo

  • Ability to build and own senior C-suite relationships

  • Broad experience with large-scale database and data warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud platforms, including Data Lake, Data Mesh and Data Fabric patterns

  • Hands-on SQL, SQL analytics and Python skills

  • Ability to connect a customer's specific business problems to Snowflake's solutions

  • A university degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience with global systems integrators (GSIs) such as EY, Deloitte or Accenture

  • Familiarity with retail data (POS, loyalty, supply chain, ecommerce) or telco data (OSS/BSS, network telemetry, subscriber analytics)

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our Majors sales team is expanding and we are seeking a qualified Account Executive with expertise in the industry and a “hunter” mentality. In this role you will use your creative prospecting skills to strategically pursue net new business and customer acquisition.

Your role will encompass prospecting, developing, and closing business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high visibility, high impact projects. You will be successful in this role if you are able to act with autonomy, take accountability and be open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team carries a deep curiosity to learn and are always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers needs.

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Become an expert on Snowflake’s product and conduct discovery calls, customized demos, and presentations to prospective customers

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace

  • Prospect qualification and the development of new sales opportunities and ongoing revenue streams

  • Land, adopt, expand, and deepen sales opportunities with accounts in your region

  • Achieve sales quotas for allocated accounts and/or territory on a quarterly and annual basis by developing a sales strategy in the allocated territory with a target prospect list, and a regional sales plan.

  • Work closely with cross functional teams including sales engineering, professional services, marketing, legal and finance.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 10+ years sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

  • A track record in securing new logos

  • Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

  • This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

  • A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe is a SaaS powerhouse enabling businesses to investigate modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the AI Data Cloud. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join us at the ground floor of this expansion. At Observe, the SDR program isn't just a department—it’s our leadership pipeline. We view our SDRs as the next wave of Account Executives, and we invest in you accordingly.

If you are looking to turbocharge a career in tech sales, this is your training ground. We provide the tools, the mentorship, and the roadmap to turn high-potential talent into elite sales professionals.

What You’ll Experience:

  • Deep Investment: From our 2-week intensive bootcamp to weekly 1-1 mentorship and bi-weekly strategy sessions, we prioritize your growth over everything else.

  • The "In-the-Trenches" Culture: Our leadership team doesn't manage from the sidelines. We work alongside you to hone your business acumen and accelerate your path to productivity.

  • A True Meritocracy: We celebrate diversity and reward results. Our goal is to give you the confidence to generate pipeline, master discovery, and qualify opportunities at an enterprise level.

By joining Observe, you aren’t just taking a job—you’re making an investment in yourself that will define the trajectory of your sales career.

This role is based out of our Menlo Park office.

IN THIS ROLE YOU GET TO:

  • Identify high-potential businesses that would be a good fit to work with Observe across your region

  • Work with the Sales team to develop and lead inbound and outbound campaigns from idea-generation through to qualified call

  • Develop strong sales and product knowledge

  • Interact with engineering decision makers via telephone, LinkedIn and email

  • Update lead and prospect activity in Salesforce to ensure effective lead management

  • Set qualified introductory meetings for the Sales team

  • Nurture early phase opportunities for future pipeline potential

  • Exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity quota

  • Build strong relationships with our marketing team and Account Executives, where we pull together to maximize the win for our business

  • Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • New graduates welcome to apply

  • Fluency in spoken and written English

  • A self-starter with a track record of hitting and exceeding goals

  • Outstanding communication skills including both phone and written communication as well as active listening

  • Extraordinary character with an incredible drive for success, high work ethic, curious by nature, and obsessed with smashing sales goals

  • Validated time leadership skills and ability to work either independently or through coaching

  • Desire to work in a driven and fast-paced environment

  • Passionate about cutting-edge technology with the aptitude to learn new and exciting IT software products, as well as, understand business critical solutions quickly

We are excited to have the ability to return to the office and focus on in-person coaching and growth. Especially in the beginning of your sales career it is crucial to have the ability to be close to your mentors and coaches to quickly ramp.

 

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors

  • Work hands-on with prospects to demonstrate value throughout the sales cycle

  • Maintain deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing teams

  • Support enterprise Proof of Concepts from design to implementation

 

WE WOULD LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE:

  • Extensive experience with Database and Data Warehouse technology

  • Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics

  • Python programming experience

  • Understanding of AI/ML principles and best practices

  • Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent experience

 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • $184,000 - $241,500 On Target Earnings (OTE = Base Salary + Commission/Quota)

  • Estimated Base Salary Range: $138,000 - $181,125

  • Snowflake offers competitive base salary, variable compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits including 401(k), health/dental/vision, flexible PTO, and professional development budget.

We are looking for a Commercial Solutions Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Commercial Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

With AIM Virtualization we’re redefining interoperability for the modern data stack. Our platform makes existing applications instantly work on Snowflake by bringing the core tenets of virtualization to the database. The runtime empowers customers to move to Snowflake without changing SQL or APIs. As a result, AIM Virtualization makes time-consuming migrations obsolete.

As a leader in this team you get to shape how we tackle some of the most intricate database implementation challenges all while pioneering an industry-first framework which customers consistently describe as “too good to be true”.

If you’re looking to empower a high-performance team and accelerate the effective use of AI across the organization, this is the challenge for you. We are looking for an AI-first leader who is not afraid to take on hard and unusual tasks.

As an Engineering Manager, you'll shape the development processes for one of Snowflake's most strategic new products.

AS A SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL

  • Provide strong technical leadership across the entire product suite of AIM-V, including the runtime, tools and utilities, as well as deployment.

  • Drive an AI-based development process across the entire platform, from requirements analysis to design, from development to validation and release.

  • Collaborate with product managers, solution architects, and field engineering to empower our customers.

  • Define and improve our engineering processes around AI-based software synthesis workflows.

  • Solve real business needs at large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem solving skills.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER WILL HAVE

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale systems and enterprise software.

  • 8+ years of experience in managing expert engineering teams.

  • Track record of owning the full software development lifecycle from inception to release.

  • Comprehensive background in SQL and/or other functional programming languages.

  • Solid knowledge of database internals, with emphasis on query parsing, query optimization, and query execution.

  • MS/PhD in Computer Science: databases, high-performance computing, or related fields.

WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

  • Build an industry-leading Cloud Data and AI Platform.

  • Solve challenging technical problems related to security, parallel and distributed systems, programming, resource management, large-scale system maintenance, and more!

  • Work closely with our customers & partners, understand their use cases & needs, think strategically to seek the right problem to solve at the right time, and innovate with rigor.

  • Join a world-class team of both industry veterans and rising stars.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Database Search
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About Database Search

Within this broader Berlin engineering team, Database Search focuses on workload optimization: building core database-engine capabilities that help customer queries run faster by finding and processing data efficiently. The team works on indexing methods, index selection and maintenance, data pruning and skipping, and query optimization for selective SQL queries and other workloads. This work also contributes to Snowflake Optima, which automatically identifies optimization opportunities in customer workloads and seamlessly integrates them so queries get faster over time with minimal user input.

The role

As a Software Engineer, you’ll take on challenging problems inside the database engine, designing, implementing, and improving components across indexing, query optimization, and execution. You’ll drive work from investigation through tested implementation and collaborate with teammates to deliver robust solutions for demanding customer workloads.

What you’ll do

  • Implement, test, and improve database-engine features across indexing, data pruning and skipping, query optimization, and execution.

  • Investigate performance and scalability bottlenecks using debugging, instrumentation, and measurement, then drive fixes through validation.

  • Write maintainable, reliable code and tests in C++ and/or Java.

  • Build and improve components in a highly parallel database engine, reasoning about how changes affect query execution end to end.

  • Work with teammates and partner engineering groups to refine designs, deliver changes, and share results.

  • Evaluate changes against customer workloads and system behavior, and measure their performance impact.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience building software through professional work, internships, research, or substantial personal or open-source projects.

  • Proficiency in C++ and/or Java, with an interest in writing efficient, reliable systems software.

  • Foundational knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and software design.

  • Familiarity with SQL and core database concepts, or a strong interest in developing that knowledge.

  • Foundational understanding of concurrency and multithreading.

  • A proactive, self-motivated approach to hard problems: you take initiative, pursue issues to root cause, and work through ambiguity while communicating progress and incorporating feedback.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Helpful experience

  • Exposure to database internals, query engines, storage engines, indexing, or query execution.

  • Experience analyzing performance in concurrent, multithreaded, or otherwise performance-sensitive systems software.

  • Familiarity with SQL workloads or columnar data formats such as ORC or Parquet.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Billing Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Billing & Payments Platform team builds Snowflake's central systems for customer resource consumption, revenue processing, invoicing, and reporting. Our systems power Snowflake's business and enable every other engineering team. The architectures we ship also serve as reference patterns for customers building on Snowflake.

Computing Snowflake's bills is a distributed systems problem. Usage is metered across every cloud and region. The pricing catalog keeps changing, including new commercial constructs for Cortex AI, Snowflake Intelligence, and the broader agentic portfolio. The same systems have to catch abuse and fraud on a usage-based product, then produce a bill Finance can audit. The bar is accuracy, auditability, and processing that keeps up with usage as it happens.

This is a deeply cross-functional role. You will partner with Product, Finance, Legal, Growth, Go-to-Market Systems, Snowsight, Cortex AI, and product engineering teams to deliver experiences that customers and internal stakeholders depend on every day.

AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON BILLING PLATFORM YOU WILL :

  • Drive multi-team initiatives from an ambiguous business problem through design, launch, and operation, and set the technical approach other engineers execute. Own a bounded project end-to-end when that is the right scope.

  • Build the billing systems that meter, rate, and invoice usage across Snowflake services, on Snowflake's own product. Usage is collected across clouds and regions, then reconciled into an auditable bill.

  • Shape how Snowflake meters, prices, and bills AI products with Cortex AI, Intelligence, and Apps, including token-based inference, agent workflows, and AI-native subscriptions.

  • Be the go-to expert for a primary billing domain — metering, rating, invoicing, contracts, payments, threshold billing, fraud, or reporting — and influence the systems next to it.

  • Own reliability and correctness for what you build. Participate in on-call, debug across unfamiliar areas, and drive systemic fixes to monitoring, alerts, and quality rather than one-off patches.

  • Mentor senior engineers. Review designs, raise the bar on testing and rollout, and help others operate these systems.

  • Partner with Product, Finance, GTM Systems, Growth, Trust, and Legal. Write designs that both engineering and Finance can execute.

OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

  • Significant experience building and operating large-scale production distributed systems, typically 10+ years or equivalent impact.

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems: consistency, fault tolerance, idempotency, exactly-once processing, queueing, and stream and batch pipelines.

Snowflake seeks a Staff Cloud Support Engineers who combine technical expertise, customer empathy, and an AI-first mindset. Key Responsibilities:

As a Staff Cloud Support Engineer, you manage customer cases and are accountable for accelerating their time-to-resolution, ensuring platform stability, and driving a world-class support experience. Operating as a full-stack technical support resource, this role blends deep hands-on troubleshooting with the customer empathy and communication skills of a trusted advisor.

Customer Value and Incident Ownership

  • Own the Customer Experience: Manage customer issues from initial triage through resolution and follow-up, ensuring clear communication and timely updates.

  • Deliver Support Value with AI: Leverage AI assistants and diagnostics to accelerate triage and root-cause analysis while maintaining accuracy and safety standards.

  • Outcome-Based Support: Focus on business impact, ensuring resolutions fix issues, reduce recurrence, and improve reliability.

  • Customer Empathy and Communication: Provide technical analysis and guidance via email, web, and phone, adapting to customer expertise levels.

Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • AI-Assisted Triage: Use AI to summarize logs, generate hypotheses, and draft responses—critically validating outputs before sharing.

  • Tooling Expertise: Utilize Snowflake environment, connectors, and internal tools to investigate and test solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to resolve systemic issues.

  • Knowledge Management: Document solutions in knowledge bases, refining AI-assisted drafts for quality.

  • Feedback and Innovation: Provide input on product behavior, documentation gaps, and AI-tool performance.

  • Bug Reporting: Document and collaborate on bugs and feature requests with engineering teams.

  • Operational Coverage: Support holiday/weekend rotations and on-call requirements

Our ideal Staff Cloud Support Engineer will have:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in technical support (customer-facing, ideally 24x7).

  • Strong AI fluency, including prompt engineering, context management, and the ability to critically validate AI outputs and know when to fall back to manual investigation.

  • Experience with AI-powered tooling (e.g., coding assistants/agentic IDEs) and modern support environments.

  • Solid technical troubleshooting skills, including comfort with SQL, log analysis, and scripting/automation (e.g., Python, APIs, workflow tools) to diagnose issues and streamline tasks.SQL, log analysis, and scripting skills (Python, APIs).

  • Strong written/verbal English communication.

  • Extensive experience with major public cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and GCP

  • Experience in Database systems and SQL queries

  • Experience in Identity Access Management (IAM) and Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC)

  • Experience in implementing and troubleshooting data sharing features, including secure views, shares in Snowflake or any other vendors

  • Experience of Data Replication, Tasks, and cron scheduling concepts

  • Experience in troubleshooting platforms that support marketplace functions

  • Deep understanding and experience of

    • Database systems and SQL queries

    • Data Warehouse fundamentals and concepts

  • Extensive experience working with data governance capabilities - Data Quality Monitoring, Data Privacy, Row/Column Security Policy, Data Lineage and Dependencies

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to diagnose and resolve data governance issues in the policy definition/application of the policy.

  • Experience in configuring and troubleshooting drivers such as ODBC, JDBC

  • Extensive experience working with:

    • Web security, networking technologies, and protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, load balancers, proxies, and firewalls.

    • Troubleshooting a variety of operating systems like Windows, Mac, *Nix

    • Troubleshooting connectivity issues using a variety of diagnostic tools and methods

    • Encryption technologies

  • Experience in Authentication and Authorization protocols (SAML SSO, Key pair, OAuth, MFA)

  • Experience in Identity Access Management (IAM) and Role-Based Access Controls (RBAC)

  • Experience in a number of the following

Preferred:

  • Snowflake or cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Advance Workflow automation / CI/CD tooling experience

  • AI-powered support or SRE workflow experience

  • Relevant certifications (SnowPro, cloud certs)

  • Public cloud certification on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud (GCP)

  • Scripting/coding experience in any of the following: Python, Java, .Net, NodeJS, R

  • Understanding of architectural aspects of the data governance framework of Snowflake or of any other vendor.

  • Security-related certifications such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CISM, CISSP, CSSP, CCSK, Security+ CCNA

  • Architectural knowledge in security concepts such as RBAC, OAuth, SAML, SSO, MFA, Identity and Access Management (IAM), encryption

How do you want to make your impact?
