Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

 

We're looking for a curious, driven Sales Development Representative based in Sydney to help grow Snowflake's footprint across the Australian market. You'll partner with our Account Executives and Marketing team to open conversations with data and technology leaders, build qualified pipeline, and learn how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud transforms the way organisations use their data. This role comes with structured training and a defined career path into Account Executive roles.

 

AS A SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Prospect into target accounts across Australia through phone, email, LinkedIn and social channels to generate qualified meetings for Account Executives

  • Follow up on inbound leads and Marketing campaigns, including Snowflake events, webinars and Data Cloud World Tour activity, converting interest into pipeline

  • Learn to position the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, including data warehousing, data engineering, data sharing and Snowflake Cortex AI, at a high level for business and technical audiences

  • Qualify opportunities using a structured framework such as MEDDPICC, uncovering business pain and use cases before handing over to the Account Executive

  • Research accounts and personas using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI-assisted prospecting to personalise your outreach

  • Log and manage all activity and pipeline accurately in Salesforce and your sales engagement platform (such as Outreach)

  • Work closely with Account Executives, Solution Engineers and Sales leadership on account plans, and join customer meetings where relevant

  • Attend local events, trade shows and internal enablement sessions to keep building your product and industry knowledge

 

OUR IDEAL SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 1+ years of prospecting experience, such as an SDR, BDR, inside sales or lead generation role, with a track record of booking meetings and building pipeline

  • A tertiary qualification or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to start conversations with senior stakeholders

  • Resilience and a coachable attitude: you take feedback, learn quickly and keep going after a "no"

  • Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise across many accounts and tasks

  • Genuine curiosity about technology, data and AI, and a desire to build a long-term career in tech sales

  • Full working rights in Australia

 

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Prospecting experience in SaaS, cloud or data technology

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Exposure to a sales qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC, BANT or Value Selling

  • Experience using AI tools to research, write or work more efficiently

     

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Snowflake's Sales Development team is where many of our future Account Executives and sales leaders begin. You'll receive structured onboarding, ongoing coaching and clear milestones on the path to an Account Executive role, while working with some of Australia's leading organisations as they adopt data and AI.

You'll join a growing, collaborative team in a business that is helping customers mobilise their data, build AI applications and share data securely across the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. If you're ambitious, curious and ready to learn fast, this is a great place to grow your tech sales career.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

  • Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and positive attitude with a passion for building customer relationships and expanding business opportunities. The Account Executive must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with clients.

  • You are driven to exceed performance objectives.

  • Self-starter comfortable with some ambiguity, demonstrating a willingness to learn/ramp quickly.

  • You are excited about being positioned right in the middle of the exploding cloud based economy and to develop and maintain a highly desired knowledge of Snowflake’s solutions.

  • You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Manage the relationship of 50-70 clients within a specific industry.

  • Build trusted relationships with Snowflake internal resources, external partners, and client account teams to qualify deals, identify business value, and provide technical guidance in order to set proper expectations to ensure customer satisfaction.

  • Align Snowflake’s value to the customers’ business and technical problems.

  • Drive revenue and increase market share in defined set of accounts.

  • Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving technology and landscape while maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them.

  • Work hands-on with customers to deliver standard, customized and/or strategic solution demonstrations, presentations, and best practices that showcase functional capabilities, competitive advantages, and business benefits of the Snowflake solutions throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation.

  • Guides customers in digital transformation and cloud adoption, understanding where Snowflake integrates with holistic architecture and strategy.

  • Provide ongoing, post-sales, technical guidance to the customer’s technical team to drive customer utilization of Snowflake and digital transformation success.

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • 1+ years of sales experience full cycle sales or equivalent business to business sales experience.

  • Proven ability to independently manage and develop client relationships.

  • Ability to drive consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.

  • Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • BA/BS preferred.

 - Ability to drive consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.

 - Experience determining customer requirements and presenting appropriate solutions.

 - Proactive, independent thinking and a high energy/positive attitude.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

 - BA/BS preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. District Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Why Snowflake ?

Snowflakeは、データ革命の最前線に立ち、世界最高水準のデータおよびアプリケーション・プラットフォームの構築に取り組んでいます。私たちのミッションは、企業の根深いデータサイロを解消し、「世界中のデータをモビライズすること」です。急速に進化するデータとAIの時代において、お客様の変革を支える次世代のデータ戦略を、ともに実現しませんか。

Sales team’s Mission ?

日本のフィールドセールス組織は、顧客規模や業界ごとに専門性を持った体制で運営されています。私たちのミッションは、単に製品を販売することではなく、社内のセールスエンジニアリング、プロフェッショナルサービス、マーケティング、パートナーと密に連携しながら、お客様にとっての長期的なデータ戦略を支えるTrusted Advisorとして価値を届けることです。Senior District Managerは、Field Sales leadership配下で、Account Executiveを中心とした営業チームを率い、担当Districtの成長を牽引する重要なマネジメントポジションです。

The Impact You will Make

Senior District Managerとして、担当Districtにおける営業戦略の立案と実行、組織づくり、案件推進を通じて、継続的な売上成長を実現していただきます。

  • District戦略の立案と実行： 担当Districtの営業戦略を策定し、四半期および年次ベースでチームの売上目標達成をリードする。

  • チームビルディングと人材育成： Account Executiveを中心とした営業チームの採用、育成、コーチング、パフォーマンスマネジメントを担い、高い成果を継続的に創出できる組織をつくる。

  • エグゼクティブリレーションの構築： お客様の経営課題、ITロードマップ、データ戦略を深く理解し、CxO、ITエグゼクティブ、LOBエグゼクティブとの長期的な信頼関係を構築する。

  • パイプラインと案件推進の高度化： 担当アカウントに対するアカウントプラン、案件戦略、パイプラインマネジメント、フォーキャスト精度の向上を推進する。

  • 戦略案件のリード： 大型案件や戦略案件において、営業活動全体の指揮を執り、案件形成からクロージング、拡大、深耕までを支援する。

  • クロスファンクショナルな協業： セールスエンジニアリング、プロフェッショナルサービス、マーケティング、パートナーを含むクロスファンクショナルチームと連携し、One Teamとして顧客成果を最大化する。

  • 市場インサイトの活用： 担当業界の市場動向、競合環境、顧客ニーズを把握し、SnowflakeのポジショニングおよびGo-to-Market戦略に反映する。

  • 次世代リーダーの育成： 将来のリーダー候補を育成し、組織の拡大と継続的な成長に貢献する。

Who You Are

必須要件

  • SaaSまたはエンタープライズソフトウェア業界において、8年以上の法人営業経験を有していること。

  • 3年以上の営業マネジメント経験を有し、チーム目標達成に向けた組織運営、育成、評価の実績があること。

  • 大型エンタープライズ案件において、アカウントプラン策定、案件推進、クロージングまでをリードした実績があること。

  • 顧客の課題を的確に捉え、適切なソリューションと期待効果をバリューセリングできること。

  • フォーキャスト、パイプラインレビュー、案件戦略レビューを通じて、再現性高く営業組織をマネジメントできること。

  • エグゼクティブ層に対して直接アプローチし、長期的な関係性を構築できる優れたコミュニケーション能力およびプレゼンテーション能力を有すること。

  • 社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込み、より大きく、より早く成果につなげられるリーダーシップを有すること。

  • 様々な部署と連携しながら成果創出できるOne Teamマインドセットを持っていること。

  • 日本語に堪能であり、英語での業務遂行に抵抗がないこと。

  • 複雑なエンタープライズ顧客に対する営業経験を有している方。

  • データ、クラウド、AI領域に対する高い関心を持ち、変化の早い市場環境の中で学び続けられる方。

  • 顧客、社内、パートナーを巻き込んだ戦略的な案件形成に強みを持つ方。

Japan Benefits（一部）

  • Free lunch at office

  • 401K（企業型確定拠出年金）

  • RSU

  • Phone & Gym reimbursement

  • 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Enterprise Account Executive, Retail

____

Why Snowflake ?

Snowflakeはデータ革命の最前線に立ち、世界最高のデータとアプリケーションのプラットフォームの構築に取り組んでいます。私たちのミッションはデータサイロ化を解消して、「世界中のデータをモビライズすること」を目指しております。急成長していくデータの未来を私たちと共に築いていきましょう！

Sales team’s Mission ?

営業チームは様々なインターナルチームやパートナー様と協業しながら、お客様にSnowflakeの価値や魅力を伝えていくと共に、長期的なデータ戦略のアドバイザーとして活動しております。
日本のフィールドセールスチームは顧客サイズや業界ごとにチームを分けて活動しております。ビジネスの拡大に伴い、エンタープライズアカウントを担当頂ける優秀な方を募集しております。一緒に日本市場をSnowflakeで盛り上げていきませんか？

The Impact You will Make

  • Snowflake製品のエキスパートになり、ディスカバリーコール、カスタマイズデモ、見込み顧客へのプレゼンテーションを実施する。

  • お客様の既存および将来のITロードマップを理解することで、信頼できるアドバイザーとなり、Snowflakeのソリューションを市場内で推進する。

  • 見込み客の認定、新規顧客の開拓、継続的な既存顧客の開拓。

  • 担当アカウントの販売機会の獲得及び導入、拡大、深耕。

  • ターゲットとなる見込み客リストとアカウントプランを用いて、営業戦略を策定し、四半期および年次ベースで、割り当てられたアカウント／テリトリーにおける売上目標達成を達成する。

  • CxO、ITエグゼクティブ、LOBエグゼクティブ、および他の主要なステークホルダーと密接な関係を築き、信頼を構築。

  • セールス エンジニアリング、プロフェッショナル サービス、マーケティング、パートナーを含むクロスファンクショナル・チームと緊密に連携する。

Who You Are

  • エンタープライズ向けのB2Bソフトウェア営業で5年以上の経験があり、年間クォータを達成した実績を説明できる方（小売・流通業界の経験は歓迎）

  • 顧客の業務課題について仮説を立て、CxOや部門責任者への提案につなげられる方

  • 担当テリトリーを主体的にマネジメントし、優先順位をつけて自律的に動ける方

  • SE・パートナーなど社内外の関係者を早い段階から巻き込み、案件を前に進められる方

  • アカウントプランニング、パイプラインマネジメント、MEDDPICCなどの営業手法を使って、Close計画を立てて実行できる方

  • 顧客の成功に寄り添い、伴走支援ができる方

 

Japan Benefits（一部）

  • Free lunch at office

  • 401K（企業型確定拠出年金）

  • RSU

  • Phone & Gym reimbursement

  • 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

Bellevue, WA - USA


Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team!

We are hiring a dynamic and accomplished Engineering Manager to join our Data Lake team.   • Have direct ownership to grow a strategic and emerging part of Snowflake’s business to address new and expanding market opportunities in Data Lake and Data Analytics workloads

  • Have direct impact on growth and development of your team through the full lifecycle of recruiting, hiring, mentorship, coaching, and identifying growth opportunities

  • Demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to work seamlessly across teams and organizations. Partner well with other leaders in the Engineering and Product organization on rhythms like annual & quarterly planning, staffing, project schedules, resource allocation, and more

  • Be comfortable and effective in delegation - effectively leveraging Senior & Principal engineers to maximize your team’s impact

  • Know when and how to shift resources across areas to achieve execution goals, while also ensuring effective ownership and longer-term alignment of work and skills

  • Use your strong technical foundation to set the bar for your team - build to last, deliver, and keep the quality exceptionally high!

  • Foster a healthy and diverse team culture

  • 7+ years industry experience designing and building distributed data systems, especially with a focus in database systems internals

  • 3+ years of software engineering management experience.

  • A track record of recruiting, leading, and growing high performing technical teams in a demanding talent market.

  • Experience building enterprise grade software - reliable, secure, and trustworthy platforms and distributed systems at large scale

  • Excellent problem solving skills, and strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Proven experience with authoring roadmap documents, project plans and RCAs.

  • Fluency in Java or C++.

  • Ability to work in a globally distributed team, collaborate well across disciplines, and mentor junior engineers.

  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills. Outstanding written and oral English language skills.

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent

  • Ability to work on-site in our Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA office.

  • Working with or building Distributed Storage platforms such as AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage

  • Internal design and implementation of query processing systems.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Customer Experience Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Customers are taking Snowflake into increasingly ambitious workloads, and they expect the product itself to guide them through complexity. The Customer Experience Engineering (CXE) team builds the intelligent product capabilities that make this possible. We turn diagnostic telemetry, operational signals and technical knowledge, both structured and unstructured, into AI-powered features inside Snowflake that help customers understand, diagnose and resolve problems on their own.

We design LLM-powered applications and agentic systems, backed by solid backend engineering, and ship them to production at Snowflake scale. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join us. You'll own products from design through launch, and you'll use AI tools in your own engineering workflow

Location: Menlo Park, CA - Hybrid

In this role you will:

  • Implement well-scoped tasks and projects across our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Kubernetes and Snowpark Container Services, with input from other team members.

  • Learn to engage in all aspects of the software lifecycle, from design through supporting the deployment.

  • Show accountability for the quality, completeness, and customer experience of the work you own.

  • Seek feedback and incorporate input from peers, stakeholders, and design reviews.

  • Learn the design of the components you work in, including requirements, use cases, and architecture, and begin developing proficiency in a specific feature area.

  • Participate in all aspects of engineering: development, testing, bug fixing and triage, and support rotation.

  • Collaborate within a cross-functional team, including product management and design.

  • Know when to ask for help in order to make progress and avoid unnecessary rework.

Our ideal Software Engineer will have:

  • B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, MIS, or equivalent discipline

  • Internship or professional experience is a plus

  • Working knowledge of modern application design, good API design patterns, and the basics of performance and scale

  • Proficiency in at least one of the following (bonus for more than one): Python, Java, Scala, GoLang

  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices: unit testing, code reviews, and design documentation

  • Ability to debug your own code, and an interest in building strong troubleshooting skills in a cloud environment

  • Ability to write high-quality, readable code that is readily maintainable by others, with consideration for performance, operability, and maintainability

  • Great communication skills, both verbal and written, and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers

  • A desire to contribute to the positive morale of the team, help new hires and interns onboard, and work on what the team needs

  • Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Partner Sales Manager, Financial Services – UK&I
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our SI partners help bring our customers' data and AI ambitions to life. They implement the Snowflake AI Data Cloud and drive outcomes for our customers. from modern data foundations to enterprise AI agents. Snowflake is the Agentic Control Plane for the enterprise: one place to build, deploy and govern AI agents on a single, governed source of truth for data and context, with any model and any provider and no lock-in. Our partners help the UK&I's largest Financial Services organisations to give their people trusted data and AI where and when they need it, to engage customers better, run their operations more efficiently and change their products.

The Partner Sales Manager role drives sales alignment and go-to-market (GTM) with system integrator (SI) partners across Financial Services accounts in the UK&I. Your main objective is to strengthen and grow the collaboration between Snowflake and these SIs so both sides grow their business.

You will work closely with our Partner Development Managers, who run our strategic relationships with our top partners. As the subject-matter expert for Financial Services in the UK&I, you will build, lead and carry out the partner strategy. Success shows up as growth with our joint customers, delivery of key GTM programmes, partners building their Data and AI capabilities, and customer success.

Your success depends on driving compelling business strategies, GTM motions and partner relationships. Your success is measured by partner-sourced and partner-influenced co-selling. As well as adoption, consumption of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, tracked through use case go-lives sourced and implemented with and through partners. Strong communication, experienced strategic alliance leadership and problem-solving skills are vital to excel in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Go-to-Market:

Work with the Financial Services sales teams to identify the right SI partners in the territory, build joint account plans and run campaigns that grow Snowflake's footprint with existing customers. Using a strong understanding of customers' business and regulatory needs, you will identify partner solutions, offerings and capabilities that drive expansion and consumption of Snowflake, across data engineering, analytics, AI and agentic workloads (including Snowflake Intelligence, Cortex AI and Snowflake CoWork & CoCo). This may include Snowflake product partners such as ISVs and data providers. You will meet and exceed goals for co-sell pipeline, use case go-lives, consumption and demand-generation activity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Work with Product, Sales, Sales Engineering, Industry (Financial Services), Professional Services, Field CTO and Marketing to give partners and customers a seamless experience. Communicate the territory strategy, vision and priorities to partners. Articulate partner value propositions and share insights with the relevant teams so they can keep improving.

Deal Support:

Help SIs through the sales process, including education, deal registration, service registration, pricing and proposal support. Work with internal teams to keep the sales cycle smooth and efficient.

Performance Tracking:

Track the performance and commercial outcomes of joint initiatives with SIs. Analyse pipeline, use case and consumption data along with market trends, and communicate partner impact and outcomes clearly.

Delivery Success:

Keep communication and collaboration with SIs consistent through pre-sales and post-sales activity. Build relationships with key Professional Services and partner delivery leaders so use cases go live on time and turn into consumption.

Desired Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in partnerships, strategic alliances, sales, marketing or business development in technology

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of channel sales or channel programme management experience

  • Direct sales experience (preferred)

  • A track record of success and established relationships with UK&I SI partners, ideally within Financial Services accounts

  • Working knowledge of cloud, data and AI environments; familiarity with enterprise AI and agentic use cases is a plus

  • Understanding of the Financial Services landscape in the UK&I, including the regulatory and data governance needs that shape it (preferred)

  • Ability to manage regional business plans and to track and explain partner progress

  • Strong executive presence and polish

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to set priorities in a fast-changing environment

Snowflake is growing fast, and we're scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of strong communication skills, diplomacy in successfully working with difficult partners (it’s easy when everything is going fine) and strong business acumen in growing a business/ channel/ partnership.

 

Reporting to the Senior Partner Manager in France, you will have a unique opportunity to work for a disruptive company at the forefront of the Data & AI revolution, and lead the development of a vibrant Partner community.

 

AS A PARTNER DEVELOPMENT MANAGER (EMEA SOUTH) YOU WILL:

  • Manage a portfolio of high performing Global Systems Integrators (GSI's) and Regional SI’s (RSIs) to achieve partnership goals such as net new customers and consumption

  • Support your partners in their go-to-market activities (business planning, pipeline development, QBR, marketing, enablement sales activities across different Go-To-Market options…)

  • Ensure successful execution of the business plan by developing and managing relationships across functional areas within the partner

  • Work with the partner to expand the partnership into new strategic areas (new Service Lines and Industry Verticals)

  • Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders (typically Partner/Managing Director Level)

  • Organise and execute events with and for our partner community

  • Pitch value proposition of Snowflake partnership on all levels (up to C-Level)

  • Ensure alignment of all relevant stakeholders on pursues in joint accounts

OUR IDEAL PDM WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Channel Management, Software/Services Sales, Consulting, and/or Business Development in Cloud or Software Technology

  • Experience in working with SIs (such as KPMG, EY, CapGemini, Atos, etc.) to leverage their strategic influence to drive technology sales in a joint sales offering

  • Proven experience in delivering strong results in pipeline generation and bookings, by leveraging existing and recruiting targeted new partners

  • Cloud Technology, AI/ML, Data, Analytics, API and platform experience and understanding

  • Ability to build, lead and implement strategy in a cross-functional environment

  • Strong executive selling and business development skills; proven ability to understand different partner GTM and organizational models

  • Ability to design and present business plans, track and articulate program progress, design and document program guidelines for distribution throughout the organization (all levels) and for external use

  • MUST HAVE: Excellent communication skills, verbal & written in French & and English. Strong problem solving skills and ability to organize priorities in a dynamic environment

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Be able to travel between 25% - 50% in some months

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE:

  • Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product!

  • Develop a brand new set of ecosystem alliances for Snowflake making data more accessible to customers

  • Develop, lead and execute industry-changing initiatives

  • Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Account Solution Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Opportunity: Accelerate the AI Data Cloud Journey

The Account Engineer is a high-impact, cross-functional role designed to accelerate the customer journey from initial acquisition to successful platform adoption and expansion on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will contribute to this mission by driving initial utilization, leveraging modern AI-powered tools and coding agents to ensure technical success.

This role bridges the critical gap by helping new and early-stage customers achieve rapid implementation, quick value, and a world-class experience on the Snowflake platform. You will be the dedicated customer technical partner, responsible for driving technical enablement and supporting the overall activation and adoption of our customers initial use cases.

This is a fantastic opportunity for technical professionals to develop deep expertise in cloud data architecture, make a measurable impact on customer success, and contribute to one of the fastest-growing technology companies.

 

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

The Account Engineer manages a critical portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and is accountable for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth. Operating as a Full-Stack Technical Resource, this role blends deep hands-on expertise with the strategic acumen of a business leader.

Strategic Ownership and Value Creation

  • Lead Your Account Micro-Business: Take ownership of the technical success and consumption trajectory within your assigned portfolio, driving adoption metrics in your assigned accounts, acting as a single point of contact for all customer needs.

  • Driving Outcome-Based Utilization: Apply an outcome-based selling mindset to customer engagements, focusing on how the Snowflake AI Data Cloud helps them solve complex data challenges and unlock maximum business value—not just product features.

  • Strategic Advisory and Guidance: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor immediately following the initial contract close, providing guidance on data strategy, technology stack integration, and ensuring a swift, successful activation of Use Cases.

  • Deliver Technical Value with AI: Deliver technical value efficiently by leveraging cutting-edge AI-powered development tools and automation to accelerate solutions and implementation guidance, helping customers move faster to production.

Technical Execution and Collaboration

  • Architectural Leadership: Provide customers with critical, Snowflake-specific foundational guidance, including Architectural Best Practices, Workload Isolation & Warehouse Utilization, Resource Monitoring & Alerts, Budgeting, and RBAC/Security Setup.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Account Team to highlight risks and establish and nurture trusted relationships with internal Snowflake teams (e.g., Professional Services, Support) and external partners to ensure seamless resource orchestration.

  • Develop Scalable Programs: Create and deliver reusable, high-impact programs, such as Hands-on Labs (HoLs) and webinars, to educate a wide customer audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

  • Technical Feedback Loop & Innovation: Act as a key feedback loop from the field to influence future product development, working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Expert Support and Triage: Efficiently triage a broad array of incoming customer inquiries, assisting the field team with demos, troubleshooting, and identifying opportunities to qualify potential business value for the Expansion team.

 

Required Qualifications

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated technical professionals eager to launch their next career chapter with us.

  • Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience with SQL is required.

  • Data & Cloud Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding and experience with data architecture, data analytics, and the core concepts of major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Growth Mindset: A strong desire to learn, grow your technical skills, and become an expert in the Snowflake platform.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

  • Professional Skills: Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and possess Project Management skills to track, manage, and drive customers to an agreed-upon timeline.

  • Education: University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related fields, or equivalent practical experience in a technical role.

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SnowPro Core certification

  • Proficiency in additional coding languages, particularly Python, Java, or Scala, especially in a data or application development context.

  • Experience with modern data technologies (e.g., CI/CD tooling, orchestration tools) or a basic understanding of Data Science concepts.

  • Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

Our Frontier Engineering team helps customers across Asia Pacific get real value from the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. As a Technical Architect based in Singapore, you will work hands-on with customer and partner teams to design, build, and launch data solutions that solve real business problems.

AS A TECHNICAL ARCHITECT AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Design and deliver customer solutions on Snowflake across data warehousing, open lakehouse with Apache Iceberg tables, data engineering, and secure data sharing

  • Build batch and streaming ingestion and data transformation pipelines using Snowflake features like Openflow, dbt projects on Snowflake,Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and Snowpark (Python, Java, or Scala)

  • Implement Snowflake security and governance best practices, including role-based access control, masking and row access policies, data quality framework and Snowflake Horizon Catalog

  • Design and implement open lakehouse architectures leveraging Snowflake-managed Iceberg tables & interoperability with open table formats.

  • Architect & enable secure, zero-copy data collaboration across business units and external partners utilizing Snowflake Data Sharing, Secure Views, and Clean Rooms.

  • Design, build & deploy scalable data applications across the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, leveraging the Native App Framework, SPCS, App runtime, Streamlit in Snowflake to productionize secure, containerized workflows and interactive UI tools.

  • customers adopt Snowflake Cortex AI features, such as Cortex AISQL functions, Cortex Search, and Cortex Analyst, CoCo to bring AI to their data. Deploy ML Ops

  • Set up automated deployment (e.g. DCM, Git integration, GitHub Actions) for repeatable, governed releases.

  • Create comprehensive documentation and execute effective knowledge transfer to ensure customers are fully enabled to maintain, optimize and extend Snowflake solutions with optimum performance and cost.

  • Partner with System Integrators, and share field feedback with Snowflake Product and Engineering teams

OUR IDEAL TECHNICAL ARCHITECT WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as consulting, data engineering, or solutions architecture With 8+ years of overall Technology experience

  • Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python building data intensive use cases

  • Experience designing data warehouse, data lake, or lakehouse solutions for Enterprise customers

  • Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP

  • Experience with ETL/ELT and orchestration tools such as dbt, Informatica, Matillion, Fivetran, or Airflow

  • Clear communication with both technical teams and business stakeholders

  • Ability to travel to customer sites within the region as needed

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certifications

  • Experience with Apache Spark or Databricks

  • Delivery experience on large data platform migrations

  • Industry knowledge in financial services, Telco, Retail, or Public sector

  • Hands-on experience with Enterprise AI or LLM-based use cases

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern – Developer Platform (Warsaw, Summer 2027)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About Snowflake

Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud, a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency and performance. Our Warsaw engineering hub is one of Snowflake's key global R&D centers. It's home to the teams that build the developer tools and platform capabilities powering the Snowflake ecosystem.

About the Team

The Developer Platform organization in Warsaw builds the tools and interfaces developers use every day to work with Snowflake. Our scope includes:

  • Snowflake CLI & Client SDKs: an open-source command-line interface for developer workloads, CI/CD automation and SQL operations.

  • Drivers: production-grade client libraries in Python, Java, Go, .NET and Node.js, used by thousands of customers worldwide.

  • Git Integration & Database Change Management (DCM): native DevOps workflows that bring version control and declarative change management to Snowflake.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers and technical leaders who have shipped widely adopted open-source tools and shaped Snowflake's developer experience from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and test features for one or more of our developer-facing products (CLI, drivers or DCM tooling)

  • Write clean, well-tested, production-quality code in Python, Java, Go, Rust or C++

  • Contribute to open-source projects and take part in code reviews with the team

  • Work on real customer use cases: what you build will be used by developers at thousands of organizations

  • Collaborate with product managers, senior engineers and other interns in an agile environment

  • Present your work to the wider Warsaw engineering team at the end of your internship

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field

  • Solid programming skills in at least one of: Python, Java, Go, Rust or C++

  • Understanding of data structures, algorithms and software design principles

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to code quality

  • Ability to communicate effectively in English (our working language)

Preferred

  • Open-source experience: contributions, issue triage or maintaining a public project

  • Experience with Rust

  • Familiarity with telemetry and observability (e.g., OpenTelemetry, metrics, tracing)

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)

  • Understanding of DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing

  • Experience building developer tools: CLIs, SDKs, APIs, build systems or package managers

  • Knowledge of API design, protocol-level networking or client-server architecture

  • A previous internship or substantial software engineering project work

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience shipping features in a product used by customers around the world

  • Mentorship from senior engineers and technical leaders in a world-class engineering organization

  • Exposure to the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and release

  • Open-source contribution experience on projects with an active community

  • A network inside one of the fastest-growing cloud data companies in the world

Logistics

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland (Kasprzaka 4)

  • Duration: 3–6 months (summer internship)

  • Work model: Hybrid, a mix of in-office and remote work

  • Start date: Summer 2027 (exact dates flexible)

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflake delivers the AI Data Cloud, a global network where thousands of organizations mobilize data with near-unlimited scale, concurrency and performance. Our Warsaw engineering hub is one of Snowflake's key global R&D centers. Its teams build core systems that move, store and serve data for customers around the world.

About the Teams

You'll join one of two Warsaw teams working at the heart of Snowflake's platform:

  • Data Ingestion: builds the high-throughput, low-latency pipelines that bring customer data into Snowflake at massive scale. The scope covers batch and continuous loading (Snowpipe, Snowpipe Streaming) and integrations with the wider data ecosystem, such as Kafka connectors.

  • Platform Infrastructure Engineering (PIE): builds and runs the core infrastructure, reliability and performance tooling that keeps Snowflake's services fast, scalable and resilient for every workload.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who design distributed systems that run at very large scale, every day.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and test features for production systems in data ingestion or platform infrastructure

  • Write clean, well-tested, production-quality code in Java, C++, Go, Rust or Python

  • Profile, benchmark and optimize systems where throughput, latency and reliability really matter

  • Help improve observability, testing and automation, so that issues are found before customers notice them

  • Take part in design discussions and code reviews with senior engineers

  • Present your work to the wider Warsaw engineering team at the end of your internship

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field

  • Solid programming skills in at least one of: Java, C++, Go, Rust or Python

  • Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms and software design principles

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to code quality

  • Ability to communicate effectively in English (our working language)

  • Required to work from designated office full time

Preferred

  • Coursework or project experience in distributed systems, operating systems, networking or databases

  • Experience with streaming or messaging technologies (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar, Kinesis)

  • Interest in performance engineering: profiling, benchmarking, concurrency and memory efficiency

  • Familiarity with data formats and pipelines (Parquet, Avro, JSON, ETL/ELT)

  • Exposure to Linux, containers or Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)

  • Familiarity with observability: metrics, logging, tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry)

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

  • Open-source contributions or substantial personal or academic systems projects

  • A previous software engineering internship

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience building systems that process data at very large scale in production

  • Mentorship from senior engineers in a world-class engineering organization

  • Deep exposure to distributed systems, performance engineering and cloud infrastructure

  • Experience across the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and release

  • A network inside one of the fastest-growing cloud data companies in the world

Logistics

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland (Kasprzaka 4)

  • Duration: 3–6 months (summer internship)

  • Start date: Summer 2027 (exact dates flexible)

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager – Order-to-Cash & Agentic AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Location: Dublin, CA | Workplace: Hybrid, 3 days in office

We are looking for a Product Manager – Order-to-Cash and Agentic AI to help design, build, and run the systems behind Snowflake's Office of the CFO. You will bring a product-led mindset to finance technology, with a strong focus on AI and agentic applications that change how Finance works.

The Mission

We are building a next-generation, AI-native enterprise platform on Snowflake ("Snow on Snow").

We are looking for a technically strong Product Manager with deep expertise in pricing, contracts, billing, and invoicing, and a proven track record of building in-house software products from zero to production. You will understand the complete customer journey, from quoting and contracting through consumption, billing, payment, and reconciliation, and translate that understanding into reliable, intuitive products.

This is a hands-on product-building role. You will own discovery, product strategy, technical requirements, AI-assisted prototyping, delivery, and adoption. Beyond implementing enterprise packages, you will define differentiated capabilities, validate them with working prototypes, and partner closely with Engineering to deliver production-grade applications. You will also build agentic applications that automate financial workflows while preserving accuracy, auditability, and human oversight.

AS A PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build Products from Zero to Production: Own discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of in-house Order-to-Cash (O2C) products. Translate customer and operational needs into clear product requirements, MVPs, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.

  • Own Contracts, Billing & Invoicing: Define capabilities for contract changes, order activation, usage rating, billing schedules, invoice generation, adjustments, and reconciliation. Support consumption-based, subscription, hybrid, and technical services business models.

  • Design the End-to-End Customer Journey: Connect upstream quoting and contracting with downstream invoicing, payments, cash application, disputes, and subledger operations. Simplify customer and operator experiences, including exceptions and recovery.

  • Prototype & Deliver with Engineering: Build working prototypes using AI-assisted development tools to validate workflows and feasibility. Partner with Engineering on APIs, data models, business rules, architecture tradeoffs, testing, and production readiness.

  • Build Reliable Agentic Workflows: Define agent orchestration, tool integration, and approval checkpoints. Establish prompt and context strategies, evals, test harnesses, and observability to measure quality, reliability, latency, and cost.

  • Drive Adoption & Operational Excellence: Deliver measurable improvements in billing accuracy, automation, collections effectiveness, and adoption. Embed financial controls, security, audit trails, and resilient exception handling throughout the product lifecycle.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Product Management Experience: 6+ years of product management experience building enterprise software, financial platforms, or billing products, with direct accountability for product decisions and business outcomes.

  • Zero-to-One In-House Product Development: Demonstrated experience taking custom-built products from problem discovery through MVP, production launch, and scale. Experience must go beyond packaged application configuration, implementation coordination, or project management.

  • Deep Contracts, Billing & Invoicing Expertise: Hands-on product experience with contract lifecycle events, amendments, renewals, billing schedules, proration, invoicing, credit/debit memos, tax integrations, and reconciliation.

  • Consumption-Based Billing: Experience delivering usage-based billing capabilities, including usage ingestion and validation, metering and rating, tiered pricing, commitments, drawdowns, overages, and billing corrections.

  • End-to-End Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) / O2C Understanding: Strong understanding of the customer journey across CPQ, pricing, deal desk, contracts, orders, billing, payments, cash application, disputes, collections, and operational subledgers.

  • Core Software Product & Engineering Skills: Ability to translate business needs into functional specifications, data models, API contracts, workflow states, and testable acceptance criteria. Technical fluency in SQL, APIs, and event-driven systems, with sound judgment on build-versus-buy, scalability, and reliability tradeoffs.

  • Hands-on AI Prototyping & Agentic Applications: Experience using tools such as Cortex Code or Cursor to build functional prototypes, and demonstrated delivery of in-house agentic applications in O2C or closely related financial workflows. Understanding of tool/function calling, orchestration, context and memory management, and human approvals.

  • AI Evaluation & Production Quality: Practical experience with prompt and context engineering, evaluation datasets, automated test harnesses, regression testing, execution tracing, and guardrails. Ability to define measurable release criteria and safe fallback behavior.

  • Enterprise Application Integration: Experience integrating or extending platforms such as Workday, Oracle, SAP, NetSuite, or Salesforce, with an understanding of financial data ownership, system boundaries, and reconciliation.

  • Customer-Centric Execution: Strong discovery, UX, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work closely with Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Compliance to turn complex requirements into usable products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building on Snowflake using Cortex AI, Snowpark, Snowpark Container Services (SPCS), Streamlit, or Dynamic Tables.

  • Prior software engineering experience or demonstrated ability to develop and validate prototypes using code.

  • Experience delivering mission-critical enterprise applications, operational subledgers, payment platforms, or cross-system reconciliation with rigorous security controls, robust exception handling, and tested recovery procedures.

  • Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom implementations.

  • Experience extracting and validating information from contracts, invoices, remittance advice, and other unstructured documents.

  • Familiarity with SOC 1/SOC 2, SOX controls, and PCI DSS requirements relevant to financial applications.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

AS A TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER: COMPUTE INFRASTRUCTURE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Drive technical programs and workstreams that improve Snowflake’s cloud infrastructure, including compute and container platforms, deployment automation, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency.

  • Apply an understanding of distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in technical design discussions to translate engineering priorities into actionable program roadmaps, surface dependencies, and understand trade-offs across scalability, reliability, security, and cost.

  • Partner with engineers to define technical milestones and readiness criteria for infrastructure launches and migrations, including integration testing, observability, staged rollouts, and rollback plans.

  • Identify and help resolve cross-service dependencies involving APIs, networking, configuration, and provisioning, supporting consistent platform capabilities across clouds, regions, and deployment environments.

  • Build dashboards to track key metrics, measure progress against OKRs, and investigate trends with engineering partners.

  • Translate technical progress, risks, and design decisions into clear program updates, helping stakeholders understand delivery impacts, trade-offs, and decisions needed.

  • Use AI effectively to build workflows and lightweight agents that synthesize technical information, surface risks, and automate readiness checks and dependency tracking, while validating outputs, safeguarding sensitive information, and measuring improvements in execution speed and quality.

OUR IDEAL TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER: COMPUTE INFRASTRUCTURE WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or a related technical role.

  • A working understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed systems, with exposure to one or more cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience delivering cross-functional programs or workstreams in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or large-scale compute environments.

  • Familiarity with using AI-assisted workflows to improve productivity, with sound judgment about output accuracy and sensitive information.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to frame problems, weigh trade-offs, and guide decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • The ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems and keep work moving in a fast-paced environment.

  • A BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience supporting infrastructure launches, migrations, or service rollouts across clouds or regions.

  • Hands-on exposure to container platforms, networking, infrastructure provisioning, or observability tools.

  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or lightweight agents using tools such as Snowflake Cortex AI to automate planning, reporting, or coordination.

  • Experience improving infrastructure utilization and efficiency to reduce cloud costs.

WHY JOIN OUR ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will help scale one of the world’s leading data and AI platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including government regions. The programs you drive will directly influence how quickly Snowflake expands and brings new capabilities to customers. You will partner with experienced engineering and infrastructure teams, deepen your technical expertise, and grow your scope and impact as Snowflake’s global cloud and AI footprint expands.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Team

The Apps & Experiences (AppEx) organization powers the unified web user experience (Snowsight) for Snowflake. Every major Snowflake customer interacts with our platform through these surfaces, making AppEx central to both customer satisfaction and revenue growth.

Within Appex, our team sits at the intersection of AI, platform, and user experience. We are on a mission to create an AI‑first, scalable, maintainable, and extensible UI platform from which all Snowflake user experiences can be built. The team owns:

  • The serving layer that powers Snowsight, Snowflake CoWork, and UX features

  • Developer tooling that enable our engineers to move fast and deliver

  • Frontend infrastructure and shared services for product teams

  • CI pipelines that ensure fast and reliable builds

  • Testing and validation platform that maintains code and product quality

  • The monitoring and logging stack that ensures observability and trust

 

What You Will Do

Snowsight is a large, complex single-page application serving interactive analytics, data engineering, and AI workloads. As our user base and feature surface grow, we must treat performance as a first-class citizen. You will own the strategy, build the tooling, and drive the culture needed to keep Snowsight fast, and you'll partner across our platform and product teams to make performance a default rather than an afterthought.

 

This is a high-leverage role: the systems and practices you build will affect every page load, interaction, and data-rendering path in Snowsight. You will:

  • Define and drive the web performance strategy for Snowsight, setting goals grounded in real user metrics (Core Web Vitals, custom interaction metrics, time-to-visually-complete for data-heavy views).

  • Build and maintain performance infrastructure: RUM/synthetic monitoring pipelines, regression detection in CI, bundle analysis, performance dashboards, and alerting, making performance visible and actionable for every product team.

  • Identify and fix systemic performance bottlenecks across the application lifecycle: initial load, code splitting and lazy loading, rendering (React), data fetching and caching, large dataset rendering (virtualization, streaming), and runtime memory/CPU efficiency.

  • Optimize build and delivery: work with the team on bundle size, tree-shaking, chunk splitting strategies, CDN caching, and resource prioritization (preload, prefetch, HTTP/2+ multiplexing).

  • Establish performance budgets and guardrails integrated into CI/CD so regressions are caught before they ship.

  • Partner with product teams to design performance-aware architectures for new features, providing guidance on data-fetching patterns, rendering strategies, and progressive loading.

  • Mentor engineers across the org on performance best practices, conduct reviews of critical performance paths, and build a culture where teams own performance as a quality attribute.

  • Represent Snowflake's frontend performance perspective in cross-org architectural decisions (e.g., API design, service infrastructure, caching layers) where frontend impact is significant.

 

What We’re Looking For

Our ideal Staff Software Engineer will have:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in web performance for large-scale, complex web applications.

  • Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript and React knowledge, including React rendering internals and experience diagnosing and resolving performance issues in large React codebases.

  • Strong understanding of browser performance fundamentals: the critical rendering path, layout/paint/composite pipeline, main-thread scheduling, Web Workers, browser DevTools/Performance panel profiling, etc.

  • Experience designing and operating RUM and synthetic performance monitoring at scale (e.g., custom metrics collection, percentile-based alerting, anomaly detection for regressions).

  • Deep knowledge of build tooling and delivery optimization: Webpack/Vite/Bazel, code splitting, tree-shaking, chunk strategies, lazy loading, CDN behavior, caching headers, resource hints, and their measurable impact on load performance.

  • Experience with large dataset rendering: virtualization (windowing), canvas/WebGL rendering for grids or charts, streaming/incremental rendering, and efficient DOM management.

  • Strong communication and influence skills: able to set technical direction, build consensus across teams, and explain performance trade-offs to both engineers and product stakeholders.

  • Experience working in a platform or infrastructure role where your customers are other engineering teams.

  • Ability to work on-site at our Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA offices.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with server-side rendering, streaming SSR, or edge rendering patterns and their performance implications.

  • Familiarity with browser engines or internals (V8, Chromium, Webkit).

  • Contributions to web performance standards, browser APIs, or open-source performance tooling.

  • Experience with observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, etc) and building internal performance tooling.

  • Background in data-intensive UIs: query editors, result grids, dashboards, notebooks, or similar products where rendering performance under large data volumes is critical.

 

If you’re excited about building the platform and systems that power how the world’s largest companies experience Snowflake, we’d love to hear from you.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in web performance for large-scale, complex web applications.

 - Expert-level JavaScript/TypeScript and React knowledge, including React rendering internals and experience diagnosing and resolving performance issues in large React codebases.

 - Strong understanding of browser performance fundamentals: the critical rendering path, layout/paint/composite pipeline, main-thread scheduling, Web Workers, browser DevTools/Performance panel profiling, etc.

 - Experience designing and operating RUM and synthetic performance monitoring at scale (e.g., custom metrics collection, percentile-based alerting, anomaly detection for regressions).

 - Deep knowledge of build tooling and delivery optimization: Webpack/Vite/Bazel, code splitting, tree-shaking, chunk strategies, lazy loading, CDN behavior, caching headers, resource hints, and their measurable impact on load performance.

 - Experience with large dataset rendering: virtualization (windowing), canvas/WebGL rendering for grids or charts, streaming/incremental rendering, and efficient DOM management.

 - Strong communication and influence skills: able to set technical direction, build consensus across teams, and explain performance trade-offs to both engineers and product stakeholders.

 - Experience working in a platform or infrastructure role where your customers are other engineering teams.

 - Ability to work on-site at our Bellevue, WA or Menlo Park, CA offices.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Familiarity with server-side rendering, streaming SSR, or edge rendering patterns and their performance implications.

 - Familiarity with browser engines or internals (V8, Chromium, Webkit).

 - Contributions to web performance standards, browser APIs, or open-source performance tooling.

 - Experience with observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, etc) and building internal performance tooling.

 - Background in data-intensive UIs: query editors, result grids, dashboards, notebooks, or similar products where rendering performance under large data volumes is critical.

 

If you’re excited about building the platform and systems that power how the world’s largest companies experience Snowflake, we’d love to hear from you.

We are hiring a driven Technical Recruiter for our Talent Acquisition team. In this role, you will lead full lifecycle recruitment across AI and core Software Engineering teams, partnering directly with engineering leaders to source, attract, and hire exceptional talent across distributed systems, database engine, cloud infrastructure, and Cortex AI initiatives.

AS A TECHNICAL RECRUITER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own full lifecycle technical recruiting across multiple engineering groups, including Core Database Engine, Cloud Infrastructure, Data Platform, and Cortex AI / Machine Learning teams.

  • Develop innovative, multi-channel sourcing strategies tailored to highly competitive technical disciplines, from systems and backend engineering to applied AI and research.

  • Act as a trusted talent advisor to engineering managers, providing actionable data on candidate pipelines, market trends, compensation benchmarks, and closing strategies.

  • Drive a high-touch, transparent candidate experience from initial outreach through final offer negotiation and closing.

  • Experiment with modern, AI-assisted recruiting workflows and intelligent tooling to accelerate talent mapping, candidate engagement, and operational velocity.

  • Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion across every stage of the recruitment funnel, actively building diverse candidate pipelines.

  • Partner cross-functionally with People Operations, Compensation, and Talent Brand to continuously strengthen Snowflake's employer brand in major engineering hubs.

OUR IDEAL TECHNICAL RECRUITER WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of full lifecycle technical recruiting experience in-house or with an agency, with proven success hiring across core software engineering domains.

  • Demonstrated track record of engaging and closing specialized technical talent across software engineering disciplines, including distributed systems, backend infrastructure, cloud platforms, or AI / Machine Learning.

  • Strong consultative acumen to partner effectively with engineering managers, balance hiring trade-offs, and align on rigorous technical standards.

  • Proven capability in proactive sourcing methodologies, market mapping, and cultivating talent pipelines for critical hiring needs.

  • Comprehensive understanding of the technical talent market, competitive compensation practices, and regional talent dynamics.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience partnering with both systems engineering teams and specialized research or applied ML teams.

  • Hands-on experience utilizing modern AI-powered recruitment tools or Cortex-driven workflows to enhance recruiting productivity.

  • Background scaling technical teams within high-growth enterprise software, data infrastructure, or cloud platform companies.

Our Talent Acquisition team is central to Snowflake's hyper-growth and mission. We operate with high autonomy, direct stakeholder trust, and a relentless focus on candidate experience. Joining our team means having a direct hand in shaping the engineering culture and technical leadership that powers the world's leading data and AI cloud.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Elastic Global Services
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Elastic Global Services (EGS) team builds the highly available, scalable, multi-tenant Cloud Services platform that underpins Snowflake services. Our work includes autoscaling cloud virtual machines, managing compute-cluster topologies and lifecycles, and orchestrating workloads.

Our infrastructure runs on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead complex distributed systems projects and improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency of our platform as customer demand grows.

Learn more in our ACM Symposium on Cloud Computing talk.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will

  • Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems for our Cloud Services platform.

  • Independently deliver projects from design through production rollout, collaborating with partner teams as needed.

  • Develop expertise in an EGS component and resolve reliability and performance issues.

  • Make informed trade-offs among availability, consistency, performance, and infrastructure cost.

  • Ensure operational readiness and meet customer commitments for availability and performance.

  • Contribute thoughtful design and code reviews, and mentor junior engineers.

Our ideal Senior Software Engineer will have

  • 5+ years experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale distributed fault tolerant infrastructure in production.

  • Experience independently designing and delivering distributed systems projects in production.

  • Strong coding and debugging skills, with a track record of delivering maintainable, well-tested software.

  • Excellent understanding of operating systems concepts, including multithreading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

  • Clear technical communication, sound engineering judgment, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving.

  • BS / MS in Computer Science or related fields.

  • Clear technical communication and effective collaboration within and across teams.

Why join EGS at Snowflake?

Build core infrastructure for an industry-leading cloud data platform. Solve challenging problems in distributed systems and resource management alongside experienced engineers, with direct ownership and impact on customer reliability and performance.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

This will require you to leverage your technical skills and expertise to engage and communicate effectively at all levels within an organization.

 

As a Technical Account Manager, you will:

  • Collaborate regularly with Solutions Engineers to identify strategies that enable customers to achieve their business goals and recommend these proactively to customers

  • Develop a deep understanding of your assigned customer's environment, use cases, and challenges, and provide expert technical advice post-production

  • Develop, manage, and implement a strategy for efficient workload consumption

  • Work with Snowflake Product and Engineering teams to access new product features, private previews, and platform upgrade requirements

  • Act as the technical advisor for production workloads, often advising on multiple use cases within large, complex organizations

  • Lead customers through Well-Architected Framework outcomes, including security hardening (MFA, SSO/SAML, RBAC), DR/BCP readiness, AI observability and alerting design, platform modernization, and performance and cost optimization

  • Leverage AI tools to develop scalable playbooks, skills, and automation that enable the broader CX organization to deliver technical outcomes faster and more consistently

  • Willingness to travel regionally to customer locations, deliver on-site solutions, and build strong customer relationships

Our Ideal Technical Account Manager will have:

  • B.S. or M.S degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

  • Hands-on experience with Python and SQL

  • 8+ years of experience managing enterprise customer environments as a technical resource, or equivalent role

  • 5+ years of experience working with AWS, Azure, GCP, and/or a private cloud environment

  • Firsthand Snowflake product experience is required

  • Experience in customer-facing roles such as solutions engineering, technical architecture, or data architecture consulting

  • Expertise in one of the following industries: Retail/CG, Financial Services, Healthcare, Media & Advertising

  • Hands-on experience in database management, data engineering, and data science

  • Experience working within the partner ecosystem as it pertains to Snowflake solutions

  • Skilled in resolving complex escalations with senior customer executives

  • Excellent verbal, written, communication, and receptive listening skills

  • High levels of emotional intelligence (EQ), empathy, proactivity, and the ability to advocate for both customers and internal teams

  • Successful experience working, collaborating, and establishing relationships with leadership, colleagues, and clients

  • Excellent team player able to work with virtual and global cross-functional teams

Nice to Have:

  • Snowflake, AWS, GCP, or Azure Cloud Certification(s) preferred

  • Snowflake SnowPro Advanced Certification is strongly preferred

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Location: Tokyo, JAPAN | Team: Account Engineering

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energised by the opportunity to reinvent how they work.
