The Account Engineer is a high-impact, cross-functional role designed to accelerate the customer journey from initial acquisition to successful platform adoption and expansion on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will contribute to this mission by driving initial utilisation, leveraging modern AI-powered tools and coding agents to ensure technical success.

As a Team Lead, Account Engineering, you will lead a group of account engineers who partner with Snowflake's enterprise customers to drive successful adoption and growth of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

AS A TEAM LEAD, ACCOUNT ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Act as a player/coach and lead a team of account engineers who guide enterprise customers through architecture, adoption, and expansion of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud.

  • Manage a portfolio of new and early-stage customers, and be responsible for accelerating their time-to-value and achieving sustained platform growth.

  • Partner with regional leadership on sales strategy, partnerships and initiatives to ensure quota targets and goals are met.

  • Build repeatable playbooks, runbooks, and reference architectures so the team scales its impact across accounts and regions.

  • Collaborate and maintain a close working relationship with product, engineering, sales, marketing, partnerships, and services teams.

  • Play an active role in sourcing and screening potential candidates and managing the interview process.

  • Lead scalable programs to educate a wide audience on specific platform features and industry best practices.

  • Leverage your AI and data analytics skills to find patterns and opportunities to up-level the team, improve customer experience, and deliver successful outcomes for customers.

 

OUR IDEAL TEAM LEAD, ACCOUNT ENGINEERING WILL HAVE:

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions engineering, technical account management, or cloud data engineering.

  • Hands-on expertise with any leading cloud data platforms, and the ability to architect solutions for agentic enterprises

  • Experience managing enterprise escalations and communicating technical risk clearly to executives and customers.

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, Spark, containers, DevOps tooling, orchestration tools, Git, etc.).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical details for mixed audiences.

  • Experience building internal tooling, automation, or AI-assisted workflows that improve support and engineering efficiency.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Production experience with Snowflake or a comparable AI Data Cloud platform.

  • Prior experience or strong interest in leveraging AI-powered development tools and coding agents to increase solution delivery efficiency.

  • 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Account Engineering sits at the centre of how our customers succeed on Snowflake. You will work on hard, high-impact problems across industries, with direct influence on how some of the world's largest organisations use data. You will also have room to shape how your team works, from the playbooks you build to the people you grow.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Sales Development Representative

____

Why Snowflake ?

Snowflakeはデータ革命の最前線に立ち、世界最高のデータとアプリケーションのプラットフォームの構築に取り組んでいます。私たちのミッションはデータサイロ化を解消して、「世界中のデータをモビライズすること」を目指しております。急成長していくデータの未来を私たちと共に築いていきましょう！

Sales Development team’s Mission ?

Sales Developmentチームは、営業組織の最前線で新たなビジネス機会を創出し、Snowflakeの成長を加速させる重要な役割を担っています。AEと密に連携しながら担当アカウントへの戦略的なアウトリーチを行い、質の高い商談機会の創出、新規パイプラインの構築、そしてマーケティング起点のリードフォローアップを通じて、営業活動の起点をつくるポジションです。

Sales Development Representativeには、単なる初期接点の創出にとどまらず、ターゲット企業や意思決定者の理解を深め、アカウント戦略に基づいたアプローチを自律的に実行し、AEや関係部門と連携しながら成果につなげていくことが期待されます。変化の速い市場環境の中で、Snowflakeの価値を的確に届け、顧客との新しい対話を生み出すことが求められます。

The Impact You will Make

  • 担当アカウントに対して戦略的なアウトリーチを行い、新規商談機会の創出をリードする。

  • 見込み顧客のビジネス課題や組織構造を理解し、適切なペルソナにアプローチして質の高いミーティングを設定する。

  • AEと連携し、Cap1 SQOやCapN Use Caseに繋がる新規パイプライン創出を推進する。

  • Marketingから引き継がれるMQLに対して迅速かつ効果的にフォローアップし、商談化につなげる。

  • Salesforce、Sales Engagementツール、各種データソースを活用し、継続的にアクティビティの質と生産性を改善する。

  • ターゲットアカウントごとの仮説立て、優先順位付け、メッセージングの最適化を行い、再現性のある成果創出モデルを構築する。

  • AE、Marketing、Partner、Solution Engineeringを含むクロスファンクショナルな連携を通じて、One Teamで顧客接点を拡大する。

  • チーム内でのベストプラクティス共有や後輩メンバーへのナレッジ展開を通じて、Sales Development組織全体のレベルアップに貢献する。

 

Who You Are

  • SaaSまたはエンタープライズソフトウェア業界において、Sales Development、Inside Sales、Business Development、またはそれに準ずる顧客開拓業務の経験をお持ちの方。

  • 複数のステークホルダーが関与する法人営業環境において、新規案件創出やパイプライン構築に携わった実績をお持ちの方。

  • ターゲット企業の調査、アカウントプランニング、仮説構築をもとに、戦略的なアウトリーチを行える方。

  • 電話、メール、LinkedInなど複数チャネルを活用し、見込み顧客との接点を創出できる優れたコミュニケーション能力をお持ちの方。

  • AEやMarketingなど社内関係者と連携しながら、スピード感を持って成果創出に取り組める方。

  • 数値目標にコミットし、活動量だけでなく質にもこだわりながら継続的に改善できる方。

  • CRMやSales Engagementツールを活用し、パイプラインやアクティビティを適切に管理できる方。

  • 日本語に堪能であり、英語での業務遂行に抵抗のない方。

  • 社内外問わず適切に連携し、周囲を巻き込みながら成果を最大化できるOne Teamマインドセットをお持ちの方。

 
 
 

Japan Benefits（一部）

  • Free lunch at office

  • 401K（企業型確定拠出年金）

  • RSU

  • Phone & Gym reimbursement

  • 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Snowflakeは、エージェント型エンタープライズの時代を切り拓いています。その実現に向け、あらゆる職種でAIネイティブな発想を持ち、自らの働き方を再定義することに意欲を持つ仲間を求めています。

AIを単なるツールとして使うのではなく、信頼できる協働パートナーとして仕事の中心に取り入れ、好奇心を持って課題解決や成果の加速に活用する方。変化の速い環境を楽しみ、謙虚な姿勢で新しい機能を素早く試し、よりシンプルで効果的な方法を見つけられる方を歓迎します。

Snowflakeで担うのは、担当領域を遂行するだけの役割ではありません。仕事の進め方そのものの未来を、ともに形づくる役割です。

Activation Engineer’s Mission?

Activation Solution Engineerは、新規および導入初期のお客様がSnowflake AI Data Cloudを迅速に活用し、導入から定着、拡大へと進むための技術面を支援する、影響力の大きいクロスファンクショナルなポジションです。AIを活用した最新のツールやコーディングエージェントを駆使し、初期利用の促進と技術的な成功を実現します。

お客様の導入初期における技術面のパートナーとして、短期間での実装と価値創出を支援し、Snowflakeプラットフォームの優れた顧客体験を提供します。初期ユースケースの立ち上げ、アクティベーション、定着に向けた技術イネーブルメントを担います。クラウドデータアーキテクチャの専門性を深めながら、お客様の成功に直接貢献できるポジションです。

The Impact You will Make

  • 担当する新規および導入初期のお客様の技術的な成功と利用拡大を主導し、アカウントごとの導入・利用指標の向上と、価値実現までの時間短縮に責任を持つ。お客様のニーズに対応する窓口として、社内外の関係者をつなぐ。

  • 製品機能の説明にとどまらず、Snowflake AI Data Cloudがお客様のデータ課題をどう解決し、ビジネス価値の最大化につながるかを軸に、成果に基づく利用促進を行う。

  • 契約締結後の早い段階から信頼されるアドバイザーとして、データ戦略や技術スタックとの統合について助言し、ユースケースの迅速かつ円滑な立ち上げを支援する。

  • AIを活用した開発ツールや自動化を用いて、ソリューション提供や実装支援を効率化し、お客様の本番環境への移行を加速する。

  • Snowflakeプラットフォーム、データプロダクト、エージェント型ワークフローに関する技術的なガイダンスを提供する。

  • アカウントチームと協力してリスクを把握し、Snowflake内の各チームや外部パートナーとの信頼関係を築きながら、必要なリソースを適切に連携する。

  • ハンズオンラボ（HoL）やウェビナーなど、幅広いお客様にプラットフォーム機能や業界のベストプラクティスを伝える、再利用可能で拡張性の高いプログラムを企画・実施する。

  • お客様の声や現場で得た知見を社内に還元し、プロダクトマネジメントやエンジニアリングチームと連携して製品の進化に貢献する。

  • お客様向けワークショップ、エグゼクティブ・ブリーフィング、業界イベント、コミュニティミートアップなどでSnowflakeを代表して情報発信を行う。

Who You Are

必須要件

  • データテクノロジー領域での実務経験8年以上

  • モダンデータスタック、ETL／ELT、データウェアハウス／データレイク、データサイエンス、生成AI、データアプリケーションに関する高い技術力

  • PythonおよびSQLの高度な実務スキル

  • Apache Spark、PySparkなどの分散コンピューティングフレームワーク、およびdbtなどのモダンデータスタックツールに関する豊富な経験

  • AWS、Microsoft Azure、Google Cloudなど、主要クラウドプラットフォームの基本概念に関する理解と実務経験

  • 学び続け、技術力を高め、Snowflakeプラットフォームの専門性を深める意欲

  • 多様な相手に技術的な内容を明確に伝えられる、優れた文書・口頭コミュニケーション能力

  • 複数のプロジェクトを並行して管理し、合意したスケジュールに沿ってお客様を支援・推進するプロジェクトマネジメント能力

  • コンピューターサイエンス、工学、数学または関連分野の大学卒業、もしくは技術職での同等の実務経験

歓迎要件

  • Snowflake認定資格、またはSnowflakeの本番環境での実務経験

  • Python、Java、Scalaなどの追加のプログラミング言語スキル。特にデータ開発またはアプリケーション開発での活用経験

  • AIを活用した開発ツールやコーディングエージェントを用いて、ソリューション提供の効率を高める経験または強い関心

Japan Benefits（一部）

  • Free lunch at office

  • 401K（企業型確定拠出年金）

  • RSU

  • Phone & Gym reimbursement

  • 3 day Summer Vacation & 5 day Year-end Holidays

  • Paid Parental Leave

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Outer Loop), Engineering Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

About the Team

Engineering Systems is the team redefining how Snowflake builds. We develop AI-powered tools, platforms, and workflows that accelerate delivery, strengthen reliability, and drive deeper developer satisfaction. Now, we’re unlocking the next frontier, bringing AI transformation to boost productivity, elevate the developer experience, and set a new standard for engineering efficiency across Snowflake.

What You Will Do

As a Principal Software Engineer on the Outer Loop team in the Engineering Systems organization, you will set the technical direction for how Snowflake tests, validates, and releases software in an AI-first world. You will build the frameworks, tooling, and practices that let our engineering organization scale its velocity by an order of magnitude without compromising quality.

  • Build agent-first test frameworks: Extend test frameworks from humans to agents. Build layers of verifiers that agents can autonomously hill climb on correctness and performance. Extend observability for agents to detect, diagnose and auto fix test or product issues.

  • Improve release tooling and process: Re-imagine our release pipelines and processes to drive faster, more frequent releases with higher quality. Shorten commit-to-production cycle time, reduce release friction and toil, and build the automation, gating, and observability needed to ship confidently at scale.

  • Identify quality escapes and drive systemic fixes: Analyze production incidents, regressions, and customer-impacting defects to identify quality escapes and recurring themes. Turn those insights into concrete changes in testing strategy, tooling, and engineering practices that measurably reduce escapes across the organization.

  • Set strategy and lead across organizations: Drive multi-quarter technical strategy for the outer loop, influence engineering-wide standards, and partner with product managers, architects, release management, and product engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Measure what matters: Define and own metrics for test signal quality, flakiness, release velocity, change failure rate, and escape rates, and use data to prioritize the highest-leverage investments.

  • Raise the bar: Mentor senior and junior engineers, set the bar on AI era talent, set ambitious goals and understand the art of what is possible with AI transformation.

What We're Looking For

Our ideal Principal Software Engineer will have:

  • 12+ years of industry experience building developer infrastructure, test frameworks, CI/CD, or release systems for large, complex codebases.

  • Hands on experience with building and scaling AI solutions include AI SRE. Experience with building fully self-driving codebase is a plus.

  • A proven track record of designing and scaling test infrastructure and frameworks (e.g., distributed test execution, test selection and sharding, flaky test management, hermetic environments) used by many teams.

  • Deep experience with release engineering: CI/CD pipelines, progressive delivery, release gating and qualification, rollbacks, and production feedback loops.

  • A data-driven approach to quality: experience analyzing incidents and defect data to identify quality escapes and systemic themes, and driving practice changes that reduce them.

  • Strong passion for making developers highly productive, and for building platforms that let many teams move faster while keeping systems maintainable and safe.

  • A strategic mindset and a strong sense of what to prioritize for maximum impact; comfort leading through ambiguity and influencing without authority across a large engineering organization.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and strong CS fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

  • Ability to work in a team environment, collaborate well, and mentor engineers at all levels.

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral English communication skills.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst II - AI & Data Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Strategic Finance is building one of the most AI-native finance teams in software, supporting one of the largest consumption-based business models in the public markets. We build the workflows, agents, and applications that the CFO, CEO, and executive team use to run the business, and we feed what we learn back to Product and Engineering to make Snowflake better. We are hiring two builders: one focused on data engineering and data quality, and one focused on AI-powered workflow and process automation.

AS AN ANALYST, STRATEGIC FINANCE - AI & DATA SYSTEMS AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Build and ship AI-powered tools, agents, and applications on Snowflake, using Cortex Code, Claude Code, Node.js/Next.js, and unreleased beta products to better serve senior executives.

  • Own the data behind executive reporting, including the weekly revenue business review: Partner with world-class data engineers building pipelines in Airflow, dbt, and Fivetran, and diagnose and fix breakages quickly when they happen.

  • Monitor and improve data quality across finance datasets, applying statistical thinking to catch anomalies, reconcile sources, and keep numbers trustworthy.

  • Find manual finance processes and automate them with AI, from report generation to knowledge capture and team workflows.

  • Act as customer zero for new Snowflake AI capabilities: partner with Product Managers and Engineers, share feedback, and help promising internal prototypes graduate into the product.

  • Build V0 solutions, win internal users, and partner with Product and Engineering when they scale.

  • Become a key part of the team that leaders rely on as the go-to expert on high-stakes topics such as annual planning and winning competitive accounts. Bring insights that get you invited into the room, then shape the decisions senior leaders make, not just review them.

OUR IDEAL ANALYST, STRATEGIC FINANCE - AI & DATA SYSTEMS WILL HAVE:

  • 2+ years of relevant experience in a quantitative role such as product management, software engineering, analytics engineering, business operations, consulting, or data science.

  • A degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Fully AI-native: you default to AI for everything, from coding to analysis to running your own workday with agents. You can show recent work that would have taken a team without AI.

  • A builder track record, such as a GitHub portfolio, a shipped side project, or something you created and grew on your own.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working through ambiguous, messy data.

  • A self-starter mindset: you figure things out, jump in where needed, and want your work to have visible impact.

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical work to executive and non-technical audiences.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Working knowledge of SQL and Python.

  • Understanding of data pipelines and data modeling, including table structure, cardinality, and query performance.

  • Hands-on exposure to Airflow, dbt, or Fivetran in a production environment.

  • Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, or Streamlit.

  • Interest in a product-minded path: taking ideas from prototype to adoption to handoff.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will be doing finance with AI further along than almost any company, with the compute and tooling to build freely. The tools this team creates are used by Snowflake's top executives, and Product, Engineering, and Data leaders regularly ask to see what we build.

This is a rare early-career role with direct executive exposure, real ownership, and a clear path to influence the Snowflake product itself. Heavy financial modeling experience is not required: we care most about how you think, how you build, and how fast you learn.

 - Own the data behind executive reporting, including the weekly revenue business review: Partner with world-class data engineers building pipelines in Airflow, dbt, and Fivetran, and diagnose and fix breakages quickly when they happen.

 - Monitor and improve data quality across finance datasets, applying statistical thinking to catch anomalies, reconcile sources, and keep numbers trustworthy.

 - Find manual finance processes and automate them with AI, from report generation to knowledge capture and team workflows.

 - Act as customer zero for new Snowflake AI capabilities: partner with Product Managers and Engineers, share feedback, and help promising internal prototypes graduate into the product.

 - Build V0 solutions, win internal users, and partner with Product and Engineering when they scale.

 - Become a key part of the team that leaders rely on as the go-to expert on high-stakes topics such as annual planning and winning competitive accounts. Bring insights that get you invited into the room, then shape the decisions senior leaders make, not just review them.

 - 2+ years of relevant experience in a quantitative role such as product management, software engineering, analytics engineering, business operations, consulting, or data science.

 - A degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Fully AI-native: you default to AI for everything, from coding to analysis to running your own workday with agents. You can show recent work that would have taken a team without AI.

 - A builder track record, such as a GitHub portfolio, a shipped side project, or something you created and grew on your own.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working through ambiguous, messy data.

 - A self-starter mindset: you figure things out, jump in where needed, and want your work to have visible impact.

 - Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical work to executive and non-technical audiences.

 - Working knowledge of SQL and Python.

 - Understanding of data pipelines and data modeling, including table structure, cardinality, and query performance.

 - Hands-on exposure to Airflow, dbt, or Fivetran in a production environment.

 - Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark, or Streamlit.

 - Interest in a product-minded path: taking ideas from prototype to adoption to handoff.

You will be doing finance with AI further along than almost any company, with the compute and tooling to build freely. The tools this team creates are used by Snowflake's top executives, and Product, Engineering, and Data leaders regularly ask to see what we build.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Commercial Solutions Engineer for the BeNeLux market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Commercial Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Dutch-speaker

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Account Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

 

The Opportunity: Accelerate the AI Data Cloud Journey

The Account Engineer is a post-sales technical role responsible for accelerating customer time-to-production and driving early consumption growth. You will partner directly with new Snowflake customers to guide their architecture, security and warehouse setup, activate outcome-focused use cases, and make sure they reach their first production workloads quickly and confidently.

As an Account Engineer, you will independently own onboarding engagements across your portfolio. You will act as the single technical point of contact for each account, lead your own account micro-business, and use AI-native workflows to move customers to production faster.

This is a high-autonomy role for an experienced, customer-facing technical professional. You will own kickoffs, activation planning and workload setup across your portfolio, seeking guidance only on genuinely ambiguous scenarios, and you will informally mentor less experienced team members.

 

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

You will own the technical success of a portfolio of new customers, from first discovery through to go-live and early expansion.

Build Trust

  • Discovery and Technical Point of View: Independently lead onboarding technical discovery, drive the technical point of view to set baseline architecture and activation scope, and present implementation plans and refine them live with customers.

  • Implementation Scoping and Activation Planning: Lead scoping and delivery from implementation start to go-live, write implementation plans with clear responsibilities for Snowflake, partners and customers, and run kick-off calls and track progress to go-live.

  • Competitive Differentiation: Use Snowflake's differentiators to guide the best implementation patterns, anticipate objections, and educate customers throughout onboarding.

Deliver Results

  • Customer Onboarding and Adoption: Own onboarding and early adoption end-to-end, and design tailored enablement and custom onboarding assets using AI coding agents.

  • Architectural Guidance: Advise customers on Snowflake best practices, including workload isolation, warehouse utilisation, resource monitors, budgets and RBAC/security setup.

  • Streamlining Go-Lives: Independently resolve implementation risks and technical blockers, rapidly prototype solutions with AI-native tools, and keep use case records accurate and up to date.

Grow Trust

  • Articulating and Proving Value: Connect platform features to business outcomes through a consumption and adoption lens, and prepare business reviews, consumption health checks and value realisation reports.

  • Driving Growth and Expansion: Partner with the Account Executive to identify and drive expansion in your accounts, and lead the creation and progression of new use cases.

Collaboration and Community

  • Enablement: Design and deliver customer workshops, enablement sessions and office hours.

  • Knowledge Sharing: Replicate successful activation strategies and share AI-native workflows with the wider team.

  • Mentorship: Informally mentor less experienced Account Engineers and support peers on their accounts when needed.

  • Operational Excellence: Keep account and use case data accurate, and self-audit records before reviews.

     

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience, including time in a customer-facing role.

  • SQL and Data Architecture: Strong hands-on SQL and data architecture experience.

  • Cloud and Modern Data Stack: Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).

  • Delivery: Project management skills to drive customers to agreed timelines.

  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with both technical and business audiences.

  • Certification: SnowPro Core certification.

  • Education: A degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

     

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SnowPro Advanced certification.

  • Programming experience in Python, Java or Scala, and experience with dbt, CI/CD and orchestration tools.

  • Daily use of AI-powered development tools and coding agents to accelerate delivery.

  • Experience leading customer workshops or enablement sessions.

     

Why Join Us

Account Engineering sits at the centre of how our customers succeed on Snowflake. You will work on hard, high-impact problems with direct influence on how leading organisations use data, and help shape how the team works, from the playbooks we build to the people we grow.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

We are hiring a Commercial Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across the Israeli mid-market. This is a high-velocity, full-cycle sales role where you will own a territory of commercial accounts, build pipeline from the ground up, and close deals that land Snowflake's platform in some of Israel's most innovative and fast-growing companies. You will work at the intersection of a deeply technical product and a market that is uniquely receptive to data and AI innovation. This is the first Commercial AE role in Israel, and you will play a foundational part in building Snowflake's commercial presence in one of the world's most dynamic technology markets.

AS A COMMERCIAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the full sales cycle for a defined territory of mid-market and commercial accounts in Israel, from prospecting and pipeline generation through negotiation and close

  • Build and execute a territory plan that prioritises the highest-potential accounts and aligns outbound activity with Snowflake's go-to-market strategy for the Israeli market

  • Generate pipeline through a disciplined mix of outbound prospecting, partnership with Sales Development Representatives, and field marketing programs

  • Run compelling discovery conversations that uncover data, analytics, and AI pain points and connect them to Snowflake's platform capabilities

  • Deliver product demonstrations alongside Solution Engineers, translating technical capabilities into clear business value for commercial buyers

  • Manage a high volume of concurrent opportunities across different stages, maintaining accurate forecasting and CRM hygiene in Salesforce

  • Collaborate with Solution Engineering, Customer Success, and Partner teams to ensure a seamless customer experience from first touch through go-live

  • Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets

OUR IDEAL COMMERCIAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience in a closing sales role in enterprise B2B technology, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota

  • Experience selling into mid-market or commercial accounts with deal cycles of 30 to 120 days

  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through outbound prospecting and to manage a high volume of concurrent opportunities

  • Strong discovery and qualification skills, with the ability to identify business pain and connect it to a technical platform value proposition

  • Comfort presenting to technical and business audiences including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Heads of Data

  • Fluency in Hebrew and English (spoken and written) is required

  • Experience using CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or equivalent)

Snowflake's Sales Operations team is seeking a Sales Planning Systems Manager to join the Sales Planning and Compensation team.

In this role, you will serve as the subject matter expert in the sales planning system, leveraging your experience from system implementation, model building, project management, and sales planning & operations. You will collaborate with Finance, Recruiting, HR, Field Operations, Sales Planning, and Sales Compensation teams to improve existing models and create roadmaps for new ones using the planning system. Success in this role requires hands-on experience with Anaplan or Pigment model building at a certified solution architect level, along with a deep understanding of headcount & capacity planning.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Own the sales headcount, sales capacity, and compensation plan models for commissionable employees. Partner with Sales Finance, Sales Leadership, and HR to power the annual planning and deployment cycle and in-year scenario modeling.

  • Serve as product manager, creating a structured feedback loop and strategic roadmap with key stakeholders, ensuring clear delivery milestones and expectations.

  • Enable teams by designing customized training programs to improve the end-user experience and system adoption.

  • Be a thought leader, driving operational efficiency across teams through system automation and AI solutions.

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics within sales planning & operations or adjacent fields

  • 5+ years of experience focused on architecting planning solutions, leading implementation projects, and providing end-user enablement.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, simplifying complex business requirements.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to handle multiple concurrent projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.

  • Expertise in root cause analysis, with the ability to communicate findings clearly to senior leadership.

  • Bring an AI-first approach to automating and improving planning and comp modeling workflows.

  • Bachelor degree in business, statistics, economics, or other quantitative disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An MBA or other relevant advanced degree is preferred

  • Master Anaplanner or Anaplan Solutions Architect certification is preferred

  • Experience with Pigment implementation is preferred

  • At ease with structuring high volumes of unstructured data to derive insights

  • A talent for solving complex business problems with simple, user-friendly solutions that drive easy adoption.

  • A passion for elevating the team through streamlined process and system automation

How do you want to make your impact?

Our enterprise sales team is expanding, and we are seeking a seasoned, outcomes-focused Enterprise Account Executive to join our acquisition team in Malaysia. This is a unique opportunity to build net-new business in a market with strong momentum, helping enterprise organisations harness the full potential of their data and Snowflake’s platform for their cloud and AI ambitions. You will be instrumental in identifying, engaging, and closing new logos across Malaysia, creating pipeline early, and delivering high-visibility, high-impact outcomes for customers.

 

A bit about you:

We are looking for an individual who can act with autonomy, take accountability, and is open to new perspectives and ideas. Our team has a deep curiosity to learn and is always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers’ needs in this rapidly evolving Data & AI landscape.

 

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Snowflake, you will:

  • Understand Snowflake’s evolving product and ecosystem, with a focus on AI capabilities, and conduct discovery calls, customised demos, and presentations for prospective customers.

  • Build and execute a territory strategy for Malaysia, identifying, creating, and progressing net-new opportunities across enterprise organisations.

  • Hunt for new strategic use cases by engaging both business and technology stakeholders, understanding their existing and future business and IT roadmap, and positioning Snowflake as a strategic platform for long-term data and AI transformation.

  • Focus on developing and deepening sales opportunities in your territory by proactively creating pipeline, building executive relationships, and championing high-value use cases.

  • Develop and execute a sales strategy to achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas, driving consistent activity, disciplined qualification, and strong pipeline development.

  • Work closely with Snowflake partners and internal cross-functional teams, including Solutions Engineering, professional services, marketing, legal, and finance, to deliver value and accelerate deal progression.

Experience you will bring:

  • Deep field sales experience with consistent success meeting or exceeding sales objectives selling technical solutions and software products into the enterprise market.

  • A track record in securing new logos

  • Demonstrable experience executing enterprise complex sales strategies and tactics within one of the following spaces Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science and/or AI/ML

  • A familiarity with solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organisation and contact management capabilities.

  • The ability to build our product and company like it’s your own, specifically defining and executing sales plans to meet strategic & financial targets, leveraging industry, partner & Go-to-Market knowledge

  • This ability to provide open, honest and respectful feedback creating an inclusive work environment

  • A reputation for Making Each Other Better: Resulting in long standing relationships with internal cross functional partners and the ability to create an inclusive work environment

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close new client relationships.

  • Experience hitting multi million $ revenue targets on an annual basis.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to join Snowflake at a pivotal stage in Malaysia’s market development.

  • A locally employed role in Malaysia with access to Snowflake’s current local benefits framework.

  • Eligibility for RSUs for new hires.

  • A chance to help shape Snowflake’s growth with strategic enterprise customers in a market with strong forward momentum.

 

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.

Are you ready for the experience of your career at a high-growth company? Do you enjoy building? Do you want to work with a collaborative team where learning is shared and you are supported? Snowflake is still growing and hiring globally, and we need a Sr Compensation Analyst, to assist with our tremendous growth.

AS A SENIOR ANALYST - COMP OPERATIONS, YOU WILL:

  • Design, build, and deploy scalable automated workflows to eliminate manual bottlenecks across employee lifecycle events, mass data transactions, and multi-tier approval chains.

  • Build intuitive, interactive and dynamic reporting flows that empower Compensation Business Partners to run on-demand offer simulations and peer parity analyses.

  • Lead market benchmarking efforts to evaluate internal equity and external competitiveness, refining job architecture and pay ranges to support business objectives.

  • Support the execution of our global planning cycles, with a focus on data integrity, reporting, and process optimization.

  • Partner with the Recruiting Team to optimize offer processes and provide market intelligence and insights.

  • Develop and maintain compensation tools, dashboards, and templates to drive informed decision-making.

  • Participate in special compensation projects as needed.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:

  • Be a subject matter expert on all compensation fundamentals, requiring 5+ years of related compensation experience in a global technology environment

  • Strong experience with Workday (or similar global HRIS) for data extraction, manipulation, and reporting.

  • Have deep knowledge of compensation practices and have experience with RSUs, stock options and performance equity plans

  • Expert-level quantitative and statistical modeling skills with a proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.

  • A team player who can work in a collaborative environment, cross-functionally and globally, at a fast pace

  • A proven ability to design, build, and deploy data models and analytical tools to automate and improve compensation processes.

  • Demonstrated programming fluency in SQL and Python (or R) to query large datasets and build custom analytical tools. Expert-level proficiency in advanced Excel functions (e.g., array formulas, Power Query) is required.

  • Strong interest in Pay Equity and Pay Transparency initiatives

YOU WILL RECEIVE BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Being a situational, influential leader with the ability to operate in the gray space, pivot as needed, and keep up in a hyper-growth environment

  • Enacting process improvements and bringing new ideas to the table

  • Large technology company experience

WHY JOIN OUR HUMAN RESOURCES COMPENSATION TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is an exciting opportunity to join the highly respected and collaborative Snowflake HR organization. We are first and foremost a customer service organization. Our #1 objective is to support the business in achieving their goals. We operate situationally, not from an abundance of policies. This means there isn’t always a “one size fits all” approach to Compensation decisions. We are consultants and advisors and believe the business will make the best decision when presented with all the facts. There are times, however, when we do need to push back, requiring this leader to be a strong, confident communicator and a skilled negotiator.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Account Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

 

The Opportunity: Accelerate the AI Data Cloud Journey

The Account Engineer is a post-sales technical role responsible for accelerating customer time-to-production and driving early consumption growth. You will partner directly with new Snowflake customers to guide their architecture, security and warehouse setup, activate outcome-focused use cases, and make sure they reach their first production workloads quickly and confidently.

As an Account Engineer, you will independently own onboarding engagements across your portfolio. You will act as the single technical point of contact for each account, lead your own account micro-business, and use AI-native workflows to move customers to production faster.

This is a high-autonomy role for an experienced, customer-facing technical professional. You will own kickoffs, activation planning and workload setup across your portfolio, seeking guidance only on genuinely ambiguous scenarios, and you will informally mentor less experienced team members.

 

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

You will own the technical success of a portfolio of new customers, from first discovery through to go-live and early expansion.

Build Trust

  • Discovery and Technical Point of View: Independently lead onboarding technical discovery, drive the technical point of view to set baseline architecture and activation scope, and present implementation plans and refine them live with customers.

  • Implementation Scoping and Activation Planning: Lead scoping and delivery from implementation start to go-live, write implementation plans with clear responsibilities for Snowflake, partners and customers, and run kick-off calls and track progress to go-live.

  • Competitive Differentiation: Use Snowflake's differentiators to guide the best implementation patterns, anticipate objections, and educate customers throughout onboarding.

Deliver Results

  • Customer Onboarding and Adoption: Own onboarding and early adoption end-to-end, and design tailored enablement and custom onboarding assets using AI coding agents.

  • Architectural Guidance: Advise customers on Snowflake best practices, including workload isolation, warehouse utilisation, resource monitors, budgets and RBAC/security setup.

  • Streamlining Go-Lives: Independently resolve implementation risks and technical blockers, rapidly prototype solutions with AI-native tools, and keep use case records accurate and up to date.

Grow Trust

  • Articulating and Proving Value: Connect platform features to business outcomes through a consumption and adoption lens, and prepare business reviews, consumption health checks and value realisation reports.

  • Driving Growth and Expansion: Partner with the Account Executive to identify and drive expansion in your accounts, and lead the creation and progression of new use cases.

Collaboration and Community

  • Enablement: Design and deliver customer workshops, enablement sessions and office hours.

  • Knowledge Sharing: Replicate successful activation strategies and share AI-native workflows with the wider team.

  • Mentorship: Informally mentor less experienced Account Engineers and support peers on their accounts when needed.

  • Operational Excellence: Keep account and use case data accurate, and self-audit records before reviews.

     

Required Qualifications

  • Spanish language speaking skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience, including time in a customer-facing role.

  • SQL and Data Architecture: Strong hands-on SQL and data architecture experience.

  • Cloud and Modern Data Stack: Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).

  • Delivery: Project management skills to drive customers to agreed timelines.

  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with both technical and business audiences.

  • Certification: SnowPro Core certification.

  • Education: A degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

     

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SnowPro Advanced certification.

  • Programming experience in Python, Java or Scala, and experience with dbt, CI/CD and orchestration tools.

  • Daily use of AI-powered development tools and coding agents to accelerate delivery.

  • Experience leading customer workshops or enablement sessions.

     

Why Join Us

Account Engineering sits at the centre of how our customers succeed on Snowflake. You will work on hard, high-impact problems with direct influence on how leading organisations use data, and help shape how the team works, from the playbooks we build to the people we grow.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - FSI Emerging Enterprise
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake are looking for a Solution Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

  • Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

 

On day one you we will expect you to have:

  • Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Experience in Banking

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solution Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 

In this role you will get to:

 - Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

 - Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

 - Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

 - Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

 - Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

 - Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

 - Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

 - Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

 - Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

 - Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

 - Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

 - Hands on experience with SQL

 - Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

 - Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

 - Experience in FSI

 - Hands on experience with Python

jobs.title: Account Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Opportunity: Accelerate the AI Data Cloud Journey

The Account Engineer is a post-sales technical role responsible for accelerating customer time-to-production and driving early consumption growth. You will partner directly with new Snowflake customers to guide their architecture, security and warehouse setup, activate outcome-focused use cases, and make sure they reach their first production workloads quickly and confidently.

As an Account Engineer, you will independently own onboarding engagements across your portfolio. You will act as the single technical point of contact for each account, lead your own account micro-business, and use AI-native workflows to move customers to production faster.

This is a high-autonomy role for an experienced, customer-facing technical professional. You will own kickoffs, activation planning and workload setup across your portfolio, seeking guidance only on genuinely ambiguous scenarios, and you will informally mentor less experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

You will own the technical success of a portfolio of new customers, from first discovery through to go-live and early expansion.

Build Trust

  • Discovery and Technical Point of View: Independently lead onboarding technical discovery, drive the technical point of view to set baseline architecture and activation scope, and present implementation plans and refine them live with customers.

  • Implementation Scoping and Activation Planning: Lead scoping and delivery from implementation start to go-live, write implementation plans with clear responsibilities for Snowflake, partners and customers, and run kick-off calls and track progress to go-live.

  • Competitive Differentiation: Use Snowflake's differentiators to guide the best implementation patterns, anticipate objections, and educate customers throughout onboarding.

Deliver Results

  • Customer Onboarding and Adoption: Own onboarding and early adoption end-to-end, and design tailored enablement and custom onboarding assets using AI coding agents.

  • Architectural Guidance: Advise customers on Snowflake best practices, including workload isolation, warehouse utilisation, resource monitors, budgets and RBAC/security setup.

  • Streamlining Go-Lives: Independently resolve implementation risks and technical blockers, rapidly prototype solutions with AI-native tools, and keep use case records accurate and up to date.

Grow Trust

  • Articulating and Proving Value: Connect platform features to business outcomes through a consumption and adoption lens, and prepare business reviews, consumption health checks and value realisation reports.

  • Driving Growth and Expansion: Partner with the Account Executive to identify and drive expansion in your accounts, and lead the creation and progression of new use cases.

Collaboration and Community

  • Enablement: Design and deliver customer workshops, enablement sessions and office hours.

  • Knowledge Sharing: Replicate successful activation strategies and share AI-native workflows with the wider team.

  • Mentorship: Informally mentor less experienced Account Engineers and support peers on their accounts when needed.

  • Operational Excellence: Keep account and use case data accurate, and self-audit records before reviews.

Required Qualifications

  • Swedish language speaking skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience, including time in a customer-facing role.

  • SQL and Data Architecture: Strong hands-on SQL and data architecture experience.

  • Cloud and Modern Data Stack: Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).

  • Delivery: Project management skills to drive customers to agreed timelines.

  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with both technical and business audiences.

  • Certification: SnowPro Core certification.

  • Education: A degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart (Preferred Qualifications)

  • SnowPro Advanced certification.

  • Programming experience in Python, Java or Scala, and experience with dbt, CI/CD and orchestration tools.

  • Daily use of AI-powered development tools and coding agents to accelerate delivery.

  • Experience leading customer workshops or enablement sessions.

Why Join Us

Account Engineering sits at the centre of how our customers succeed on Snowflake. You will work on hard, high-impact problems with direct influence on how leading organisations use data, and help shape how the team works, from the playbooks we build to the people we grow.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a senior, executive-facing role for someone with 10+ years' experience. It is not an engineering or coding role. You will be the strategic voice of Snowflake's Frontier Engineering team with the C-suite of some of the largest enterprises in Europe and the Middle East: inspiring what AI can change in their business, leading the discovery that finds the problems worth solving, and shaping engagements our engineers deliver.

About the team

Snowflake's Frontier Engineering (also known as Forward Deployed Engineering) team embeds directly inside enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production AI systems on the data they already trust. Our engineers are the people who build Snowflake itself. We work at risk: customers pay when they are happy with what we have delivered. And we do not do pilots that never ship.

What you will do

  • Engage executives. Sit with CEOs, COOs, CFOs, CISOs, CDOs, and CIOs and their teams. Understand how they make money, where the friction is, and what is at stake. Bring a point of view they cannot get from their own staff.

  • Inspire on the art of the possible. Lead executive briefings, workshops and vision sessions that show what AI grounded in a company's own governed data can do, adapted to the industry, the market and the room.

  • Lead discovery. Run structured discovery across business, IT and data stakeholders, prioritise use cases by value, feasibility and data readiness, and build the business case behind them.

  • Shape the engagement. With FDE product managers and engineers, turn discovery into a clear scope - objectives, success measures, and delivery approach - that our engineers can deliver against, and make the honest call when FDE is not the right answer. Collaborate with the Legal team to navigate IP, data rights, and contract terms specific to Frontier Engineering engagements.

  • Grow the relationship. Stay close through delivery, make sure the value case is realised, and help expand a first engagement into a portfolio across business units.

  • Build assets others reuse. Create industry points of view, value frameworks, and discovery guides that raise the bar for FDE and account teams across EMEA.

  • Feed signal back. Bring customer pain points and use-case patterns directly to FDE product and engineering leadership.

How the role works with account teams

You do not carry a sales quota. You understand the account goals and work with the account team in growing FDE engagements. You are assessed on the quality of that work within the FDE team. You would work alongside AEs on contracting and commercials. You own the engagement scope, product pricing, and delivery commitments. The AE will own the primary commercial relationship on the account and deal, and you will influence them to deliver high-margin Frontier Engineering engagements.

What you must bring

  • Executive presence that holds the room. You keep C-suite leaders engaged and bring a point of view, not a pitch.

  • Business-first fluency in AI and data. You connect AI to strategy and the P&L, and you understand why AI works best when it sits next to governed enterprise data. You speak the language of IT and data teams; you do not need to write code.

  • Discovery and scoping experience. You have led discovery and shaped complex, multi-stakeholder engagements into clear scopes and business cases, and you are honest about what will and will not be delivered.

  • 10+ years in enterprise technology, consulting or strategic advisory, including direct work with the C-suite - for example advising an executive team through a multi-year transformation, owning executive relationships on major accounts, or holding a CTO, CDO or Field CTO role.

What would set you apart

  • Hands-on use of AI beyond prompting - building agents, skills, or connectors - or comfort building and giving a demo

  • A background as a Field CTO, CTO, or management consultant with technical depth

  • Experience with Snowflake or comparable data and AI platforms

  • Deep expertise in a major industry, such as financial services, manufacturing, or the public sector

  • Experience with how large European or Middle Eastern enterprises buy technology: procurement, regulators, and AI regulation such as the EU AI Act

  • A second language, particularly German, French, or Arabic

Don't meet every point? If the must-haves describe you, we would still like to hear from you.

How success is measured

  • Depth and quality of the executive relationships you build

  • Discovery that turns into well-scoped engagements our engineers can deliver

  • Engagements that deliver against their value case

  • Growth from first engagement into a multi-use-case portfolio

  • Assets and frameworks adopted across the EMEA team

Location and travel

Based in our London office (not fully remote), covering customers across EMEA, with regular travel.

Why join

  • Close the gap between AI's promise and reality. Enterprises have heard plenty about AI; far fewer have it in production delivering value. Frontier Engineering is how Snowflake answers the 'how', not just the 'why'.

  • A real point of difference. AI grounded in a customer's own governed data gives better, more trustworthy answers than the same model anywhere else.

  • We put our own skin in the game. Customers pay when they are happy with the outcome, so everything we scope has to be real.

  • Exceptional colleagues. Work alongside the product engineers and researchers who build Snowflake.

  • Build something new. Be one of the first strategists in EMEA and help shape how the team grows.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Global Account Manager to own Snowflake's account strategy for a large global insurer, connecting executive priorities with measurable value from data, analytics, and AI. You will lead a coordinated global account approach, build trusted relationships, and identify opportunities across business units and regions.

AS A GLOBAL ACCOUNT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Develop and execute a multi-year Snowflake account plan for a single global insurance account, aligning business priorities, executive sponsorship, and regional opportunities.

  • Deliver quarterly and annual sales goals by expanding Snowflake adoption across new workloads and use cases, securing strategic commitments, and driving sustainable consumption growth.

  • Build relationships with business, technology, and data executives, connecting Snowflake's platform capabilities with customer outcomes.

  • Identify and qualify Snowflake opportunities across insurance analytics, customer insight, risk reporting, and AI, validating priorities with customer stakeholders.

  • Coordinate Snowflake solution engineers, value engineering, customer success, and partners to turn opportunities into successful deployments and measurable value.

  • Lead complex Snowflake commercial negotiations, aligning procurement, legal, and regional stakeholders through agreement closure.

  • Partner with marketing on Snowflake account-based engagement, executive workshops, and value-led campaigns tailored to the global account.

  • Maintain accurate Snowflake opportunity forecasts and lead account reviews covering adoption, delivery risks, customer satisfaction, and business value.

OUR IDEAL GLOBAL ACCOUNT MANAGER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience preferred, with an emphasis on data or cloud platforms.

  • Demonstrated success owning complex strategic accounts and closing seven-figure, multi-year agreements.

  • Experience leading distributed, cross-functional account teams through influence, with clear ownership and coordinated execution.

  • Executive relationship management skills and a consultative approach to understanding customer priorities within a multi layered and complex organisational structure.

  • Ability to develop compelling business cases, articulate return on investment, and navigate sophisticated negotiations.

  • Experience selling into insurance or regulated financial services, with an understanding of how governance and risk shape purchasing decisions.

  • Strong presentation, listening, and written communication skills, translating technical capabilities into business value.

  • Sound judgement, organisation, and the ability to adapt account strategy as customer needs evolve.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience positioning Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms in large enterprise accounts.

  • Knowledge of insurance data use cases, including claims analytics, underwriting insight, customer experience, and risk reporting.

  • Experience building joint account strategies with cloud providers, systems integrators, and technology partners.

  • Familiarity with governed data collaboration and enterprise AI adoption.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

You will shape the direction of a strategic account while bringing together commercial and technical expertise to help customers turn data into business outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to build long-term executive partnerships and lead complex, high-value transformation initiatives.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.descriptionHtml:
