Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team. Our EMEA Partners & Alliances organization is seeking a Partner Sales Manager to join our growing team in EMEA Central (Eastern Europe).
GSI and RSI Partners offer consulting services and implement Snowflake in customer environments and refer new customers to Snowflake. We are looking for a self driven, go getter to help grow these Partners into profitable revenue streams and accelerate our Partner Ecosystem and the growth of the business.

We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of strong communication skills, diplomacy in successfully working with difficult partners (it’s easy when everything is going fine) and strong business acumen in growing a business/ channel/ partnership.

Reporting to the Regional Partner Director for EMEA Central, you will have a unique opportunity to work for a disruptive company at the forefront of the Data & AI revolution, and lead the development of a vibrant Partner community.

AS A PARTNER DEVELOPMENT MANAGER (EMEA CENTRAL) YOU WILL:

  • Manage a portfolio of high performing Global Systems Integrators (GSI's) and Regional SI’s (RSIs) to achieve partnership goals such as net new customers and consumption

  • Support your partners in their go-to-market activities (business planning, pipeline development, QBR, marketing, enablement sales activities across different Go-To-Market options…)

  • Ensure successful execution of the business plan by developing and managing relationships across functional areas within the partner

  • Work with the partner to expand the partnership into new strategic areas (new Service Lines and Industry Verticals)

  • Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders (typically Partner/Managing Director Level)

  • Organise and execute events with and for our partner community

  • Pitch value proposition of Snowflake partnership on all levels (up to C-Level)

  • Ensure alignment of all relevant stakeholders on pursues in joint accounts

OUR IDEAL PDM WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Channel Management, Software/Services Sales, Consulting, and/or Business Development in Cloud or Software Technology

  • Experience in working with SIs (such as KPMG, EY, CapGemini, Atos, etc.) to leverage their strategic influence to drive technology sales in a joint sales offering

  • Proven experience in delivering strong results in pipeline generation and bookings, by leveraging existing and recruiting targeted new partners

  • Cloud Technology, AI/ML, Data, Analytics, API and platform experience and understanding

  • Ability to build, lead and implement strategy in a cross-functional environment

  • Strong executive selling and business development skills; proven ability to understand different partner GTM and organizational models

  • Ability to design and present business plans, track and articulate program progress, design and document program guidelines for distribution throughout the organization (all levels) and for external use

  • MUST HAVE: Excellent communication skills, verbal & written in Polish & English.

  • Strong problem solving skills and ability to organize priorities in a dynamic environment

  • Bachelor's degree

  • Be able to travel between 25% - 50% in some months

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE:

  • Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product!

  • Develop a brand new set of ecosystem alliances for Snowflake making data more accessible to customers

  • Develop, lead and execute industry-changing initiatives

  • Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is looking for someone with adaptability and aptitude to join our Product admin team and elevate the business through proactive and holistic support of Product Management leadership.

 

As an Executive Assistant, you’re at the center of the team’s business operations and activities, and are relied upon to keep the team moving in a positive, forward direction. You are organized, dependable and able to keep up with changing business needs - using your understanding to strategically support and prioritize your team’s projects. You also have communication skills needed to interact with a variety of people and job functions including customers, partners and vendors. In this role you will work closely with a team of Administrative professionals and manage the day-to-day operations of the office and help keep teams efficient, happy and productive.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Perform an extensive array of core administrative tasks:

    • Effectively manage and maintain complex calendars for Product Leadership.

    • Book complex travel and manage team and executive level expenses.

    • Create, organize and maintain team mailing lists, folders, drives.

    • Organize, plan and execute team events.

    • Respond to questions and requests for information by employees and guests, connecting people with the right resources.

    • Responsible for greeting executive’s guests (ie. interviews, customers, etc.) and ensuring every guest sign in upon arrival.

  • Attend team meetings and track action items, assist with day-to-day projects, help build and improve processes and systems.

  • Drive projects and own the operations of programs and initiatives within the Product team.

  • Be the main liaison for coordinating meetings and external engagements with our customers, and partners.

  • Lead and manage small projects within the administrative team.

  • Other duties as assigned.

 

Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of relevant work experience -- direct executive support, project management, and event planning experience.

  • Proven ability to manage time efficiently and prioritize multiple stakeholders, functions and tasks.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; proven ability to take initiative and build strong, productive relationships.

  • Experience implementing systems, processes, or programs that increase efficiency.

  • Positive, can-do attitude and willingness to jump into a myriad of projects. Resourceful self-starter that is curious, asks questions and can make logical, proactive decisions in a fast-paced and demanding environment.

  • Extreme attention to detail, organized and responsive.

  • Embrace and spread the Snowflake culture which revolves around our values

  • Generally tech savvy

  • Experience working with all levels of management, employees, vendors, and customers

 
 

We’re looking for people who share our passion for ground-breaking technology and want to create a lasting future for you and Snowflake.

 

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Commercial Solutions Engineer - Acquisition
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Commercial Solutions Engineer for the German market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

 

As a Snowflake Commercial Solutions Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

 
 

In this role you will get to:

  • Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

  • Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

  • Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

  • Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

  • Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

  • Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

  • Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

  • Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

     

On day one we will expect you to have:

  • Sales engineering/solution architect experience in a SaaS environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

  • Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

  • Hands on experience with SQL

  • Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

  • Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

  • German language skills

     

Preferred (but not required) to have:

  • Hands on experience with Python

  • Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

  • Experience with data science and machine learning technology

     

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solutions Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

 

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We are looking for a Senior Executive Assistant to support our VP of Marketing, EMEA, based in Paris. You will be a trusted right hand to the leader building Snowflake's brand awareness and engagement with customers across the region, running the operational rhythm of the EMEA Marketing leadership team.

AS A SENIOR EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Own the VP Marketing EMEA's complex, multi-time-zone calendar, prioritising time for strategic planning reviews, GTM leadership alignment, external facing initiatives, public speaking engagement and executive customer engagements

  • Coordinate the VP's involvement in Snowflake flagship events such as Snowflake Summit, Expedition and Snowflake World Tour stops across EMEA, including speaker prep, briefing documents, and on-site logistics

  • EMEA Marketing leadership cadence: staff meetings, quarterly planning, annual team offsite, and EMEA Marketing all-hands, owning agendas, pre-reads, and action tracking in collaboration with Planning Lead

  • Prepare materials for internal communication such as EMEA Marketing All-hands and EMEA Marketing weekly report / newsletter with Planning Lead

  • Plan and manage international travel, visas, and itineraries across EMEA and to the US, adapting quickly when priorities shift and handle related expenses

  • Experiment with Snowflake Intelligence, Cortex AI, and other AI tools to automate briefings, meeting summaries, and recurring admin workflows

  • Handle confidential information, including organisational and budget plans, with the highest level of discretion

OUR IDEAL SENIOR EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT WILL HAVE:

  • 5+ years of experience supporting VP-level or C-level executives, ideally in a fast-growing technology or SaaS organisation

  • Exceptional organisational skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities with calm and good judgement

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging executives, customers, agencies, and partners

  • Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom, plus experience with expense and procurement tools such as Navan or Workday

  • A proactive, anticipatory mindset: you spot issues before they become problems and propose solutions

  • Proven discretion with sensitive and confidential information

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach and comfort working in a dynamic, ambiguous environment

  • Fluent French, written and spoken

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience supporting a Marketing leader or marketing leadership team

  • Experience coordinating large-scale events or executive speaking engagements across multiple EMEA countries

  • Familiarity with marketing budgets, purchase order processes, and agency management

  • Hands-on use of generative AI tools to streamline executive support

  • Additional European languages

jobs.descriptionHtml:

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This is a hybrid, office-based role. Candidates must live within commuting distance of our Paris office and be able to work on site as required.

The Account Executive (Expansion) focuses on identifying growth opportunities and strengthening strategic relationships with enterprise clients in the Retail & CPG sector.

People who excel at this job have the ability to prospect, develop, and close business within a timely manner while focusing on the clients’ requirements. The candidate must have the confidence and ability to negotiate and close agreements with clients and support new customers through our on-boarding process.

This role is a unique opportunity to contribute in a meaningful way to high-visibility, high-impact projects at a very exciting time for the company. Snowflake is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused company operating in a large and growing market.

If you are an energetic, self-managed professional with experience managing complex sales processes, and you possess excellent presentation, listening, organizational, and contact management skills, we’d love to hear from you.

 

AS AN ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

  • Achieve quarterly and annual sales quotas across allocated accounts and territories by developing a regional sales plan, a prioritized target customer list, and a tailored territory sales strategy.

  • Develop marketing plans with the marketing team to drive revenue growth.

  • Be the trusted advisor to the customer by understanding their existing and future IT roadmap to drive the Snowflake solution within the marketplace.

  • Identify and qualify key prospects within customers to expand the sales pipeline and drive ongoing revenue growth.

  • Arrange and conduct initial Executive and CxO discussions and positioning meetings.

  • Drive the end-to-end sales cycle from pipeline management through to final deal closure.

  • Ongoing account management to ensure customer satisfaction and drive additional revenue streams.

  • Execute a consultative, solution-based sales methodology while navigating complex sales processes with superior presentation, listening, and organizational skills.

OUR IDEAL ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:

  • 7+ years of field sales experience (data or cloud technology preferred).

  • 3+ years industry-specific sales within our target vertical (retail & CPG)

  • Proven ability to independently manage, develop, and close client relationships.

  • New business sales focus.

  • A track record of success in driving consistent activity, pipeline development and quota achievement.

  • Proven consultative experience diagnosing customer requirements and presenting tailored solutions.

  • Strategic business acumen, with the ability to see the "bigger picture" and understand core IT business drivers.

  • Executive-level relationship management experience.

  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and relationship management skills.

  • A proactive, independent mindset paired with high energy and a positive attitude.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • BA/BS required.

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

  • Implementing and executing MEDDPICC (or similar enterprise sales qualification methodologies).

  • Selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications to large, complex organizations.

jobs.title: Principal Sourcer, Executive Recruiting
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Principal Sourcer to join our Executive Recruiting team as an analytical talent consultant, not a traditional sourcer. This role is part senior sourcer, part executive search researcher. You'll support our active executive searches and also build leadership talent ahead of need. You'll find, map and engage the Director+ and IC6+ leaders who will build the future of the AI Data Cloud across Engineering, Product Management and Frontier Engineering.

AS A PRINCIPAL SOURCER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Prepare and contribute search intake with Executive Recruiters and hiring leaders across Engineering, Product Management and Frontier Engineering. Set target companies, target profiles for Engineering and Product Management Director+ and IC roles, including principal and distinguished engineers.

  • Engage directly with senior leaders via networking and assessment to identify and pitch top talent, while garnering valuable insights that will fuel shifts in sourcing strategies over time.

  • Map the full talent landscape and build complete, calibrated slates, so leaders choose from the whole market rather than a few known names. Keep long-term executive pipelines and succession benches for critical leadership roles.

  • Leave no stone unturned when researching thin, competitive and emerging talent markets. Build talent in circles out from direct competitors to adjacent spaces, and find unusual channels for niche leadership roles in databases, distributed systems, AI/ML, data engineering, security and developer platforms.

  • Reverse-engineer competitor organizations by mapping org charts, how many people each leader manages, and who reports to whom across hyperscalers, data and AI platform companies, research labs and high-growth startups.

  • Utilize a combination of news and AI to track and share competitive intelligence, including leadership moves, reorgs and layoffs at peer companies, and send leaders regular talent market updates.

  • Give hiring leaders data-driven talent insights, with frank advice on market realities, how much talent exists, hiring trends, and pay and org design benchmarks for leadership roles.

  • Write highly personalized outreach that speaks to what motivates senior executives and stands out in a crowded market, creating moments that matter for leaders from first contact through handoff to the search team.

  • Own research operations: keep mapping data, tools and recruiting-system records clean, and build research assets the team can reuse. Tools include LinkedIn Recruiter, patents, academic and industry publications, and AI-powered tools.

  • Experiment, innovate and build with Snowflake’s internal AI tools, helping shape the next generation of executive recruiting and talent intelligence capabilities.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOURCER WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years of experience in sourcing, executive research or front-end recruiting at an executive search firm or a specialized in-house talent acquisition team.

  • Executive research experience on Director, Senior Director and VP searches, or senior technical IC searches, across complex technology companies.

  • Deep experience in market mapping, competitive intelligence and reaching passive executives, rather than relying on inbound or transactional channels.

  • Strong skills in reverse-engineering organizations, with a proven ability to rebuild competitor org structures and leadership reporting lines.

  • Enough technical fluency to engage senior engineers and product leaders credibly and judge their technical depth.

  • An advisory style, with the ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and influence them with data-driven recommendations.

  • Excellent writing skills, plus sound judgment and discretion on confidential searches.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Research experience at a retained executive search firm plus in-house executive recruiting at a high-growth technology company.

  • Familiarity with the AI, data and cloud ecosystem, including research labs and AI-native startups.

  • Experience building talent intelligence or market mapping programs from scratch.

  • Experience using generative AI tools to scale research, mapping and outreach.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Our Executive Recruiting team shapes the leadership that will define Snowflake's next chapter. You will work directly with senior technical leaders on the searches that matter most, and help shape how Snowflake attracts and builds world-class leadership talent across Engineering, Product and Frontier Engineering.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We're looking for an ambitious Enterprise SDR in Sydney to build pipeline with some of Australia's largest organisations. You'll be aligned to three Enterprise Account Executives, partnering closely with them, as well as Solution Engineers and Marketing, to open conversations with senior data, technology and business leaders across their named enterprise accounts. This role is designed as a launchpad into a closing role, with a structured career path towards an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) or Account Executive role, guided by clear, measurable performance milestones.

AS AN ENTERPRISE SDR AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Partner with your aligned Enterprise AEs to build and grow pipeline across their named enterprise accounts, agreeing shared priorities, targets and a regular operating rhythm

  • Run targeted, multi-threaded outbound campaigns into those accounts, engaging CDOs, CIOs, heads of data and line-of-business leaders by phone, email, LinkedIn and events

  • Build account plans with each of your AEs, mapping buying groups and use cases for the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, from data engineering and data sharing to Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowflake Intelligence

  • Convert inbound interest from Snowflake World Tour, webinars and partner campaigns into qualified enterprise pipeline for your AE accounts

  • Qualify opportunities using MEDDPICC, uncovering business pain, metrics and the decision process before handing over to the right AE

  • Use AI-assisted research, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Outreach to personalise outreach at scale, and test new approaches to see what works

  • Keep pipeline and activity accurate in Salesforce, and share what you learn from the market with your AEs, Sales and Marketing

OUR IDEAL ENTERPRISE SDR WILL HAVE:

  • 1+ years in a target-driven, new business role, such as SDR, BDR, inside sales, or agency recruitment on a 360 or business development desk

  • A track record of consistently exceeding targets, with results you can walk us through

  • Confidence engaging senior or C-level stakeholders and running multi-threaded outreach into large, complex organisations

  • The ability to support several senior stakeholders at once, balancing priorities across multiple AEs and account sets

  • Genuine curiosity about data, cloud and AI, and a willingness to learn the Snowflake platform quickly

  • Clear, persuasive written and spoken communication

  • A disciplined approach to managing your time, activity and pipeline

  • A clear ambition to grow into a closing role, such as Inside Sales Representative or Account Executive, and an appetite for coaching and feedback

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience selling software, cloud, data or SaaS products, including at a smaller or high-growth vendor

  • Experience prospecting into enterprise or large-account segments

  • Exposure to MEDDPICC, Value Selling or a similar qualification methodology

  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Gong or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your prospecting workflow

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

Snowflake is one of the fastest-growing companies in the data and AI space, and our Australian business is scaling with it. As an Enterprise SDR, you'll work on some of the most strategic accounts in the region, learn directly from three experienced Enterprise AEs and our Solution Engineers, and build the skills that lead to a closing role.

Your development is supported from day one: structured onboarding and enablement, AE mentorship, regular progression check-ins and a defined promotion framework, with potential pathways into Inside Sales Representative or Account Executive roles as you demonstrate readiness, and we'd love to hear from you whatever your path so far.

How do you want to make your impact?

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team.

Snowflake is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values and our culture! We’re also looking for people with a growth mindset and the pragmatic insight to solve for today while building for the future.

Do you want to be part of the team that is shaking up the data and AI world? Snowflake product marketers conceive and execute the go-to-market for the most strategic areas of the business. We’re looking for a highly talented, driven, and self-motivated marketing professional who can assist with product marketing for AI. This PMM will work across our Snowflake sales, product, and marketing teams to develop go-to-market plans and solutions that position Snowflake as the top choice for all priority AI use cases.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Focus Area: Enterprise Data Agents

  • Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team. Snowflake is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values and our culture! We’re also looking for people with a growth mindset and the pragmatic insight to solve for today while building for the future. Do you want to be part of the team that is shaking up the data and AI world? Snowflake product marketers conceive and execute the go-to-market for the most strategic areas of the business. We’re looking for a highly talented, driven, and self-motivated marketing professional who can assist with product marketing for Analytics. This PMM will work across our Snowflake sales, product, and marketing teams to develop go-to-market plans and solutions that position Snowflake as the top choice for all priority Analytics use cases on data modernization.

  • We are seeking a Principal Product Marketing Lead for AI to spearhead the go-to-market strategy for our Enterprise Data Agents.

  • Lead the Enterprise Data Agents of Snowflake to activate customers’ AI journey and accelerate their business outcomes. Define and communicate the value proposition focused on Enterprise AI outcomes and AI readiness. Plan and execute multi-wave program launches including customer marketing activities such as webinars and events. Align co-marketing motions with partners and create partner ready assets to scale the program. Enable field and partners with TCO/ROI frameworks, qualification guides, customer stories to accelerate pipeline. Track and measure the program success, leverage customer, partner and field feedback and success metrics to refine messaging and execution.

  • You will be at the forefront of a groundbreaking shift, crafting the narrative for how customers can transform unstructured data—including text, images, and audio—into actionable intelligence. This role will champion our Frontier AI platform partnerships. You will be responsible for articulating how our solution powers the largest AI workloads with speed and accuracy, providing consistent, interactive insights across all tools and eliminating the need for data extracts. Your mission is to empower every organization to make faster, more informed decisions by enabling them to talk to their data and build intelligent dashboards with unparalleled ease.

  • Build and execute a go-to-market strategy and innovative programs and campaigns that position AI on Snowflake as the leader

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with demand generation, content marketing, sales, product management, Alliances and other teams to build alignment around go-to-market plans

  • Execute and be accountable for the success of go-to-market campaigns

  • Communicate customer requirements and provide input to product management on product enhancements and future product direction

  • Develop market/competitive intelligence, acting as our thought leader and expert

 

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

  • 10+ years in product marketing, cloud marketing, or technical GTM roles.

  • Strong storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts into outcome‑driven narratives.

  • Proven success driving cross‑functional programs with sales, engineering, and partners.

  • Ability to manage multiple launches and GTM motions simultaneously.

  • Familiarity with migration patterns, modernization frameworks, and cloud adoption programs.

  • Experience landing large‑scale programs across diverse markets and customer segments.

  • Cross-functional team management and organizational skills, influence without authority, including senior management

  • Excellent communication skills, and can engage internal leaders/teams across functions and external stakeholders

  • Strong written communication skills and ability to synthesize complex information into clear and concise presentations and plans

  • Demonstrated track record of building and executing successful go-to-market programs and campaigns

  • Analytical mindset, interpreting and summarizing data with actionable insights

  • Technical- and business-benefit understanding of prevailing and emerging data technologies, on-premises and in the cloud.

  • BS/BA, MBA preferred

This role will be based in Snowflake’s Menlo Park, CA, Dublin, CA OR Bellevue, WA offices.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

jobs.descriptionHtml:

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is experiencing rapid growth and we are expanding our team to support and accelerate this growth. We are deeply committed to our employees, customers, values, and culture. We are looking for individuals who have a growth mindset and the practical insight to address current challenges while also laying the foundation for future success. As a member of the Snowflake team, you will be responsible for promoting and fostering diversity and inclusivity.

We are in search of a Majors Expansion Sales Manager, on our Financial Services team, who embodies Snowflake’s values and has a proven track record of creating an inclusive and collaborative work environment that brings people and ideas together. This individual should possess strong communication skills, be open to giving and receiving constructive feedback, be adept at recognizing and celebrating the achievements of others, and have a genuine passion for our technology, as well as a commitment to continuous learning and teaching.

 

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT FOR THE TEAM IF YOU HAVE:

  • An understanding of Snowflake's product in order to be able to provide guidance to navigate complex technical evaluations

  • Drive to enable, coach, develop and motivate a robust Majors sales team

  • Developed territories by planning strategically and effectively

  • 10+ years guiding Account Executives through complex legal and commercial negotiations

  • A customer first mindset to ensure success

  • Consistently executed what is forecasted to senior management

  • Understand how to sell business value, using a repeatable process

  • Coach reps on how to create urgency and deal control

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

  • Recruit and build successful sales professionals into high-performing revenue drivers for Snowflake

  • Build cross-functional relationships with internal and external support teams & technical partners

  • Influence go-to-market strategy for top tier financial services companies.

  • Develop a team culture around Snowflake Core Values

  • Sell an industry changing and market defining product

 

ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

  • BA/BS required

  • 15+ years selling Cloud Solutions, Infrastructure Software, Databases, Analytic Tools, or Applications Software

  • 10+ years managing a team of sales teams

  • Have sold to the Financial Services industry

  • Sold to CEOs, CTOs, Heads of Product, Engineering, or Data Science

  • Ability to coach your team how to target and pursue an opportunity with our ideal customer profile within a complex sales cycle

  • Experience outperforming targets as an individual contributor in an outbound role

  • Ability to coach AEs how to navigate commercial and legal negotiations when working with procurement, legal, and business teams.

  • Ability to work with sales engineering managers and customers to inventory existing software state, define migration plans, and build business cases for migrations to drive new logo acquisition.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
